title: AgentWall: A Runtime Safety Layer for Local AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, open-source implementation at https://github.com/agentwall/Agentwall
summary: The safety of autonomous AI agents is increasingly recognized as a critical open problem. As agents transition from passive text generators to active actors capable of executing shell commands, modifying files, calling APIs, and browsing the web, the consequences of unsafe or adversarially manipulated behavior become immediate and tangible. Existing AI safety work has focused primarily on model alignment and input filtering, but these approaches do not address what happens at the moment an agent's intent becomes a real action on a real machine. This gap is especially acute in local environments, where developers run agents against their own filesystems, credentials, and infrastructure with little runtime control. This paper introduces AgentWall, a runtime safety and observability layer for local AI agents. AgentWall intercepts every proposed agent action before it reaches the host environment, evaluates it against an explicit declarative policy, requires human approval for sensitive operations, and records a complete execution trail for audit and replay. It is implemented as a policy-enforcing MCP proxy and native OpenClaw plugin, working across Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and OpenClaw with a single install command. We present the design, architecture, threat model, and policy model of AgentWall, and demonstrate 92.9% policy enforcement accuracy with sub-millisecond overhead across 14 benchmark tests. AgentWall is open-source at https://github.com/agentwall/Agentwall.

AI.tldr: AgentWall是一个面向本地AI代理的运行时安全与可观测层，通过拦截代理动作、执行声明式策略、要求敏感操作人工审批并记录完整执行轨迹，实现了92.9%的策略执行准确率和亚毫秒级开销，支持多个主流AI代理平台。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全工作主要集中在模型对齐和输入过滤，但未解决代理意图转化为真实机器操作时的安全问题，尤其是在本地环境中开发者运行代理时缺乏运行时控制。
AI.method: AgentWall实现为策略执行的MCP代理和原生OpenClaw插件，在代理动作到达主机环境前进行拦截，基于声明式策略进行评估，对敏感操作要求人工审批，并记录完整执行轨迹用于审计和重放。
AI.result: 在14个基准测试中实现了92.9%的策略执行准确率，且开销为亚毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: AgentWall有效填补了AI代理从意图到真实机器操作之间的安全空白，为本地AI代理提供了实用的运行时安全保护。
idea_en: A runtime safety layer that intercepts every proposed AI agent action before execution and evaluates against a declarative policy.
A policy-enforcing MCP (Model Context Protocol) proxy architecture for runtime agent action filtering.
A unified safety plugin system working across Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and OpenClaw with single-install.
A complete execution trail recording mechanism for audit and replay of all AI agent actions.
A hierarchical policy model requiring human approval for sensitive operations while allowing autonomous execution for safe ones.
Sub-millisecond overhead policy enforcement mechanism for real-time agent action interception.
A cross-platform runtime observability layer specifically designed for local AI agent environments.
idea_ch: 一种在执行前拦截每个AI代理提议动作并基于声明式策略进行评估的运行时安全层
一种用于运行时代理动作过滤的策略执行MCP（模型上下文协议）代理架构
一种通过单次安装即可跨Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、Claude Code和OpenClaw工作的统一安全插件系统
一种用于所有AI代理动作审计和重放的完整执行轨迹记录机制
一种要求敏感操作需人工审批而允许安全操作自主执行的分层策略模型
一种用于实时代理动作拦截的亚毫秒级开销策略执行机制
一种专为本地AI代理环境设计的跨平台运行时可观测层

title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
summary: LLM-based agents can recover from individual execution errors, yet they repeatedly fail on the same fault when the underlying process knowledge--operator schemas, preconditions, and constraints--remains unrepaired. Existing self-evolving approaches address this gap by updating prompts, memory, or model weights, but none directly repair the symbolic structures that encode how tasks are executed, and few provide the governance guarantees required for safe deployment. We introduce ANNEAL, a neuro-symbolic agent that converts recurring failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without modifying foundation model weights. Its core mechanism, Failure-Driven Knowledge Acquisition (FDKA), localizes the responsible operator, synthesizes a typed patch through constrained LLM generation, and validates the proposal via multi-dimensional scoring, symbolic guardrails, and canary testing before commit. Every accepted edit carries full provenance and deterministic rollback capability. Across four domains and 27 multi-seed runs, ANNEAL is the only evaluated system that commits persistent structural repairs--strong baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion achieve high episodic recovery yet retain 72-100% holdout failure rates on recurring faults, whereas ANNEAL reduces these to 0% in the tested recurring-failure settings. Ablation confirms that removing FDKA eliminates all structural repairs and drops success rate by up to 26.7 percentage points. These results suggest that governed symbolic repair offers a complementary paradigm to weight-level and prompt-level adaptation for persistent fault elimination.

AI.tldr: ANNEAL是一种神经符号智能体，通过将重复性故障转化为受治理的符号知识图谱编辑（而非修改模型权重），实现持久性结构修复，在多个领域将重复故障率降至0%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体可以从单个执行错误中恢复，但当底层过程知识（操作符模式、前置条件和约束）未被修复时，会对相同故障反复失败。现有自演化方法更新提示、记忆或模型权重，但均未直接修复编码任务执行方式的符号结构，且缺乏安全部署所需的治理保证。
AI.method: ANNEAL的核心机制为故障驱动知识获取（FDKA）：定位故障责任操作符，通过受约束的LLM生成合成类型化补丁，再通过多维评分、符号护栏和金丝雀测试验证提案，最终提交带有完整来源和确定性回滚能力的编辑。
AI.result: 在四个领域和27个多种子运行中，ANNEAL是唯一提交持久结构修复的系统，将重复故障率降至0%，而ReAct和Reflexion等强基线保留72-100%的重复故障率。消融实验证实移除FDKA会消除所有结构修复并使成功率下降26.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 受治理的符号修复提供了权重级和提示级适应之外的互补范式，用于持久消除故障。
idea_en: A neuro-symbolic agent architecture that converts recurring execution failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without modifying foundation model weights.

A Failure-Driven Knowledge Acquisition (FDKA) mechanism that localizes responsible operators, synthesizes typed patches via constrained LLM generation, and validates proposals through multi-dimensional scoring, symbolic guardrails, and canary testing before commit.
A system that ensures every accepted edit carries full provenance and deterministic rollback capability for safe governance.
A method for persistent structural repair of operator schemas, preconditions, and constraints in LLM-based agents to eliminate recurring faults.
An approach combining symbolic guardrails with canary testing to validate knowledge graph edits proposed by LLM generation before committing changes.
idea_ch: 一种神经符号智能体架构，将重复执行故障转化为对过程知识图谱的受治理符号编辑，无需修改基础模型权重。
故障驱动知识获取（FDKA）机制：定位责任操作符，通过受约束的LLM生成合成类型化补丁，并通过多维评分、符号护栏和金丝雀测试验证提案后提交。
确保每个接受的编辑带有完整来源和确定性回滚能力的系统，用于安全治理。
一种对LLM智能体中操作符模式、前置条件和约束进行持久结构修复以消除重复故障的方法。
将符号护栏与金丝雀测试相结合的方法，在提交前验证LLM生成的知识图谱编辑提案。

title: From Prompts to Protocols: An AI Agent for Laboratory Automation
summary: Automating science laboratories enables faster, safer, more accurate, and more reproducible execution of protocols, accelerating the discovery and testing of new materials, drugs, and more. However, setting up and running autonomous labs requires coordinating numerous instruments and robots, forcing scientists to write code, manage configuration files, and navigate complex software infrastructure. We present an AI agent architecture that integrates large language models with laboratory orchestration, enabling scientists to interactively create and monitor automated lab protocols using natural language. Integrated into the Experiment Orchestration System (EOS), the AI agent operates under an agentic loop with automated validation and error correction, and supports the complete experimental lifecycle: creating protocols, running and monitoring both protocols and closed-loop optimization campaigns, and analyzing results. A visual graph editor renders protocols as interactive node-based diagrams synchronized with the AI agent's protocol representation, enabling seamless alternation between AI-assisted and manual protocol construction. Evaluated on three simulated automated labs spanning chemistry, biology, and materials science, the AI agent achieves a 97% first-attempt protocol generation success rate and an order of magnitude reduction in required interface actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI智能体架构，集成大语言模型与实验室编排系统，使科学家通过自然语言交互式创建、监控自动化实验协议，在化学、生物、材料三个模拟实验室中实现97%的首轮协议生成成功率，并大幅减少界面操作。
AI.motivation: 自动化科学实验室虽然能加速新材料、药物的发现和测试，但设置和运行自主实验室需要协调大量仪器和机器人，科学家被迫编写代码、管理配置文件和处理复杂的软件基础设施，效率低下且门槛高。
AI.method: 提出一种AI智能体架构，将大语言模型与实验室编排系统集成，通过智能体循环（agentic loop）实现自动验证和错误纠正，支持实验全生命周期；同时配备可视化图形编辑器，以交互式节点图方式同步呈现协议，支持AI辅助与手动构建无缝切换。
AI.result: 在化学、生物学、材料科学三个模拟自动化实验室中评估，AI智能体实现了97%的首轮协议生成成功率，并将所需的界面操作数量减少了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该AI智能体架构有效降低了科学家使用自动化实验室的门槛，无需编写大量代码即可通过自然语言操控复杂实验流程，具有很高的实用价值和推广前景。
idea_en: A large language model-based AI agent architecture integrated with an Experiment Orchestration System (EOS) that enables scientists to create, monitor, and modify automated laboratory protocols through natural language interaction, with automated validation and error correction via an agentic loop.

A visual graph editor that renders experimental protocols as interactive node-based diagrams, synchronized bidirectionally with the AI agent's internal protocol representation, allowing seamless switching between AI-assisted and manual protocol editing.

A method for closed-loop optimization campaign management where the AI agent autonomously runs and monitors iterative experimental cycles, analyzes results, and adjusts subsequent protocols without human intervention.
A system that automatically translates natural language descriptions of experimental procedures into machine-executable protocol code for coordinating multiple laboratory instruments and robots.
idea_ch: 基于大语言模型的AI智能体架构，集成于实验编排系统（EOS），允许科学家通过自然语言交互式创建、监控和修改自动化实验室协议，并具备通过智能体循环实现的自动验证与错误纠正功能。
可视化图形编辑器，将实验协议渲染为交互式节点图，与AI智能体的内部协议表示双向同步，支持AI辅助与手动编辑模式的无缝切换。
闭环优化活动管理方法，AI智能体自主运行和监控迭代实验循环，分析结果并自动调整后续协议，无需人工干预。
自动将自然语言描述的实验流程翻译为机器可执行的协议代码的系统，用于协调多个实验室仪器和机器人协同工作。

title: Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents
summary: Skim is a speculative execution framework for web agents that exploits the predictable structure of purpose-built websites. Today's web-agent expense is not intrinsic to the tasks but a property of how agents are composed: frontier-model inference, browser rendering, and ReAct-style planning are applied to every step of every task regardless of complexity. Skim's key observation is that websites enforce stable URL patterns, answer formats, and task-to-trajectory mappings across queries of the same type, so most queries can bypass these heavyweight components entirely. An offline profiler captures these patterns once per site. At runtime, Skim matches each query to a template, synthesizes the destination URL, and extracts the answer with a small model. A lightweight verifier gates each fast-path output against the query and schema; rare misspeculations cascade to the full agent, warm-started by the fast path's final URL to preserve upstream trajectory progress. Across standard web-agent benchmarks paired with three backboneagents (WebVoyager, AgentOccam, BrowserUse), Skim reduces median per-task cost by 1.9x and latency by 33.4% with no accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: Skim是一个面向Web Agent的投机执行框架，利用目的性网站的可预测结构，通过离线分析捕获URL模式、答案格式和任务轨迹映射，在运行时让大多数查询绕过昂贵的前沿模型推理和浏览器渲染，仅用轻量级模板匹配和验证器快速执行，仅在罕见情况下回退到完整Agent，实现成本降低1.9倍、延迟降低33.4%且准确率不变。
AI.motivation: 当前Web Agent的成本并非任务本身固有的，而是由于Agent组成方式的问题——无论任务复杂度如何，每一步都使用前沿模型推理、浏览器渲染和ReAct式规划，导致大量计算浪费。而多数Web查询实际上遵循可预测的网站结构模式，无需每次都使用这些重型组件。
AI.method: 1) 离线分析器(Offline Profiler)：对每个网站捕获稳定的URL模式、答案格式和任务到轨迹的映射；2) 运行时将查询与模板匹配，直接合成目标URL；3) 用小模型从页面提取答案；4) 轻量级验证器(Verifier)对快速路径输出进行验证；5) 当验证失败时（罕见情况），回退到完整Agent，且用快速路径的最终URL热启动以保持上游轨迹进度。
AI.result: 在标准Web Agent基准测试上，搭配三种骨干Agent（WebVoyager、AgentOccam、BrowserUse），Skim将每任务中位成本降低1.9倍，延迟降低33.4%，且未造成准确率损失。
AI.conclusion: Skim证明了大多数Web查询可以利用网站的结构可预测性绕过昂贵组件，通过投机执行框架实现成本与效率的大幅提升，同时保持准确率不变。
idea_en: Speculative execution framework for web agents that uses offline profiling to capture URL patterns, answer formats, and task-to-trajectory mappings per website, enabling most queries to bypass heavy model inference and browser rendering.
Fast-path execution system with template matching and small-model answer extraction, combined with a lightweight verifier to gate outputs against query and schema.
Cascading fallback mechanism that warm-starts the full agent with the fast path's final URL upon verification failure, preserving upstream trajectory progress.
Offline profiler that pre-learns stable website structures (URL patterns, answer formats, task mappings) to enable runtime query bypass of expensive components.
idea_ch: 一种面向Web Agent的投机执行框架，通过离线分析捕获每个网站的URL模式、答案格式和任务到轨迹的映射，使大多数查询无需经过重型模型推理和浏览器渲染即可快速执行
一种快速路径执行系统，采用模板匹配和小模型答案提取，并结合轻量级验证器对输出结果进行查询和模式验证
一种级联回退机制，在验证失败时利用快速路径的最终URL热启动完整Agent，保持上游轨迹进度不丢失
一种离线分析器，预先学习稳定的网站结构（URL模式、答案格式、任务映射），使运行时查询能够绕过昂贵的计算组件

title: Scalable Uncertainty Reasoning in Knowledge Graphs
comment: 14 pages. Preprint of a paper accepted at the ESWC 2026 PhD Symposium
summary: Knowledge Graphs are pivotal for semantic data integration. The real-world data they model is often inherently uncertain. Within knowledge graphs, uncertainty manifests in three distinct levels: imprecise attribute values, probabilistic triple existence, and incomplete schema knowledge. However, current Semantic Web standards lack native support for reasoning over such uncertainty, and naïve extensions often incur computational intractability. In this thesis, I aim to develop a modular framework that addresses each level through tailored techniques: (1) defining probabilistic literals and a corresponding query algebra for continuous attributes; (2) a compilation-based framework transforming SPARQL provenance into tractable probabilistic circuits for uncertain triples; and (3) topology-aware geometric embeddings for statistical schema reasoning. The central hypothesis is that specialized reasoning mechanisms, namely algebraic, logical, and geometric approaches, can reconcile semantic precision with computational tractability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化框架，通过代数、逻辑和几何三种专门推理机制，分别处理知识图谱中属性值不精确、三元组存在概率不确定和模式知识不完整三个层次的不确定性，旨在实现语义精度与计算可处理性的平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前语义网标准缺乏对知识图谱中不确定性的原生支持，而简单的扩展往往导致计算不可处理。知识图谱中的不确定性存在于三个不同层次（不精确的属性值、概率性的三元组存在、不完整的模式知识），需要针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: (1) 定义概率字面量和对应查询代数来处理连续属性；(2) 基于编译的框架，将SPARQL溯源转换为可处理的概率电路来处理不确定三元组；(3) 拓扑感知的几何嵌入用于统计模式推理。
AI.result: 尚未给出具体实验结果，论文提出了模块化框架的设计思路和三个层次的技术方案。
AI.conclusion: 专门化的推理机制（代数、逻辑、几何方法）能够在语义精度与计算可处理性之间取得平衡，为知识图谱中的不确定性推理提供可行的解决方案。
idea_en: A method for representing uncertain continuous attribute values in knowledge graphs using probabilistic literals with a dedicated query algebra that enables tractable reasoning over imprecise data.

A compilation-based framework that transforms SPARQL provenance information into tractable probabilistic circuits (e.g., arithmetic circuits or Bayesian networks) for efficient reasoning over uncertain triple existence.
Topology-aware geometric embeddings for statistical schema reasoning that capture incomplete schema knowledge in knowledge graphs through learned representations with topological constraints.

A modular multi-level uncertainty reasoning framework that combines algebraic (attribute-level), logical (triple-level), and geometric (schema-level) approaches tailored to different uncertainty types in knowledge graphs.
Probabilistic query algebra operators specifically designed for continuous data types in RDF/SPARQL context enabling native uncertainty handling in semantic web queries.
idea_ch: 一种使用概率字面量和专用查询代数表示知识图谱中不确定连续属性值的方法，实现对不精确数据的可处理推理
一种基于编译的框架，将SPARQL溯源信息转换为可处理的概率电路（如算术电路或贝叶斯网络），用于对不确定三元组存在进行高效推理
拓扑感知的几何嵌入方法，通过具有拓扑约束的学习表示对知识图谱中不完整的模式知识进行统计模式推理
一种模块化的多层次不确定性推理框架，结合代数（属性级）、逻辑（三元组级）和几何（模式级）方法，针对知识图谱中不同类型的不确定性
专为RDF/SPARQL上下文中连续数据类型设计的概率查询代数运算符，实现语义网查询中原生的不确定性处理

title: Counterparty Modeling is Not Strategy: The Limits of LLM Negotiators
summary: Negotiation requires more than inferring what the other side wants: it requires using that information to make advantageous offers and counteroffers over multiple turns. We study whether large language model (LLM) agents do this in a controlled multi-attribute bargaining environment. We find that current LLM agents can model a counterparty's preferences, but do not reliably turn that knowledge into strategic bargaining. When given negotiating partner preference information, agents model it accurately and early in their reasoning traces, yet this does not reliably improve outcomes for the informed side. Turn-level analyses show why: agents often respond to what they believe the counterparty values, but do not consistently pair those moves with gains on their own high-value attributes. Sellers are more accommodating overall, and in asymmetric-information conditions, the informed side often makes the more weakly compensated concessions. Because agents fail to leverage this underlying utility structure for strategic advantage, their final agreements are heavily dictated by surface-level opening anchors rather than actual utility weights. Finally, requiring agents to explicitly state concession-for-reciprocity trades before making an offer makes individual turns look more strategic, but ultimately fails to improve the efficiency of the final agreements.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM智能体在多属性谈判中的表现，发现它们虽能建模对手偏好，但无法将这种知识转化为战略性的谈判优势，最终协议质量受表面锚定效应主导。
AI.motivation: 探究大规模语言模型（LLM）智能体在多轮、多属性谈判环境中，能否利用对手偏好信息进行战略性议价，而不仅仅是推断对方需求。
AI.method: 在受控的多属性议价环境中，通过给予LLM智能体谈判对手的偏好信息，分析其在推理过程中是否准确建模对手偏好，以及这些信息是否实际改善谈判结果。通过回合级分析研究智能体的让步与交换行为。
AI.result: LLM智能体能准确建模对手偏好，但这种知识并未可靠地改善知情方的谈判结果。智能体常回应对手重视的属性，但未能在自己高价值属性上获得相应收益。卖方更易让步，信息不对称下知情方反而做出更多弱补偿性让步。最终协议受表面锚定影响大于实际效用权重。要求智能体明确陈述交换方案未能提高最终协议效率。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体缺乏将对手偏好信息转化为战略性谈判优势的能力，其行为模式偏离理性博弈策略，更受锚定效应影响。
idea_en: A negotiation system that explicitly models the counterparty's utility weights and guides LLM agents to make concession-for-reciprocity trades aligned with their own high-value attributes.
A multi-attribute bargaining framework that detects when an LLM agent is being influenced by surface-level anchors and automatically adjusts negotiation strategy to prioritize utility weights.

A structured reasoning method for LLM agents that separates preference modeling from strategic offer generation, ensuring that modeled preferences are explicitly translated into advantageous proposals.
An asymmetric-information negotiation protocol that prevents the informed party from making weakly compensated concessions by enforcing proportional utility gain requirements.
A turn-level negotiation optimization algorithm that evaluates each offer against both counterparty preferences and the agent's own utility weights to identify exploitable opportunities.
idea_ch: 一种谈判系统，显式建模对手效用权重并引导LLM智能体做出与自身高价值属性对齐的让步交换策略
一种多属性议价框架，检测LLM智能体受表面锚定影响时自动调整谈判策略以优先考虑效用权重
一种结构化推理方法，将偏好建模与战略出价生成分离，确保建模的偏好被显式转化为有利提案
一种非对称信息谈判协议，通过强制执行比例效用增益要求，防止知情方做出弱补偿性让步
一种回合级谈判优化算法，结合对手偏好和智能体自身效用权重评估每次出价，识别可被利用的机会

title: PRISMat: Policy-Driven, Permutation-Invariant Autoregressive Material Generation
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, Under Review at Neurips 2026
summary: Rapid identification of candidate materials with target properties has become a key task in materials science. Machine learning has emerged as an alternative to physics-based simulation, offering a faster and cheaper way to filter materials based on their stability and other target properties, reducing the number of candidates that reach the costly synthesis stage. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied to this role, but these models are parameter-heavy and computationally expensive both during training and at inference time, making them unsuitable for high-throughput tasks. This inefficiency stems from both the large over-parameterization of language models and the difficulty of framing material generation as a sequence learning problem. In this paper, we present PRISMat, a cost-effective, permutation-invariant model, which addresses these limitations. We show that PRISMat, despite taking less time for inference, is able to outperform LLMs in generating crystal slabs conditioned on critical materials' surface properties. In targeted material discovery, we achieve mean absolute errors of 0.188 eV/A$^2$ and 2.79 eV for cleavage energy and work function tasks, respectively, reducing the error of the next best model by 4$\times$.

AI.tldr: PRISMat是一种低成本、置换不变的模型，在晶体表面性质预测任务上以更少推理时间超越LLMs，误差降低4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLMs在材料科学中参数庞大、计算成本高，不适合高通量筛选任务，且材料生成作为序列学习存在困难。
AI.method: 提出PRISMat模型，采用置换不变性设计，避免将材料生成作为序列学习问题，实现高效推理。
AI.result: 在解理能和工作函数任务上MAE分别为0.188 eV/A²和2.79 eV，误差比次优模型降低4倍，且推理时间更短。
AI.conclusion: PRISMat证明了低成本、置换不变模型在高通量材料筛选和性质预测中比大规模LLMs更有效。
idea_en: A permutation-invariant neural network architecture for crystal slab generation that treats atomic positions as a set rather than a sequence, eliminating the need for sequential representation learning.
A cost-effective inference framework for high-throughput materials screening that achieves 4x error reduction compared to LLM-based approaches while requiring less inference time.
A conditional generation method for crystal surfaces that simultaneously predicts multiple critical surface properties (cleavage energy and work function) using a single permutation-invariant model.
idea_ch: 一种置换不变神经网络架构，将原子位置作为集合而非序列处理，消除材料生成中的序列学习依赖，提升晶体 slab 生成效率。
一种低成本高通量材料筛选推理框架，相比基于LLM的方法误差降低4倍且推理时间更短。
一种晶体表面条件生成方法，利用单一置换不变模型同时预测解理能和工作函数等多个关键表面性质。

title: TTE-Flash: Accelerating Reasoning-based Multimodal Representations via Think-Then-Embed Tokens
summary: Recent research has demonstrated that Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) benefits significantly from Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. In this paradigm, a generative model produces explicit reasoning traces for a multimodal query, with the final representation extracted from an <eos> embedding token attending to both the query and the reasoning. Despite its effectiveness, the computational overhead of generating explicit CoT traces is often prohibitive. In this work, we propose replacing explicit CoT with latent think tokens, which are interpreted as latent variables that can produce explicit CoT traces as observed variables. By optimizing think tokens using CoT generation loss and subsequent embedding tokens using contrastive loss, we produce high-performance, reasoning-aware representations at a constant inference cost. Our study investigates two key architectural designs: 1) how think and embeddings tokens should be extracted from the same LLM backbone. 2) how the tokens should be trained as two dependent tasks. We introduce TTE-Flash-2B, a reasoning-aware multimodal representation model that outperforms its explicit-CoT counterpart on the MMEB-v2 benchmark, while producing latent think tokens that are interpretable both textually and visually. Furthermore, zero-shot evaluation across 15 video datasets reveals scaling behavior as the number of think tokens increases, and motivating a pilot study of adaptive think budget allocation based on task requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出用隐式思考令牌（latent think tokens）替代显式思维链（CoT）推理，在恒定推理成本下实现高性能、推理感知的多模态表示。
AI.motivation: 显式CoT推理虽能提升通用多模态嵌入（UME）性能，但计算开销过大，亟需一种既能保留推理能力又降低计算成本的方案。
AI.method: 将隐式思考令牌视为潜变量，通过CoT生成损失优化思考令牌，再通过对比损失优化嵌入令牌；研究了两种架构设计：1) 思考令牌与嵌入令牌如何从同一LLM骨干中提取；2) 两者如何作为两个依赖任务进行训练。
AI.result: 提出的TTE-Flash-2B在MMEB-v2基准上超越显式CoT方案；思考令牌在文本和视觉上均可解释；15个视频数据集零样本评估显示随思考令牌数量增加存在缩放行为。
AI.conclusion: 隐式思考令牌可在恒定推理成本下实现推理感知的多模态表示，并支持自适应思考预算分配，为高效多模态推理提供了新范式。
idea_en: Method of training latent think tokens using CoT generation loss combined with contrastive loss on embedding tokens for reasoning-aware multimodal representations.
Architecture design for extracting both think tokens and embedding tokens from the same LLM backbone as two dependent tasks.
Adaptive think budget allocation mechanism based on task requirements, utilizing the scaling behavior observed with increasing think tokens.
idea_ch: 一种利用思维链生成损失和对比损失联合优化隐式思考令牌与嵌入令牌，实现推理感知多模态表示的方法
从同一大语言模型骨干中提取思考令牌和嵌入令牌并将其作为两个依赖任务训练的架构设计
基于任务需求的自适应思考预算分配机制，利用思考令牌数量增加时的缩放行为动态调整推理深度

title: Sustainable Intelligence for the Wild: Democratizing Ecological Monitoring via Knowledge-Adaptive Edge Expert Agents
summary: Rapid biodiversity loss underscore the urgency of effective monitoring, yet manual surveys remain resource-intensive. While on-device AI offers a scalable alternative, its performance in the wild is often challenged by environmental variability. Current methods rely heavily on cloud resource, which requires continuous uploading of field data for model retraining. This approach is unsuitable for remote deployments because it consumes limited power and network connectivity. To address these constraints, this research proposes a shift from model adaptation to knowledge adaptation. We introduce an architecture that separates visual perception from reasoning, combining a visual encoder with a dynamic knowledge base. We uses an explicit knowledge base to replace implicitly encoding expert knowledge into model parameters. This method also supports knowledge sustainability by preserving expert insights in a structured form. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration with biologists and Indigenous communities, this work advances ethical AI co-development, fostering responsible and culturally informed ecosystem management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将视觉感知与推理分离的架构，通过动态知识库替代隐式编码专家知识，实现设备端AI的可持续知识适应，解决野外部署中网络和能耗限制问题。
AI.motivation: 传统手工生物多样性监测资源密集，现有设备端AI受环境变化影响大，依赖云端数据持续上传的模型适应方式在偏远地区受限于网络和能耗。
AI.method: 提出从模型适应转向知识适应的范式转变，构建视觉编码器+动态知识库的分离架构，用显式结构化知识库替代隐式参数编码，支持跨学科协作的伦理AI共同开发。
AI.result: 该方法可在有限网络和能耗条件下运行，保持专家知识的结构化存储与可持续性，通过生物学家和原住民社区的跨学科协作实现文化敏感的生态系统管理。
AI.conclusion: 知识适应范式比模型适应更适合偏远地区生物多样性监测，显式知识库架构为设备端AI提供了可扩展、可持续且符合伦理的解决方案。
idea_en: A vision-reasoning separation architecture for on-device AI that decouples visual perception from inference using a dynamic knowledge base, enabling model updates without cloud dependency.
A method for converting domain expert knowledge into structured, queryable knowledge base entries that can be updated dynamically on edge devices without retraining neural networks.
A sustainable knowledge preservation system that maintains expert ecological insights in explicit structural form, allowing knowledge transfer across generations of AI models.
An ethical AI co-development framework integrating biologists and Indigenous communities into the model design process for culturally informed biodiversity monitoring.
idea_ch: 一种将视觉感知与推理分离的设备端AI架构，通过动态知识库实现无需依赖云端的模型更新。
一种将领域专家知识转化为结构化、可查询知识库条目的方法，支持在边缘设备上动态更新而无需重新训练神经网络。
一种可持续知识保存系统，以显式结构化形式维护生态专家知识，支持跨代AI模型的知识传递。
一种整合生物学家和原住民社区的伦理AI共同开发框架，用于文化敏感的生态监测系统设计。

title: LinAlg-Bench: A Forensic Benchmark Revealing Structural Failure Modes in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 42 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track submission. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LinAlgBench/linalg-bench
summary: We introduce LinAlg-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating 10 frontier large language models on structured linear algebra computation across a strict dimensional gradient of 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 matrices. Spanning 9 task types and 660 SymPy-certified problems, the benchmark exhaustively evaluates 6,600 model outputs. Beyond binary accuracy, LinAlg-Bench introduces a three-stage automated forensic pipeline classifying 1,156 failures into ten primary error tags with fine-grained subtypes, revealing that LLM mathematical failure is not random but structurally constrained by algorithm type and matrix dimension. Our central finding is a sharp behavioral threshold at 4x4 scale: below it, models fail through execution errors -- sign tracking failures, arithmetic drift, and parity errors; above it, failure transitions to computational abandonment, with models fabricating responses through tool roleplay, constraint-consistent confabulation, and structured hallucination rather than attempting computation. This fabrication-to-abandonment transition is near-universal across all model tiers and architectures, suggesting a working memory limit rather than a knowledge gap, supported by three scale-emergent error types absent at 3x3 but present at 4x4 and 5x5. We further show that solution strategy rigidity is a near-perfect predictor of 5x5 determinant accuracy, document constraint-aware confabulation as a novel structured hallucination failure mode, and release all data, model outputs, error labels, and judge pipeline publicly.

AI.tldr: LinAlg-Bench是一个诊断性基准，评估10个前沿大语言模型在结构化线性代数计算上的表现，覆盖3x3、4x4、5x5矩阵的维度梯度，通过660个SymPy验证的问题和6,600个模型输出，揭示LLM数学失败的结构性规律，核心发现是4x4尺度下存在行为阈值——低于该阈值模型出现执行错误，高于阈值则转向计算放弃和结构化幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法系统揭示LLM在数学推理中的失败模式，尤其是未能区分错误类型与维度依赖关系，缺乏对结构化失败机制的深入分析。
AI.method: 构建LinAlg-Bench基准，包含9种线性代数任务类型、3个维度梯度（3x3/4x4/5x5），共660个SymPy验证的问题。设计三阶段自动化取证流水线，将1,156个失败分类为10种主要错误标签及细粒度子类型。
AI.result: (1) LLM数学失败在4x4维度存在尖锐行为阈值；(2) 低于阈值：执行错误（符号跟踪失败、算术漂移、奇偶错误）；(3) 高于阈值：计算放弃（工具角色扮演、约束一致虚构、结构化幻觉）；(4) 策略刚性是5x5行列式准确度的近乎完美预测因子；(5) 发现约束感知虚构（constraint-aware confabulation）作为一种新型结构化幻觉失败模式。
AI.conclusion: LLM在数学推理中的失败主要源于工作记忆限制而非知识缺口，证据是三种维度突现的错误类型仅在3x3以上出现，且放弃-虚构转换在不同模型层级和架构中几乎普遍存在。
idea_en: A diagnostic benchmark (LinAlg-Bench) for systematically evaluating LLMs on structured linear algebra computation across dimensional gradients with SymPy-verified ground truth.
A three-stage automated forensic pipeline that classifies LLM mathematical failures into hierarchical error types with fine-grained subtypes.
Identification of a behavioral threshold phenomenon in LLMs at 4x4 matrix scale, below which execution errors dominate and above which computational abandonment occurs.
Detection of constraint-aware confabulation as a novel structured hallucination failure mode in LLM mathematical reasoning.
A method using solution strategy rigidity as a predictive indicator for high-dimensional determinant computation accuracy in LLMs.
Systematic documentation of scale-emergent error types that appear only at 4x4 and 5x5 matrix dimensions but absent at 3x3.
Tool roleplay and constraint-consistent confabulation detection as methods to identify computational abandonment in LLM outputs.
idea_ch: 一种诊断性基准LinAlg-Bench，用于系统评估大语言模型在结构化解线性代数计算中的表现，覆盖维度梯度并使用SymPy验证真实结果。
一种三阶段自动化取证流水线，将LLM数学失败分类为层次化错误类型及细粒度子类型。
发现LLM在4x4矩阵尺度存在行为阈值现象：低于阈值执行错误主导，高于阈值转向计算放弃的结构化失败模式。
识别约束感知虚构（constraint-aware confabulation）作为LLM数学推理中一种新型结构化幻觉失败模式。
一种利用解题策略刚性作为预测指标的方法，用于评估LLM在高维行列式计算中的准确性。
系统性文档化尺度突现错误类型，这些错误仅在4x4和5x5矩阵维度出现，而在3x3维度缺失。
通过工具角色扮演和约束一致虚构检测来识别LLM输出中计算放弃行为的方法。

title: Enhancing Metacognitive AI: Knowledge-Graph Population with Graph-Theoretic LLM Enrichment
summary: Metacognition-the ability to monitor one's own knowledge state, spot gaps, and autonomously fill them--remains largely absent from modern AI. Here, we present MetaKGEnrich, a fully automated pipeline that endows large language model (LLM) applications with self-directed knowledge repair. The system (i) builds knowledge graphs from a seed query, (ii) detects sparse regions via seven graph metrics, (iii) has GPT-4o generate targeted questions, (iv) retrieves web evidence with Tavily and ingests it into Neo4j, and (v) re-answers the query with GraphRAG for GPT-4 to evaluate improvement. Tested on 30 queries from each of three widely-used datasets: Google Research Natural Questions, MS MARCO, and Hot-potQA. MetaKGEnrich improved answer quality in 80% of HotpotQA questions, 87% of Google Research Natural Questions and 83% of MS MARCO questions, while preserving well-supported regions. This proof of concept demonstrates how topological self-diagnosis plus targeted retrieval can advance AI toward humanlike metacognitive learning.

AI.tldr: MetaKGEnrich是一个全自动管道，通过构建知识图谱、检测稀疏区域、生成针对性问题、检索网络证据并重新回答查询，使LLM应用具备自我导向知识修复能力，在三个数据集上80%以上问题回答质量得到提升。
AI.motivation: 现代AI缺乏元认知能力——即监控自身知识状态、发现知识缺口并自主填补的能力。现有大语言模型无法主动识别和修复自身知识盲区。
AI.method: (i) 从种子查询构建知识图谱；(ii) 通过7种图指标检测稀疏区域；(iii) GPT-4o生成针对性问题；(iv) Tavily检索网络证据并存入Neo4j；(v) GraphRAG重新回答查询，GPT-4评估改进效果。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA上80%、Google Research Natural Questions上87%、MS MARCO上83%的问题回答质量得到提升，同时保留原有良好支撑的区域。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑自诊断+定向检索可以推动AI向人类般的元认知学习能力迈进，是一项概念验证。
idea_en: 1. Topological self-diagnosis system for knowledge gaps in knowledge graphs using seven distinct graph metrics to identify sparse regions.
2. Automated pipeline that combines knowledge graph construction with targeted web evidence retrieval to repair knowledge deficiencies in LLMs.
3. Graph-based metacognitive loop: build graph -> detect sparse regions -> generate questions -> retrieve evidence -> re-answer and evaluate improvement.
4. Method for preserving well-supported knowledge regions while selectively enriching sparse regions in knowledge graphs.
5. Integration of Neo4j graph database with Tavily web search API for dynamic knowledge enrichment of LLM applications.
idea_ch: 1. 基于七种图指标的拓扑自诊断系统，用于检测知识图谱中的稀疏区域以定位知识缺口。
2. 融合知识图谱构建与定向网络证据检索的全自动管道，用于修复大语言模型的知识缺陷。
3. 基于图的元认知循环：构建图谱→检测稀疏区域→生成问题→检索证据→重新回答并评估改进效果。
4. 选择性保留知识图谱中已有良好支撑区域、仅丰富稀疏区域的知识修复方法。
5. Neo4j图数据库与Tavily网络搜索API的集成方案，用于LLM应用的动态知识丰富。

title: Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems
summary: Long-context and memory systems usually treat personalization as a recall problem. In practice, many failures occur later, when a system commits: it turns noisy hints into hard constraints, drops rare witnesses, forgets downstream obligations, or answers despite infeasibility. We introduce Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA) with Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV). CBEA activates a bounded evidence set using typed coverage, tail witnesses, and consequence debt; LCV validates structured commitments before prose and routes infeasible states to repair, abstention, or recontract. Across 360 fixtures and three generation backends, CBEA+LCV reaches zero failures within validator scope at 0.49-0.60 availability over attempted runs. Raw and long-context baselines with the same LCV gate reach zero only at 0.003-0.092. A shadow oracle diagnostic marks the limit: CBEA+LCV recalls 0.012 of uncompiled visible facts, while raw recalls 0.53. The result is a bounded operating point: explicit commitment control and 74-75% lower median input payload, not universal memory dominance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA)与Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV)方法，通过有界证据激活和结构化承诺验证解决长上下文与记忆系统中的承诺失败问题，以降低输入负载为代价实现了零验证器失败率。
AI.motivation: 长上下文和记忆系统通常将个性化视为回忆问题，但实践中许多失败发生在系统进行"承诺"时——将噪声提示转化为硬约束、丢弃稀有见证、遗忘下游义务，或在不可行时仍给出答案。现有方法缺乏对承诺有效性的事前验证机制。
AI.method: CBEA通过类型化覆盖、尾部见证和后果债务激活有界证据集；LCV在生成散文之前验证结构化承诺，并将不可行状态导向修复、弃权或重新签约。
AI.result: 在360个测试案例和三个生成后端上，CBEA+LCV在验证器范围内达到零失败，可用性为0.49-0.60。原始和长上下文基线在相同LCV门控下只有在0.003-0.092可用性时才能达到零失败。影子Oracle诊断显示，CBEA+LCV仅回忆0.012的未编译可见事实，而原始回忆为0.53。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了一个有界操作点：显式承诺控制和输入负载中位数降低74-75%，但牺牲了通用记忆优势，不是通用记忆主导方案。
idea_en: Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation with typed coverage, tail witnesses, and consequence debt for activating bounded evidence sets
Lexicographic Commitment Validation for validating structured commitments before prose generation
Three-way routing mechanism for infeasible states: repair, abstention, or recontract
Commitment-gated generation framework that separates evidence activation from commitment validation
idea_ch: 基于类型化覆盖、尾部见证和后果债务的有界证据激活方法(CBEA)，用于在长上下文中精准激活相关证据集
词法承诺验证方法(LCV)，在生成文本前对结构化承诺进行有效性验证
不可行状态的三路路由机制：自动修复、弃权或重新协商合约
将证据激活与承诺验证分离的承诺门控生成框架，实现零失败率操作点

title: GRID: Graph Representation of Intelligence Data for Security Text Knowledge Graph Construction
summary: Security knowledge graphs can provide computable external memory for security agents, but constructing them from long-form cyber threat intelligence (CTI) remains difficult: LLMs often lack grounded security-domain knowledge, and end-to-end document-to-graph training is hard to supervise with cheap, stable rewards. We present GRID (Graph Representation of Intelligence Data), an end-to-end framework for security text knowledge graph construction. GRID first builds security-domain supervision from CTI articles by creating traceable article-graph alignments through graph extraction and knowledge-graph-conditioned text revision. It then turns document-to-graph learning into a scripted task bank combining four-option multi-select questions with triple-level regex matching targets, yielding more stable task-specific rewards than repeatedly scoring full graph outputs with an LLM judge. Using this supervision pipeline, we train two Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-based 4B extractors: a primary Task-bank Reward model and a secondary End2End Reward model with LLM-as-judge precision/recall rewards. On 249 CTI articles from GRID, CASIE, CTINexus, MalKG, and SecureNLP, the Task-bank Reward model with the ontology-guided GRID extraction pipeline reaches 84.62% source-averaged precision, 64.91% source-averaged recall, and 68.53% Avg F1, achieving the best source-averaged recall and near-top Avg F1 with lower token usage and deployment cost. The End2End Reward model reaches 76.91% precision, 53.85% recall, and 58.06% Avg F1. Further analyses show that task-bank rewards can be built once offline and reused across later post-training runs, outperforming online End2End LLM-as-judge reward and weaker alternatives such as Choice-only Reward and End2End SFT without RL.

AI.tldr: GRID是一个端到端的框架，用于从网络安全威胁情报（CTI）文本中构建知识图谱。它通过构建可追溯的图-文对齐监督数据，将文档到图的学习转化为脚本化任务库（包含多选题和正则匹配目标），训练了两个4B参数的提取器，在多项数据集上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 从长文本网络安全威胁情报（CTI）中构建安全知识图谱面临两个关键困难：1) LLM缺乏扎实的安全领域知识；2) 端到端的文档到图训练难以用廉价、稳定的奖励信号进行监督。
AI.method: 1) 首先从CTI文章构建安全领域监督数据，通过图提取和知识图谱条件文本修订创建可追溯的文章-图对齐；2) 将文档到图学习转化为脚本化任务库，结合四选多选问题和三元组级别正则匹配目标；3) 训练两个基于Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的提取器：主要任务库奖励模型（Task-bank Reward model）和辅助端到端奖励模型（End2End Reward model）。
AI.result: 在来自GRID、CASIE、CTINexus、MalKG和SecureNLP的249篇CTI文章上，Task-bank Reward模型达到84.62%平均精确率、64.91%平均召回率和68.53%平均F1。End2End Reward模型达到76.91%精确率、53.85%召回率和58.06%平均F1。任务库奖励可离线构建并跨后续训练运行复用。
AI.conclusion: GRID框架通过构建任务库奖励实现了更稳定的文档到图训练，任务库奖励优于端到端LLM评判奖励及其他较弱替代方案（如仅选择奖励和端到端SFT），且具有更低的token使用和部署成本。
idea_en: A method for constructing security-domain supervision data from CTI articles by creating traceable article-graph alignments through graph extraction and knowledge-graph-conditioned text revision.
A scripted task bank for document-to-graph learning that combines four-option multi-select questions with triple-level regex matching targets, providing stable task-specific rewards.
A two-model architecture comprising a primary Task-bank Reward model and a secondary End2End Reward model with LLM-as-judge precision/recall rewards for security knowledge graph construction.
An offline task-bank reward construction method that can be built once and reused across multiple post-training runs, outperforming online end-to-end reward approaches.
idea_ch: 一种通过图提取和知识图谱条件文本修订创建可追踪文章-图对齐，从而从CTI文章构建安全领域监督数据的方法。
一种用于文档到图学习的脚本化任务库，结合四选多选问题和三元组级别正则匹配目标，提供稳定的任务特定奖励。
一种双模型架构，包括主要任务库奖励模型和辅助端到端奖励模型（使用LLM评判精确率/召回率奖励），用于安全知识图谱构建。
一种离线任务库奖励构建方法，可一次性构建并在多个后续训练运行中复用，优于在线端到端奖励方法。

title: Baba in Wonderland: Online Self-Supervised Dynamics Discovery for Executable World Models
summary: Executable world models can be read, edited, executed, and reused for planning, but only if the program captures the environment's transition law rather than semantic shortcuts in its surface vocabulary. We study online executable world-model learning under prior misalignment, where an agent must induce state-dependent dynamics from interaction evidence alone, without rule descriptions, reward signals, or trustworthy lexical priors. We introduce Alice, a closed-loop system that treats failed candidate updates as structural signal: when a candidate explains a new transition but loses previously explained ones, the preservation conflict reveals dynamics that the current program had conflated. Alice refines these conflicts into hypothesis classes that both provide compact, class-stratified preservation counterexamples for update and guide frontier exploration toward transitions that are novel and underrepresented with respect to the current program. We evaluate Alice on Baba in Wonderland, a prior-misaligned variant of Baba Is You that preserves simulator dynamics while replacing semantically meaningful rule-property labels with unrelated words. Experiments show that Alice substantially improves executable world-model learning under prior misalignment, and ablations show that both class refinement and class-aware exploration contribute.

AI.tldr: 提出Alice系统，在优先级不对齐条件下，通过将失败的候选更新视为结构信号，利用假设类提炼和类感知探索，实现可执行世界模型的在线学习。
AI.motivation: 解决在线可执行世界模型学习中的优先级不对齐问题：智能体无法依赖规则描述、奖励信号或可信的词汇先验，仅凭交互证据诱导状态依赖的动态学模型。
AI.method: Alice闭环系统：1) 将失败候选更新视为结构信号，识别保留冲突；2) 将冲突提炼为假设类，提供紧凑的分层保留反例；3) 类感知前沿探索，引导智能体关注对当前程序而言新颖且代表性不足的转换。
AI.result: 在Baba in Wonderland（Baba Is You的优先级不对齐变体）实验中，Alice显著提升了可执行世界模型学习效果，消融实验证实了类提炼和类感知探索两者的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 失败更新中的保留冲突可被利用为结构信号，以提炼假设类并指导探索，从而在无可靠语义先验条件下有效学习可执行世界模型。
idea_en: Closed-loop system that treats failed candidate updates as structural signals for executable world model learning
Method of using preservation conflicts to reveal dynamics conflated by current program
Technique of refining conflicts into hypothesis classes with class-stratified preservation counterexamples
Class-aware frontier exploration toward novel and underrepresented transitions
Online executable world-model learning without rule descriptions, reward signals, or trustworthy lexical priors
idea_ch: 将失败的候选更新视为结构信号进行可执行世界模型学习的闭环系统
利用保留冲突揭示当前程序混淆的动态学的方法
将冲突提炼为假设类并提供分层保留反例的技术
面向新颖和代表性不足转换的类感知前沿探索方法
无需规则描述、奖励信号或可信词汇先验的在线可执行世界模型学习方法

title: A Global-Local Graph Attention Network for Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting is a significant part of intelligent transportation systems. One of the critical challenges of traffic forecasting is to find spatio-temporal correlations. In recent years, graph convolutional networks and graph attention networks have replaced traditional statistical models to predict future traffic. However, it is complicated for both of them to allow vertices to have far different characters. To address this, we propose the Global-Local Graph Attention Network (GLGAT) with pairwise encoding and the event-based adjacency matrix. The GLGAT allows vertices to have a global attention matrix set for the whole graph and assigns local attention matrix sets to each vertex. Experiments on two real-world traffic datasets show that GLGAT can effectively capture spatio-temporal correlations and has competitive performance against other state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出全局-局部图注意力网络（GLGAT），通过成对编码和基于事件的邻接矩阵，解决图卷积/注意力网络中顶点特征差异难以表征的问题，在交通预测中有效捕获时空相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有图卷积网络和图注意力网络难以让顶点具有截然不同的特征，限制了交通预测中异质性节点的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出GLGAT，包含全局注意力矩阵（全图共享）和局部注意力矩阵（每个顶点独有），结合成对编码与基于事件的邻接矩阵来捕获时空相关性。
AI.result: 在两个真实交通数据集上，GLGAT有效捕获了时空相关性，性能优于多种现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: GLGAT通过全局-局部注意力机制解决了顶点异质性问题，为交通预测提供了一种新的有效方法。
idea_en: Global-Local Graph Attention Network (GLGAT) structure combining a global attention matrix set for the entire graph with local attention matrix sets assigned to each vertex, enabling modeling of vertices with vastly different characteristics.
Pairwise encoding mechanism integrated into graph attention to enhance representation of vertex-specific features in spatio-temporal forecasting.
Event-based adjacency matrix construction for capturing dynamic spatio-temporal correlations in traffic networks.
Dual-level attention architecture (global + local) that allows simultaneous modeling of shared patterns across the graph and individualized vertex behaviors.
idea_ch: 全局-局部图注意力网络（GLGAT）结构：为全图设置全局注意力矩阵集，同时为每个顶点分配局部注意力矩阵集，从而支持具有截然不同特征的顶点建模。
成对编码机制：将成对编码集成到图注意力中，增强交通预测中顶点特定特征的表示能力。
基于事件的邻接矩阵构建方法：用于捕获交通网络中动态的时空相关性。
双层注意力架构：结合全局注意力（全图共享模式）与局部注意力（个体化顶点行为），实现更精细的时空依赖性建模。

title: PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self-Play
summary: We introduce PopuLoRA, a population-based asymmetric self-play framework for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) post-training of LLMs. Teachers and students are specialised LoRA adapters on a shared frozen base: teachers propose problems, matched students solve them under a programmatic verifier, and cross-evaluation between sub-populations replaces the self-calibration that limits single-agent self-play. A family of LoRA weight-space evolution operators (mutations and crossovers that produce same-rank population members in seconds) serves as the replacement step of a population-based training loop at 7B scale. We instantiate PopuLoRA on top of Absolute Zero Reasoner and compare it against a per-adapter compute-matched single-agent baseline. Where the single agent self-calibrates to generating easy problems it can reliably solve, the population enters a co-evolutionary arms race: teachers produce increasingly complex problems, student solve rates oscillate, and problem-space coverage keeps expanding throughout training. Despite lower training-time reward, the population mean outperforms the baseline on three code benchmarks (HumanEval+, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench) and seven math benchmarks (AIME 24/25, AMC 23, MATH-500, Minerva, GSM8K, OlympiadBench), and even the weakest member of the population beats the baseline on aggregate.

AI.tldr: PopuLoRA是一个基于群体的非对称自博弈框架，用于LLM的RLVR后训练。教师和学生是共享冻结基座上的LoRA适配器，教师出题、学生解题，通过群体间的交叉评估替代单智能体的自校准，并利用LoRA权重空间演化算子实现高效群体更新。在7B规模上，群体进入共进化军备竞赛，教师生成更复杂问题，学生解决率波动，问题空间覆盖持续扩大，最终在多个代码和数学基准上超越单智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 解决单智能体自博弈（self-play）中模型会自校准到生成简单问题的问题，导致训练效果受限，希望通过群体共进化机制激发更复杂的推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 共享冻结基座模型上的多个LoRA适配器组成教师和学生群体；2) 教师提出题目，对应的学生解题并由程序化验证器评分；3) 子群体间交叉评估替代单智能体的自校准；4) 使用LoRA权重空间演化算子（变异和交叉）在数秒内生成同秩群体成员，作为群体训练循环的替换步骤。
AI.result: 在HumanEval+、MBPP+、LiveCodeBench三个代码基准，以及AIME 24/25、AMC 23、MATH-500、Minerva、GSM8K、OlympiadBench七个数学基准上，群体均值超越计算量匹配的单智能体基线，且群体中最弱的成员在总体上仍优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 群体共进化机制能够克服单智能体自校准的局限性，尽管训练期奖励较低，但问题空间覆盖持续扩大，最终在多个推理基准上取得更优性能。
idea_en: A population-based asymmetric self-play reinforcement learning framework using specialized LoRA adapters on a shared frozen base model, where teachers propose problems and students solve them under programmatic verifiers, enabling co-evolution without full model fine-tuning.

A LoRA weight-space evolution operator family (mutations and crossovers) that generates same-rank population members within seconds, serving as an efficient replacement step for population-based training of LLMs at 7B scale.

A cross-evaluation mechanism between sub-populations of LoRA adapters that replaces self-calibration in single-agent self-play, preventing the model from converging to generating easy problems it can reliably solve.

A co-evolutionary arms race induction method in RLVR post-training where teacher-student populations drive expanding problem-space coverage despite lower training-time reward, outperforming compute-matched single-agent baselines.
idea_ch: 一种基于群体的非对称自博弈强化学习框架，在共享冻结基座模型上使用专门的LoRA适配器，教师提出题目、学生在程序化验证器下解题，实现了无需全模型微调的共进化训练。
一种LoRA权重空间演化算子族（变异和交叉），可在数秒内生成同秩群体成员，作为7B规模LLM群体训练循环的高效替换步骤。
一种LoRA适配器子群体间的交叉评估机制，替代单智能体自博弈中的自校准过程，防止模型收敛到生成自己能稳定解决的简单问题。
一种RLVR后训练中的共进化军备竞赛诱导方法，通过教师-学生群体驱动问题空间覆盖持续扩展，尽管训练期奖励较低，但在计算量匹配的情况下仍优于单智能体基线。

title: Body-Grounded Perspective Formation and Conative Attunement in Artificial Agents
summary: This paper proposes a minimal architecture for body-grounded perspective formation in artificial agents. Extending prior work, the model introduces an interoceptive viability signal, a Fisher-style metric over fused exteroceptive-interoceptive states, and a conative alignment mechanism linking bodily tendency to action readiness. In a reward-free gridworld, conation converts learned bodily tendency into stable body-directed behavior, while body-to-perspective routing allows bodily perturbations to leave a recoverable geometric residue in the perspective latent. This study shows how minimal structural conditions for artificial subjectivity can be operationalized in the phenomenological sense, through the embodied organization of how a world is given to an agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于人工智能体身体基础视角形成的最小架构，通过内感受生存信号、Fisher度量融合外感受-内感受状态，以及意动对齐机制，实现了无奖励环境中的身体导向行为稳定性和视角几何残差恢复。
AI.motivation: 探索人工主体性在现象学意义上的最小结构条件，即如何通过具身组织实现世界向智能体的呈现方式。
AI.method: 提出包含三个核心模块的最小架构：(1)内感受生存信号（interoceptive viability signal）；(2)基于Fisher度量的外感受-内感受状态融合度量；(3)意动对齐机制（conative alignment），将身体倾向转化为行动准备状态。
AI.result: 在无奖励的网格世界中，意动机制将学习到的身体倾向转化为稳定的身体导向行为；身体到视角的路由使得身体扰动在视角潜空间中留下可恢复的几何残差。
AI.conclusion: 通过具身组织的特定方式（身体-视角路由、意动对齐等），可以在人工系统中实现现象学意义上的主观性最小条件。
idea_en: A method for body-grounded perspective formation in artificial agents using an interoceptive viability signal that measures internal state fitness
A Fisher-style metric system for fusing exteroceptive and interoceptive states into a unified representation space
A conative alignment mechanism that converts learned bodily tendencies into stable action readiness without external rewards
A body-to-perspective routing architecture that encodes bodily perturbations as recoverable geometric residuals in a perspective latent space
idea_ch: 一种基于内感受生存信号的人工智能体身体基础视角形成方法，通过测量内部状态适应性来引导行为
一种基于Fisher度量的外感受-内感受状态融合系统，将外部感知与内部状态统一到一个表征空间
一种无需外部奖励的意动对齐机制，将学习到的身体倾向转化为稳定的行动准备状态
一种身体到视角的路由架构，将身体扰动编码为视角潜空间中的可恢复几何残差

title: State Contamination in Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent state, including transcripts, summaries, retrieved context, and memory buffers, to support long-horizon interaction. This makes safety depend not only on individual model outputs, but also on what an agent stores and later reuses. We study a failure mode we call memory laundering: toxic or adversarial context can be compressed into memory summaries that no longer appear toxic under standard detectors, while still preserving hostile framing or conflict structure that influences future generations. Using paired counterfactual multi-agent rollouts, we show that toxic-origin memory summaries can remain below common toxicity thresholds while nevertheless increasing downstream toxicity relative to matched neutral baselines. To measure this hidden influence, we introduce the sub-threshold propagation gap (SPG), which quantifies downstream behavioral differences conditioned on memory states that a deployed monitor would classify as safe. Our experiments show that toxicity propagates through distinct state channels: raw transcript reuse drives overt downstream toxicity, while compressed memory carries hidden sub-threshold influence. We further find that mitigation depends critically on intervention placement. Sanitizing toxic state before summarization substantially reduces the hidden propagation gap, whereas cleaning only the completed summary can leave laundered influence intact. These results suggest that safety in memory-augmented agents should be treated as a state-control problem over evolving context, with sanitization applied before unsafe information is compressed into persistent memory.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM代理中的"记忆洗钱"漏洞：有毒或对抗性内容被压缩成记忆摘要后，可绕过毒性检测器，但仍能影响后续生成行为。作者提出"亚阈值传播差距"(SPG)量化该隐藏影响，并发现毒性通过原始转录(显性)和压缩记忆(隐性)两条通道传播。关键缓解手段是在摘要化之前对有毒状态进行消毒。
AI.motivation: LLM代理依赖持久状态(转录、摘要、检索上下文、记忆缓冲)支持长周期交互，导致安全性不仅取决于单次输出，还取决于代理存储和后续重用的内容。现有安全机制未考虑有毒内容被压缩后"洗钱"的风险。
AI.method: 使用配对反事实多智能体模拟：对比有毒来源记忆摘要与中性基线在下游行为中的差异。定义亚阈值传播差距(SPG)衡量在部署监控器判定为安全的记忆状态下，下游行为的差异。
AI.result: 1) 有毒来源的记忆摘要可低于常见毒性阈值但仍增加下游毒性；2) 原始转录复用导致显性毒性，压缩记忆携带隐性亚阈值影响；3) 在摘要化前消毒显著降低隐藏传播差距，摘要化后消毒效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 面向记忆增强型代理的安全应被视为对演化上下文的"状态控制"问题，在安全信息被压缩为持久记忆前实施消毒处理。
idea_en: A method for detecting memory laundering in LLM agents by computing the sub-threshold propagation gap (SPG) between paired counterfactual multi-agent rollouts with toxic-origin versus neutral memory summaries.
A safety system that sanitizes LLM agent memory state before summarization/compression, preventing toxic context from being laundered into apparently safe memory summaries.

A multi-channel toxicity propagation monitoring framework for memory-augmented agents that distinguishes between overt toxicity from raw transcript reuse and hidden sub-threshold influence from compressed memory.
A counterfactual rollout-based testing methodology for auditing LLM agent memory systems, using paired rollouts with toxic and neutral origin states to quantify hidden memory-borne risks.
idea_ch: 一种通过计算配对反事实多智能体模拟中亚阈值传播差距(SPG)来检测LLM代理记忆洗钱的方法
一种在摘要化/压缩之前对LLM代理记忆状态进行消毒的安全系统，防止有毒上下文被洗钱为表面上安全的记忆摘要
一种面向记忆增强型代理的多通道毒性传播监控框架，区分原始转录复用的显性毒性与压缩记忆携带的隐性亚阈值影响
一种基于反事实模拟的LLM代理记忆系统审计方法，通过配对模拟有毒与中性来源状态来量化隐藏的记忆传播风险

title: NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. Further, we provide a theoretical perspective showing why such modular textual computation is more parameter-efficient when tasks admit hierarchical decompositions. Experiments show that NeuroMAS improves significantly over both inference-time and trained multi-agent baselines. We further find that organizational scaling is path-dependent: larger systems can be challenging to train from scratch, but become feasible when grown progressively from smaller trained systems. These results suggest that learned neural multi-agent systems are a promising scaling axis for LLMs.

AI.tldr: NeuroMAS将多智能体语言系统构建为可训练、可扩展的类神经网络架构，以LLM作为节点、文本信号作为边，通过强化学习训练实现智能体的角色自由但结构感知的协作，显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体语言系统依赖手工设计的流程和预设的通信协议，缺乏可学习性和可扩展性，限制了LLM能力的发挥。
AI.method: 将多智能体系统建模为神经网络架构，LLM作为无角色但感知结构的节点，文本信号作为边；使用强化学习训练节点间的通信、专化和协调方式；支持通过深度、宽度、连接性和增长协议实现规模化。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，NeuroMAS显著优于推理时和训练过的多智能体基线；发现组织扩展存在路径依赖性，从小型系统渐进增长是可行策略。
AI.conclusion: 学习型神经多智能体系统是LLM有前景的扩展方向，将多智能体设计从工作流工程转向架构设计。
idea_en: A trainable multi-agent neural architecture where LLM agents serve as nodes with structure-aware but role-free design, enabling dynamic role specialization through reinforcement learning.
Progressive scaling method for multi-agent systems that grows larger architectures from smaller trained systems to overcome training difficulties.
Textual signal propagation mechanism in multi-agent systems that treats intermediate outputs as edges in a neural-network-like topology.
Theoretical framework proving modular textual computation achieves higher parameter efficiency for hierarchically decomposable tasks.
idea_ch: 一种可训练的多智能体神经架构，LLM作为结构感知但无固定角色的节点，通过强化学习实现动态角色专化
渐进式规模化方法：从小型训练好的系统逐步增长到大型系统，克服大规模多智能体系统训练困难

title: Multi-Paradigm Agent Interaction in Practice:A Systematic Analysis of Generator-Evaluator, ReAct Loop,and Adversarial Evaluation in the buddyMe Framework
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has produced diverse interaction paradigms, yet few production systems integrate multiple paradigms within a unified architecture. This paper presents a systematic analysis of three principal agent interaction paradigms, including Multi-Agent Orchestration (Generator-Evaluator), ReAct Tool-Use Loops, and Memory-Augmented Interaction, as implemented in buddyMe, an open-source multi-model agent programming framework. We formalize a five-stage processing pipeline: Requirement Pre-Review -> Task Decomposition -> ReAct Execution -> Real-Execution Verification -> Adversarial Evaluation Discussion, and establish a six-dimensional evaluation schema with weighted scoring. Through four empirical case studies drawn from real-world deployment logs covering museum guide generation, scheduled weather tasks, and comprehensive tour planning, we draw three key conclusions. First, Generator-Evaluator pre-review detects requirement omissions in 20 percent of complex tasks, with 80 percent tasks passing initial inspection. Second, the ReAct loop ensures stable subtask execution but leads to around 30 percent redundant tool invocations. Third, adversarial Evaluator-Defender discussions reach consensus within 2-3 rounds for nearly 70 percent of scenarios, functioning mainly for content refinement rather than logical reversal. We additionally provide three Mermaid-based architectural diagrams and conduct cross-paradigm comparisons with CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, MemGPT and A-Mem across six system dimensions. The research outcomes offer practical design guidelines for constructing stable and reliable multi-paradigm agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了三种智能体交互范式（多智能体编排、ReAct工具使用循环、记忆增强交互），并在buddyMe框架中实现了五阶段处理流水线和六维评估体系。通过四个真实案例研究（博物馆导览生成、定时天气任务、综合旅行规划），发现生成器-评估器预审可检测20%复杂任务的需求遗漏，ReAct循环导致约30%冗余工具调用，对抗性讨论在2-3轮内达成共识。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体产生了多种交互范式，但很少有生产系统在统一架构中集成多种范式，缺乏对多范式系统的系统分析和设计指南。
AI.method: 提出五阶段流水线：需求预审->任务分解->ReAct执行->真实执行验证->对抗性评估讨论；建立六维加权评分评估体系；在buddyMe框架中实现三种交互范式。
AI.result: 生成器-评估器预审检测20%复杂任务需求遗漏，80%任务通过初审；ReAct循环确保稳定子任务执行但导致约30%冗余工具调用；对抗性讨论在2-3轮内达成共识（约70%场景），主要用于内容优化而非逻辑反转。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果为构建稳定可靠的多范式智能体系统提供了实用设计指南。
idea_en: A multi-paradigm agent interaction framework integrating Generator-Evaluator orchestration, ReAct tool-use loops, and memory-augmented interaction within a unified architecture
A five-stage processing pipeline comprising Requirement Pre-Review, Task Decomposition, ReAct Execution, Real-Execution Verification, and Adversarial Evaluation Discussion for LLM agents
A six-dimensional weighted evaluation schema for comprehensively assessing multi-paradigm agent system performance
An adversarial Evaluator-Defender discussion mechanism that achieves consensus within 2-3 rounds for content refinement in multi-agent systems
A pre-review mechanism using Generator-Evaluator paradigm to detect requirement omissions in complex tasks before execution

title: Voices in the Loop: Mapping Participatory AI
comment: Accepted to The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25--28, 2026, Montreal, QC, Canada
summary: Participatory approaches to artificial intelligence are increasingly documented across public, civic, and humanitarian settings, but evidence about how participation is organized remains fragmented. This paper reports on the construction of an open repository and interactive atlas of participatory AI initiatives, using records harmonized from Maga~na and Shilton's Trustworthy AI corpus, and additional audited cases from research and practice. We contribute three elements. First, we specify a reproducible protocol for discovery, vetting, harmonization, geocoding, provenance tracking, and release-based publication of participatory AI records. Second, we report corpus-level patterns in geography, participation tiers, lifecycle loci, organizational form, verification status, and remaining documentation gaps. Documented initiatives remain concentrated in a small number of countries, while participation is most often coded at problem formulation, evaluation, and governance rather than model development or training. Third, we show how the atlas operationalizes a design and governance framework for participatory-by-default AI infrastructures through versioned releases, record-linked issue and annotation channels, schema feedback workflows, and redaction or restricted-disclosure requests. The atlas is intended to support comparative research, policy learning, and community scrutiny through a living inventory that can be updated, contested, and reused.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了参与式AI开放图谱（Atlas）的构建，包含可复现的记录协议、语料库模式分析，以及支持参与式AI基础设施的设计与治理框架。
AI.motivation: 参与式AI方法在公共、公民和人道主义场景中日益增多，但关于如何组织参与的证据仍然零散，缺乏系统化的记录和分析工具。
AI.method: 基于Magaña和Shilton的可信AI语料库及额外审计案例，构建开放存储库和交互式图谱，制定了可复现的发现、审核、统一化、地理编码、溯源追踪和发布协议。
AI.result: 语料库显示参与式AI倡议集中在少数国家，参与主要集中在问题制定、评估和治理环节，而非模型开发或训练；协议支持版本发布、记录关联的问题和注释渠道、模式反馈流程及删除/限制披露请求。
AI.conclusion: 该图谱作为可更新、可质疑、可复用的活库存，支持比较研究、政策学习和社区审查，为默认参与式AI基础设施提供设计与治理参考。

A design and governance framework for participatory-by-default AI infrastructures with versioned releases, record-linked issue/annotation channels, schema feedback workflows, and redaction/restricted-disclosure requests
An interactive atlas that operationalizes participatory AI as a living inventory that can be updated, contested, and reused for comparative research and policy learning

title: Sketch Then Paint: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) are powerful for image generation, but optimizing them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains a major challenge. One primary difficulty is that a single image can be generated through many different unmasking sequences, which makes calculating importance ratios often intractable. Additionally, existing methods tend to ignore the hierarchical generation process of dMLLMs, where early tokens define the global layout and later tokens focus on local details. By assigning uniform rewards to all tokens, these current methods fail to reflect the actual contribution of each token to the final image. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Token GRPO (HT-GRPO), which integrates this hierarchy directly into the policy optimization process. Our approach features a Sketch-Then-Paint training scheme that organizes updates into three distinct stages: global, structure, and refinement. We also use a prompt-conditioned estimator to calculate importance ratios starting from a fully masked state. Furthermore, we introduce a Hierarchical Credit Assignment mechanism that prioritizes key structural tokens to ensure accurate reward propagation. Experiments using two popular dMLLM backbones, MMaDA and Lumina-DiMOO, demonstrate that HT-GRPO achieves substantial gains on the GenEval and DPG benchmarks. Evaluations across six additional metrics confirm significant improvements in image quality, aesthetics, and human preference.

AI.tldr: HT-GRPO提出了一种分层策略优化方法，通过Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练方案和分层信用分配机制，解决扩散多模态大语言模型在强化学习优化中因不同掩码序列和层级生成过程导致的策略梯度计算困难问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型(dMLLMs)在图像生成方面表现出色，但通过强化学习(RL)优化它们仍然是一个重大挑战。主要困难在于：1）单张图像可通过多种不同的去掩码序列生成，导致重要性比率计算往往难以处理；2）现有方法忽略了dMLLMs的分层生成过程（早期token定义全局布局，后期token关注局部细节），对所有token分配均匀奖励，无法反映每个token对最终图像的实际贡献。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Token GRPO (HT-GRPO)，包括：1）Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练方案（全局、结构、细化）；2）基于提示条件的估计器，从完全掩码状态计算重要性比率；3）分层信用分配机制，优先处理关键结构token以确保准确的奖励传播。
AI.result: 在MMaDA和Lumina-DiMOO两种主流dMLLM骨干上，HT-GRPO在GenEval和DPG基准测试中取得了显著增益，在六项额外指标上证实了图像质量、美学质量和人类偏好的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分层生成结构直接整合到策略优化过程中，HT-GRPO有效解决了dMLLMs在RL优化中的关键难题，为扩散多模态大语言模型的强化学习训练提供了新的有效范式。
idea_en: Hierarchical Token GRPO (HT-GRPO) method for reinforcement learning optimization of diffusion multi-modal large language models
Sketch-Then-Paint three-stage training scheme (global, structure, refinement) for hierarchical policy optimization
Prompt-conditioned importance ratio estimator starting from fully masked state
Hierarchical Credit Assignment mechanism prioritizing key structural tokens for reward propagation
idea_ch: 分层Token GRPO (HT-GRPO) 方法：一种针对扩散多模态大语言模型的强化学习优化方法，将分层生成结构直接整合到策略优化过程中
Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练方案：将模型训练组织为全局、结构和细化三个阶段的分层策略优化方案
基于提示条件的从完全掩码状态开始的重要性比率估计器：从完全掩码状态出发计算重要性比率的新型估计方法
分层信用分配机制：优先处理关键结构token以确保准确奖励传播的信用分配机制

title: Artificial Adaptive Intelligence: The Missing Stage Between Narrow and General Intelligence
summary: Between the narrow systems we deploy and the general intelligence we speculate about lies an entire regime of machine behavior that has never received its own name. This monograph argues that this regime is not empty: it is where meta-learning, neural architecture search, AutoML, continual learning, evolutionary computation, and physics-informed modeling have quietly converged on a common principle, namely the steady removal of the human from the loop of parameter specification. We name this regime Artificial Adaptive Intelligence (AAI) and define it operationally: a system exhibits AAI to the extent that it requires no human-specified tunable hyperparameters while maintaining competitive performance across a diverse distribution of tasks. To make the definition quantitative, we introduce an adaptivity index that measures progress along an axis orthogonal to scale, combining the fraction of hyperparameters absorbed by the system with the performance ratio against a task-specialized baseline. We develop the principle of parametric minimality and ground it in the minimum description length framework, showing that the appropriate hyperparameter count is data-determined rather than designer-determined. We then organize the field around three pathways to minimality: data- and task-aware configuration, structural and evolutionary morphing, and in-training self-adaptation. We analyze their stability, convergence, and governance implications, and illustrate them through case studies spanning aerospace design, financial regime detection, turbulence modeling, ecological dynamics, and vision-language systems. The thesis is that the path from ANI to AGI passes through AAI, and that naming this stage changes what we measure, what we build, and what we call a success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人工自适应智能(AAI)"概念，指代介于窄人工智能与通用人工智能之间的中间地带，其核心原则是将人类逐步从参数指定循环中移除，并通过自适应指数进行量化评估。
AI.motivation: 窄AI系统与通用AI之间存在未被命名的中间机器行为领域，该领域在元学习、神经架构搜索、AutoML、持续学习、进化计算和物理信息建模等多个方向中已悄然收敛于共同原则，但缺乏统一的理论框架和命名。
AI.method: 提出AAI的操作性定义：系统无需人工指定可调超参数，同时在多样化任务分布上保持竞争性能。引入自适应指数，结合系统吸收的超参数比例与相对于任务专化基线的性能比。建立参数最小化原则，基于最小描述长度框架，论证超参数数量应由数据决定而非设计者决定。将领域组织为三条路径：数据与任务感知配置、结构与进化变体、训练中自适应性。
AI.result: 建立了AAI的理论框架，通过航空航天设计、金融制度检测、湍流建模、生态动力学和视觉-语言系统等案例研究验证了三条路径的稳定性、收敛性和治理含义。
AI.conclusion: 从ANI到AGI的路径必然经过AAI，命名这一阶段将改变我们所测量、所构建和所称为成功的东西。
idea_en: An adaptivity index measuring machine intelligence progress orthogonal to model scale, combining hyperparameter absorption ratio and performance ratio against task-specialized baselines.
A parametric minimality principle grounded in minimum description length (MDL) framework where hyperparameter count is data-determined rather than designer-determined.
A system that autonomously absorbs hyperparameters during operation across three pathways: data/task-aware configuration, structural/evolutionary morphing, and in-training self-adaptation.

A unified framework integrating meta-learning, neural architecture search, AutoML, continual learning, evolutionary computation, and physics-informed modeling under a common principle of human removal from parameter specification.
idea_ch: 一种正交于模型规模的自适应指数，结合超参数吸收率与相对于任务专化基线的性能比，用于量化机器智能的自适应程度。
基于最小描述长度(MDL)框架的参数最小化原则，使超参数数量由数据本身决定而非设计者决定。
一种通过数据/任务感知配置、结构/进化变体和训练中自适应三条路径，在运行过程中自主吸收超参数的系统。
将元学习、神经架构搜索、AutoML、持续学习、进化计算和物理信息建模统一于人类从参数指定中逐步退出的共同原则下的框架。

title: Learning to Learn from Multimodal Experience
summary: Experience-driven learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling agents to improve from interaction trajectories by accumulating and reusing past experience. However, existing approaches are predominantly developed in textual settings and rely on manually designed memory schemas, limiting their applicability to multimodal environments. In real-world scenarios, experience is inherently multimodal, involving heterogeneous signals across perception, reasoning, and action, which makes effective memory design significantly more challenging. In particular, the optimal way to structure and utilize multimodal experience is highly task-dependent and evolves over time, rendering fixed memory designs insufficient. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, learning to learn from multimodal experience, which shifts memory design from a predefined component to an adaptive and learnable process. Our framework enables agents to dynamically construct, organize, and utilize memory based on task requirements and interaction history, effectively learning how to structure experience for improved performance. Experiments demonstrate that adaptive memory design substantially enhances agent performance and generalization across multimodal tasks, highlighting the critical role of learning memory mechanisms in experience-driven learning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的学习范式——从多模态经验中学习学习，将记忆设计从预定义组件转变为自适应、可学习的过程，使智能体能够根据任务需求和交互历史动态构建、组织和利用记忆，从而提升多模态任务性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有经验驱动学习方法主要在纯文本环境下开发，依赖人工设计的记忆模式，无法适用于多模态环境。在多模态真实场景中，经验涉及感知、推理和行动的异构信号，最优的记忆结构高度依赖任务且随时间动态变化，固定记忆设计存在根本性局限。
AI.method: 提出"从多模态经验中学习学习"的新范式，将记忆设计从预定义组件转变为自适应、可学习的过程。智能体基于任务需求和交互历史动态构建、组织和利用记忆，学习如何结构化经验以提升性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，自适应记忆设计在多模态任务中显著提升了智能体的性能和泛化能力，验证了学习记忆机制在经验驱动学习中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆设计从静态预定义转变为动态可学习过程，是提升多模态经验驱动学习效果的有效途径，突出了学习记忆机制本身的重要性。
idea_en: A method for dynamically constructing memory structures in real-time based on task requirements and multimodal interaction history, where the memory organization schema is learned rather than manually predefined.
A framework for adaptive multimodal memory organization that learns to categorize and link heterogeneous experience signals across perception, reasoning, and action modalities.
A learnable memory utilization mechanism that automatically determines when and how to retrieve and compose past multimodal experiences for current task execution.
A system for task-dependent memory evolution that automatically adjusts memory schemas over time as interaction history accumulates and task demands shift.
idea_ch: 一种基于任务需求和多模态交互历史实时动态构建记忆结构的方法，记忆组织模式通过学习获得而非人工预定义。
一种自适应多模态记忆组织框架，学习对感知、推理、行动等异构经验信号进行分类和关联。
一种可学习的记忆利用机制，自动确定何时以及如何检索和组合过去的多模态经验以执行当前任务。
一种任务依赖的记忆进化系统，随交互历史积累和任务需求变化自动调整记忆模式。

title: Reasoning Can Be Restored by Correcting a Few Decision Tokens
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) substantially outperform their base LLM counterparts on challenging reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains poorly understood where base models go wrong during token-by-token generation and how to narrow this gap efficiently. We study the base-reasoning gap through quantifying token-level distributional disagreement between a base model and a stronger reasoning model using likelihood-based divergences. Across benchmarks, we find that the reasoning advantage is highly sparse and concentrates on a small set of early, planning-related decision tokens. For instance, on Qwen3-0.6B, only ~8% of generated tokens account for the salient disagreement, and these tokens concentrate early in the response, are strongly enriched in planning-related decisions (17x), and coincide with high base-model uncertainty -- suggesting that base models fail mainly at early planning points that steer the subsequent reasoning trajectory. Building on these findings, we propose disagreement-guided token intervention, a simple inference-time delegation scheme that performs a one-token takeover by the reasoning model only at high-disagreement positions and immediately switches back to the base model. With a small intervention budget, this sparse delegation substantially recovers and can even surpass the performance of a same-size reasoning model on challenging reasoning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AlphaLab-USTC/RRTokenIntervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型推理模型(LRM)与基础LLM在逐token生成时的差异，发现推理优势高度稀疏且集中在早期规划相关的决策token上。基于此提出了一种分歧引导的token干预方法，仅在高分歧位置用推理模型接管一个token，即可在极小干预预算下恢复甚至超越同规模推理模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 理解基础模型在逐token生成过程中哪里出错，以及如何高效地缩小基础模型与更强推理模型之间的性能差距。
AI.method: 使用基于似然度的散度量化基础模型与推理模型在token级别的分布差异，发现分歧高度集中在早期规划token；提出分歧引导的token干预方法，仅在分歧大的位置由推理模型接管一个token后立即切回基础模型。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B上，仅约8%的生成token贡献了显著分歧，这些token集中在响应早期，与规划决策相关的token富集17倍。稀疏委托方法在极小干预预算下恢复甚至超越同规模推理模型的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型失败主要在早期规划节点，通过在关键分歧位置进行稀疏的推理模型token干预，可以高效地弥合基础-推理模型差距。
idea_en: A disagreement-guided token intervention method that identifies high-disagreement positions between base and reasoning models using likelihood-based divergences and performs one-token takeover by a stronger reasoning model only at those positions.

A sparse delegation scheme for inference-time reasoning enhancement where a base model's generation is interrupted at early planning tokens and a single token is replaced by a reasoning model's output before switching back.
A token-level distributional disagreement quantification technique using likelihood-based divergences to identify critical planning decision points in autoregressive generation.

An efficient inference-time architecture that combines a lightweight base model with a larger reasoning model through token-level dynamic routing, activating the reasoning model only at high-uncertainty planning positions.
idea_ch: 一种基于分歧引导的token干预方法，利用似然度散度量化基础模型与推理模型在token级别的分布差异，仅在高分歧位置由推理模型接管一个token。
一种稀疏委托的推理增强方案，在基础模型生成的早期规划token处中断生成，用推理模型的输出替换单个token后立即切回基础模型。
一种基于似然度散度的token级分布差异量化技术，用于识别自回归生成中关键的规划决策点。
一种高效的推理时架构，通过token级动态路由将轻量级基础模型与推理模型结合，仅在高度不确定的规划位置激活推理模型。

title: Virtual Nodes Guided Dynamic Graph Neural Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
comment: The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026
summary: Multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is crucial for brain tumor segmentation, with many methods leveraging its four key modalities to capture complementary information for effective sub-region analysis. However, the absence of several modalities is very common in practice, leading to severe performance degradation in existing full-modality segmentation methods. Limited by the structured data model, recent works often adopt a multi-stage training strategy for full-modality and missing-modality scenarios, which increases training costs and inadequately addresses the interference of miss. In this work, we propose a graph-based one-stage framework for robust brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities. Specifically, we introduce modality-specific virtual nodes that serve as supplementary information sources to compensate for missing modalities. To enhance model robustness against arbitrary modality combinations, we leverage the inherent flexibility of graph networks to devise a dynamic connection strategy. This mechanism dynamically adjusts the adjacency matrix based on modality availability, preserving beneficial information flow while mitigating interference effects caused by missing modalities. Furthermore, we enhance the graph network through heterogeneous weight matrices, enhancing its adaptability to multimodal scenarios. Extensive experiments on the BRATS-2018 and BRATS-2020 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on almost all subsets of incomplete modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图的单阶段框架，用于解决脑肿瘤分割中多模态MRI缺失问题。通过引入模态特定虚拟节点作为补充信息源，并利用动态连接策略和异构权重矩阵增强图网络，实现对任意缺失模态组合的鲁棒分割，在BRATS数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态MRI对脑肿瘤分割至关重要，但临床实践中常出现模态缺失，导致现有全模态分割方法性能严重下降。当前方法多采用多阶段训练策略，训练成本高且未能充分处理缺失模态的干扰问题。
AI.method: 1) 引入模态特定虚拟节点作为补充信息源补偿缺失模态；2) 利用图网络的灵活性设计动态连接策略，根据模态可用性动态调整邻接矩阵，保持有益信息流并减轻缺失模态的干扰效应；3) 通过异构权重矩阵增强图网络对多模态场景的适应性。
AI.result: 在BRATS-2018和BRATS-2020数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在几乎所有不完整模态子集上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于图的单阶段框架有效解决了多模态MRI分割中的模态缺失问题，通过虚拟节点和动态连接策略实现了对任意模态组合的鲁棒性，为临床实际应用提供了可行方案。
idea_en: A graph-based one-stage framework for brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities, using modality-specific virtual nodes as supplementary information sources to compensate for absent modalities.

A dynamic connection strategy for graph networks that adjusts the adjacency matrix based on modality availability, preserving beneficial information flow while mitigating interference from missing modalities.
Heterogeneous weight matrices for graph networks to enhance adaptability to multimodal scenarios with varying modality availability.
A method for robust arbitrary modality combination processing in medical image segmentation using dynamically adjustable graph structures.
idea_ch: 一种基于图的单阶段脑肿瘤分割框架，利用模态特定虚拟节点作为补充信息源来补偿缺失模态
一种图网络的动态连接策略，根据模态可用性动态调整邻接矩阵，在保持有益信息流的同时减轻缺失模态的干扰效应
