混合AI+人类在环可持续性优化框架：联合优化文档处理精度、人力缩减与碳排放、能耗、水耗等环境指标的创新方法

title: From Imitation to Interaction: Mastering Game of Schnapsen with Shallow Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper investigates whether shallow neural network agents can master the card game Schnapsen and challenge a strong search-based baseline, RdeepBot, which uses Monte Carlo sampling and lookahead search. Guided by a progressively more complex experimental design, we first evaluate a supervised learning agent (MLPBot) trained on replay data and then a reinforcement learning agent (RLBot) with the same shallow architecture trained through asynchronous Monte Carlo updates and experience replay. The results show that supervised imitation does not generalize well enough to defeat strong RdeepBot opponents, whereas reinforcement learning produces substantially stronger agents. In the setting that focuses on the depth parameter of RdeepBot, the best performance is achieved when the learned value function is combined with deeper lookahead during gameplay, allowing RLBot to achieve statistically significant higher winning rates against the strongest evaluated RdeepBot baseline. In the sample-based setting, the gains are more conditional: the strongest performance appears at a relatively lower training num_samples parameter rather than increasing uniformly with stronger sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了浅层神经网络代理能否掌握纸牌游戏Schnapsen并挑战基于搜索的强基线RdeepBot。结果表明：监督模仿学习泛化能力不足，无法击败强对手；强化学习（RL）结合异步蒙特卡洛更新和经验回放，能产生更强的代理。当RL学习到的价值函数与更深层前瞻搜索结合时，达到最佳性能；在基于样本的设置中，最强性能出现在相对较低的训练样本参数下。
AI.motivation: 探究浅层神经网络代理在复杂纸牌游戏Schnapsen中能否掌握策略并挑战依赖蒙特卡洛采样和前瞻搜索的强基线模型RdeepBot，比较监督学习与强化学习两种方法的有效性。
AI.method: 设计渐进复杂的实验：1）监督学习代理MLPBot，基于回放数据进行训练；2）强化学习代理RLBot，采用异步蒙特卡洛更新和经验回放，使用相同的浅层网络架构。在两个不同设置（深度参数变化和样本参数变化）下与RdeepBot基线进行对比。
AI.result: 监督模仿学习泛化不足，无法击败强RdeepBot对手；强化学习显著更强。在深度参数设置中，学习到的价值函数与更深层前瞻搜索结合时，RLBot对最强RdeepBot基线取得统计显著的高胜率。在样本设置中，最强性能出现在相对较低的训练样本参数下。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习结合浅层神经网络在Schnapsen游戏中可以挑战甚至超越基于强搜索的基线模型，但性能提升是有条件的，取决于前瞻深度和样本参数的合理配置。
idea_en: A shallow neural network agent trained with asynchronous Monte Carlo updates and experience replay for imperfect-information card games, combining learned value functions with variable-depth lookahead search during gameplay
A hybrid reinforcement learning architecture where a value network guides Monte Carlo tree search depth adaptation in real-time based on game state complexity
An adaptive training parameter mechanism for sample-based reinforcement learning that identifies optimal sampling density rather than uniformly increasing samples
idea_ch: 一种结合异步蒙特卡洛更新和经验回放的浅层神经网络代理方法，用于不完美信息纸牌游戏，在游戏过程中将学习到的价值函数与可变深度前瞻搜索相结合
一种混合强化学习架构，其中价值网络根据游戏状态复杂度实时指导蒙特卡洛树搜索深度的自适应调整
一种基于样本的强化学习自适应训练参数机制，能够识别最优采样密度而无需均匀增加样本量

title: Responsible Agentic AI Requires Explicit Provenance
summary: Agentic AI is rapidly proliferating across diverse real-world domains such as software engineering, yet public trust has not kept pace. The central reason is that responsibility, despite being widely discussed, remains a subjective and unenforced concept, as no current agentic framework produces the quantifiable, traceable, and interventionable provenance needed to assign it when harm emerges from compositions no single party designed. We position that what is missing is not better benchmark-level evaluation but $\textbf{explicit provenance}$ across the full agentic lifecycle, which is the only viable basis for making responsibility computable and actionable. We advance this agenda along four axes: establishing $\textit{why}$ such provenance is a structural necessity by identifying responsibility gaps across sociotechnical dimensions, formalizing $\textit{what}$ it must encode through a causal attribution function and responsibility tensor, discussing $\textit{how}$ it can be made computable across four lifecycle layers with preliminary experiments showing that provenance is estimable and interveneable online before irreversible harm accumulates, and examining $\textit{who}$ bears responsibility through a concrete agentic incident. Explicit provenance is not a discretionary refinement but the necessary condition for responsible agentic AI, and no stakeholder across its ecosystem can afford to treat it as optional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，代理式AI（Agentic AI）缺乏显式溯源（explicit provenance）是公众信任不足的核心原因，并论证了通过因果归责函数、责任张量及生命周期可计算溯源是实现责任可量化、可追溯、可干预的必要条件。
AI.motivation: 当前代理式AI快速普及，但公众信任滞后。责任概念虽然被广泛讨论，却仍为主观且不可执行，现有框架无法在多方组合系统中产生可量化、可追溯、可干预的溯源信息，导致损害发生时无法分配责任。
AI.method: 沿四个维度展开：(1) 通过社会技术维度识别责任缺口，论证溯源的结构必要性；(2) 通过因果归责函数和责任张量形式化溯源应编码的内容；(3) 在四层生命周期中讨论如何实现可计算溯源，并通过初步实验证明溯源可在不可逆损害累积前进行在线估计和干预；(4) 通过具体代理事故案例考察谁承担责任。
AI.result: 初步实验表明，溯源是可估计的，并可在不可逆损害累积前进行在线干预。显式溯源是负责任代理式AI的必要条件，生态系统中的所有利益相关者不能将其视为可选。
AI.conclusion: 显式溯源不是可选的精细化改进，而是负责任代理式AI的必要条件。没有它，责任无法被计算化和可执行化，信任无法建立。
idea_en: A method for establishing explicit provenance across the full agentic AI lifecycle by encoding causal attribution functions and responsibility tensors, enabling quantifiable and traceable responsibility assignment in multi-agent compositions.
A system for real-time online estimation and intervention of agentic AI provenance before irreversible harm accumulates, using lifecycle-layer-aware provenance tracking.
A responsibility gap identification framework across sociotechnical dimensions for agentic AI systems, providing structural necessity analysis for provenance requirements.
A causal attribution function and responsibility tensor formalism that makes responsibility computable and actionable in agentic AI ecosystems.
idea_ch: 一种跨完整代理式AI生命周期建立显式溯源的方法，通过编码因果归责函数和责任张量，实现多代理组合系统中可量化、可追溯的责任分配。
一种在不可逆损害累积前对代理式AI溯源进行实时在线估计和干预的系统，采用生命周期层感知的溯源追踪技术。
一种跨社会技术维度的代理式AI责任缺口识别框架，为溯源需求提供结构性必要性分析。
一种因果归责函数与责任张量的形式化方法，使代理式AI生态系统中的责任变得可计算和可执行。

title: CAREBench: Evaluating LLMs' Emotion Understanding by Assessing Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning
summary: Emotion understanding is a core capability for LLMs to interact effectively with humans, yet existing evaluation paradigms rely on discrete emotion label prediction and fail to capture the cognitive processes underlying emotion generation. Grounded in appraisal theory, we introduce CAREBench, the first benchmark with complete inferential chain annotations from both first- and third-person perspectives on real-world narratives, spanning appraisal reasoning, appraisal ratings, and multi-label emotion annotation. We propose a process-level evaluation framework and conduct systematic experiments across six LLMs organized around four research questions. We find that stronger models match or surpass human observers on certain tasks, yet fall short on appraisal reasoning and positive emotion recognition; performance across chain steps and sensitivity to appraisal interventions exhibit dissociations across models; and current models have not internalized the mechanisms needed to capture human subjective heterogeneity. These findings suggest that downstream emotion prediction metrics may overestimate LLMs' true emotion understanding, and CAREBench provides a foundation for more diagnostically informative evaluation of LLMs' affective cognitive capabilities.

AI.tldr: CAREBench是基于评价理论的情感理解基准，通过完整的推理链标注（评价推理、评价评分、多标签情感）从第一和第三人称视角评估LLM的情感认知能力，发现强模型在某些任务上达到或超越人类，但在评价推理和积极情感识别上存在不足，且模型对主观异质性的捕捉有限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM情感理解评估仅依赖离散情感标签预测，无法捕捉情感生成背后的认知过程，缺乏基于认知理论的过程级评估框架。
AI.method: 基于评价理论，构建CAREBench基准，包含从第一/第三人称视角对真实世界叙事的完整推理链标注（评价推理、评价评分、多标签情感注释），并提出过程级评估框架，在六个LLM上进行系统实验。
AI.result: 强模型在某些任务上匹配或超越人类观察者，但在评价推理和积极情感识别上表现不足；模型在推理链各步骤的表现和对评价干预的敏感性存在解离；当前模型未能内化捕捉人类主观异质性的机制。
AI.conclusion: 下游情感预测指标可能高估LLM的真实情感理解能力，CAREBench为LLM情感认知能力提供了更具诊断性的评估基础。
idea_en: A process-level evaluation framework for LLM emotion understanding based on appraisal theory, using complete inferential chain annotations (appraisal reasoning, appraisal ratings, multi-label emotion) from first- and third-person perspectives.
A benchmark (CAREBench) that provides structured appraisal reasoning annotations on real-world narratives, enabling diagnostic evaluation of LLMs' cognitive processes underlying emotion generation.
A method for evaluating LLM sensitivity to appraisal interventions, revealing dissociations across model performances in different steps of the emotion inference chain.

A multi-perspective (first-person and third-person) annotation schema that captures subjective heterogeneity in emotion understanding, enabling assessment of whether LLMs internalize mechanisms for human subjective variability.
idea_ch: 一种基于评价理论的过程级LLM情感理解评估框架，利用来自第一人称和第三人称视角的完整推理链标注（评价推理、评价评分、多标签情感）进行诊断性评估。
CAREBench基准：在真实世界叙事上提供结构化的评价推理标注，使LLM情感生成背后的认知过程可被逐环节诊断。
一种评估LLM对评价干预敏感性的方法，能够揭示模型在情感推理链不同步骤上的表现解离现象。
一种多视角（第一人称和第三人称）标注方案，捕捉情感理解中的主观异质性，用于评估LLM是否内化了处理人类主观变异性的机制。

title: ChemVA: Advancing Large Language Models on Chemical Reaction Diagrams Understanding
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized scientific text processing, they exhibit a significant capability gap when interpreting chemical reaction diagrams. We identify two fundamental bottlenecks restricting current systems: a Visual Deficit, where generic vision encoders struggle to resolve the strict topological connectivity of dense molecular graphs, and a Semantic Disconnect, where standard linear strings, such as SMILES, fail to effectively activate the model's latent chemical reasoning. To bridge these gaps, we propose the Chemical Visual Activation (ChemVA) framework, which employs a Visual Anchor mechanism to ground functional groups via hybrid-granularity detection, followed by a semantic alignment approach that translates visual features into entity names to maximize knowledge activation in LLMs. We evaluate our approach on OCRD-Bench, a newly constructed dataset featuring dense visual-semantic contexts and comprehensive reaction coverage to evaluate the full spectrum from recognition to reasoning. Extensive experiments on OCRD-Bench demonstrate that ChemVA achieves 92.0% structural recognition accuracy. By bridging visual and semantic bottlenecks, our framework delivers a consistent performance gain of approximately 20 percentage points across 9 diverse LLMs, enabling open-weight models to rival proprietary SOTA systems in complex chemical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ChemVA框架，通过视觉锚点机制和语义对齐方法，弥补大语言模型在化学反应图解译中的视觉缺陷和语义断层，在OCRD-Bench数据集上实现92.0%结构识别准确率，并在9种大语言模型上取得约20个百分点的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理化学反应图时存在两大瓶颈：一是通用视觉编码器难以解析密集分子图的严格拓扑连接性（视觉缺陷），二是标准线性字符串（如SMILES）无法有效激活模型潜在的化学推理能力（语义断层）。
AI.method: 提出ChemVA框架，包含：(1) Visual Anchor机制，通过混合粒度检测定位功能基团；(2) 语义对齐方法，将视觉特征转化为实体名称，最大化LLM知识激活。
AI.result: 在OCRD-Bench数据集上结构识别准确率达92.0%；在9种不同LLM上取得约20个百分点的持续性能提升，使开源模型在复杂化学推理任务中媲美专有SOTA系统。
AI.conclusion: ChemVA框架有效弥合了视觉和语义瓶颈，显著提升了LLM在化学反应图解译方面的能力。
idea_en: A Visual Anchor mechanism that grounds functional groups via hybrid-granularity detection for chemical reaction diagram interpretation.
A semantic alignment approach that translates visual features of molecular structures into entity names to activate latent chemical reasoning in LLMs.
A hybrid-granularity detection method that combines coarse and fine-grained visual analysis to resolve topological connectivity in dense molecular graphs.
OCRD-Bench: a comprehensive dataset featuring dense visual-semantic contexts and full-spectrum reaction coverage for evaluating chemical diagram recognition and reasoning.
A framework that bridges the visual deficit and semantic disconnect in LLMs for chemical diagram understanding, achieving consistent ~20% performance gain across diverse LLMs.
idea_ch: 基于混合粒度检测的视觉锚点机制，用于在化学反应图中定位功能基团并建立视觉锚定。
将分子结构视觉特征转化为实体名称的语义对齐方法，以最大化激活大语言模型的化学推理知识。
结合粗粒度和细粒度视觉分析的混合粒度检测方法，用于解析密集分子图中的严格拓扑连接性。
OCRD-Bench综合数据集：包含密集视觉-语义上下文和全面反应覆盖，用于评估化学图解译全链条（从识别到推理）。
弥合大语言模型在化学图解译中视觉缺陷和语义断层的统一框架，可在多种LLM上稳定提升约20个百分点的性能。

title: Towards Robust Argumentative Essay Understanding via TIDE: An Interactive Framework with Trial and Debate
summary: Argumentative essays serve as a vital medium for assessing critical thinking and reasoning skills, yet there is limited works on accurately understanding and evaluating such texts via prompt. In this work, we propose TIDE, a novel framework designed to improve criteria-based prompt optimization for argument-related tasks by integrating TrIal and DEbate mechanism. Our method addresses key limitations of criteria-based prompt optimizing by mitigating the influence of noisy training data and enhancing optimization stability. We evaluate TIDE on three core tasks: Automated Essay Scoring, Argument Component Detection, and Argument Relation Identification. Results demonstrate that our framework improves performance across tasks. These findings underscore the potential of combining prompt-based methods for advanced argument understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出了TIDE框架，通过引入"试炼与辩论"机制来优化基于标准的提示词优化方法，提升议论文理解与评估任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的议论文理解与评估方法在通过提示词准确理解和评估议论文方面存在不足，尤其是基于标准的提示词优化方法受到噪声训练数据和不稳定优化的限制。
AI.method: 提出TIDE框架，集成Trial and Debate机制，通过对抗噪声数据和增强优化稳定性来改进基于标准的提示词优化。
AI.result: 在自动作文评分、论元成分检测和论元关系识别三个核心任务上均取得了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: TIDE框架有效提升了议论文理解任务的性能，展示了将基于提示的方法与先进机制结合用于高级论证理解的潜力。
idea_en: A prompt optimization framework integrating a Trial-and-Debate mechanism that iteratively refines criteria-based prompts for argumentative text analysis, reducing sensitivity to noisy training data.
A method for automated essay scoring that uses debate-style adversarial prompt optimization to improve scoring accuracy and robustness.
An argument component detection technique employing a trial-based prompt selection strategy to filter out low-quality prompts and enhance detection stability.
A system for argument relation identification that leverages multi-agent debate mechanisms within prompt engineering to achieve more reliable relation classification.
idea_ch: 一种融合试炼与辩论机制的提示词优化框架，通过迭代优化基于标准的提示词来分析议论文本，降低对噪声训练数据的敏感性。
一种使用辩论式对抗提示优化的自动作文评分方法，提高评分准确性和鲁棒性。
一种采用基于试炼的提示词选择策略的论元成分检测技术，过滤低质量提示词并增强检测稳定性。
一种利用提示工程中多智能体辩论机制的论元关系识别系统，实现更可靠的论元关系分类。

title: CatalyticMLLM: A Graph-Text Multimodal Large Language Model for Catalytic Materials
summary:
Property prediction and inverse structural design of catalytic materials are typically modeled as two independent tasks: the former predicts target properties from given structures, whereas the latter generates candidate structures according to desired properties. Although the decoupled paradigm facilitates the implementation of a ``generation--evaluation--screening'' workflow, the inconsistency between the generative model and the property prediction model in terms of representation spaces and training objectives can readily introduce data distribution shifts and evaluator bias, thereby limiting the stability of closed-loop optimization.
  In this work, we propose QE-Catalytic-V2, a unified graph--text multimodal large language model for catalytic materials, which integrates property prediction and inverse design within the same model and shared representation space. Under this unified framework, QE-Catalytic-V2 can not only perform reliable property prediction by leveraging three-dimensional structures and textual information, but also generate and screen physically feasible CIF candidates conditioned on target properties, thereby forming a closed-loop optimization workflow of ``inverse design--prediction--screening--redesign.'' Experimental results demonstrate that this unified paradigm outperforms decoupled baselines on both catalytic relaxed-energy prediction and inverse design tasks, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling property prediction and structure generation within a single multimodal model.

AI.tldr: 提出统一图文多模态大模型QE-Catalytic-V2，将催化材料的性质预测与逆向结构设计整合在同一模型和共享表征空间中，形成"逆向设计-预测-筛选-再设计"闭环优化流程，优于传统解耦范式。
AI.motivation: 传统催化材料研究中，性质预测与逆向结构设计被建模为两个独立任务，生成模型与预测模型在表征空间和训练目标上存在不一致，导致数据分布偏移和评估偏差，限制了闭环优化的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出QE-Catalytic-V2，一个统一图-文本多模态大语言模型，将性质预测和逆向设计整合在同一模型和共享表征空间中。利用三维结构和文本信息进行可靠性质预测，同时基于目标性质生成并筛选物理可行的CIF候选结构。
AI.result: 在催化松弛能预测和逆向设计任务上，统一范式优于解耦基线方法，验证了在多模态模型中联合建模性质预测和结构生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一模型框架能够消除生成模型与预测模型之间的表征空间和训练目标不一致问题，实现更稳定的闭环优化，为催化材料设计提供新范式。
idea_en: A unified multimodal large language model that integrates both property prediction and inverse structural design of catalytic materials within the same model and shared representation space, using graph and text modalities.
A closed-loop optimization workflow for catalytic materials that performs iterative inverse design, property prediction, screening, and redesign without decoupling generation and evaluation models.
A framework that generates physically feasible CIF (Crystallographic Information File) candidates conditioned on target catalytic properties using a single multimodal model.
A method to eliminate data distribution shift and evaluator bias in catalytic materials design by sharing representation space between generation and prediction tasks.
A graph-text multimodal model that leverages 3D structural information and textual descriptions simultaneously for catalytic relaxed-energy prediction.
idea_ch: 一种将催化材料的性质预测与逆向结构设计整合在同一模型和共享表征空间中的统一图文多模态大语言模型。
一种催化材料闭环优化工作流，无需解耦生成模型与评估模型即可实现迭代式逆向设计、性质预测、筛选和再设计。
一种基于目标催化性质条件，使用单一多模态模型生成物理可行的CIF晶体结构文件的框架。
一种通过共享生成任务与预测任务的表征空间，消除催化材料设计中数据分布偏移和评估偏差的方法。
一种同时利用三维结构信息和文本描述进行催化松弛能预测的图-文本多模态模型。

title: CAM-Bench: A Benchmark for Computational and Applied Mathematics in Lean
summary: Formal theorem-proving benchmarks enable mechanically verifiable evaluation of mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on Olympiad-style problems and algebraic domains, leaving computational and applied mathematics underrepresented. We introduce CAM-Bench, a Lean 4 theorem-proving benchmark of 1,000 Lean proof targets in computational and applied mathematics, with coverage spanning optimization, numerical linear algebra, and numerical analysis. These problems are adapted from textbook exercises and often depend on locally introduced definitions, notation, algorithms, and elementary results. To construct CAM-Bench, we develop a dependency-recovery pipeline that reconstructs the local textbook context needed to state each problem faithfully. It then normalizes each problem into a standalone informal theorem and translates it into a Lean target. We validate the resulting formal problems through Lean compilation and semantic review, checking both formal correctness and semantic alignment with the original exercises. For each problem, we release the raw exercise, recovered context, normalized informal theorem, and final Lean target. CAM-Bench complements existing formal mathematics benchmarks by targeting applied mathematics problems that rely on textbook concepts and elementary theorems, many of which are not directly available as standard Mathlib4 lemmas. We evaluate widely used large language models and formalization agents on CAM-Bench, and analyze common failure modes in tracking local assumptions, applying elementary results, decomposing proofs, and maintaining long-horizon control in Lean.

AI.tldr: CAM-Bench 是一个包含 1,000 个 Lean 4 定理证明目标的基准，专注于计算数学和应用数学领域（如优化、数值线性代数、数值分析），通过依赖恢复管道将教科书习题转化为独立的 Lean 证明目标，并评估了现有大模型和形式化代理在该基准上的表现与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的形式化定理证明基准主要关注奥林匹克竞赛类问题和代数领域，计算数学和应用数学领域严重缺乏代表性，导致对这些领域数学推理能力的评估不足。
AI.method: 1. 从教科书习题中选取 1,000 个计算/应用数学问题；2. 开发依赖恢复管道，重构每个问题所需的局部教科书上下文（定义、符号、算法、基础结论）；3. 将每个问题标准化为独立的非正式定理；4. 翻译为 Lean 4 形式化证明目标；5. 通过 Lean 编译和语义审查进行双重验证。
AI.result: 构建了包含 1,000 个 Lean 4 证明目标的 CAM-Bench 基准，覆盖优化、数值线性代数和数值分析领域。评估了主流大模型和形式化代理，识别出在跟踪局部假设、应用基础结论、分解证明和长程控制方面的常见失败模式。
AI.conclusion: CAM-Bench 填补了形式化数学基准在计算和应用数学领域的空白，揭示了当前大模型在形式化证明中面对依赖局部上下文的非标准数学问题时存在的系统性缺陷。
idea_en: A dependency-recovery pipeline that reconstructs local textbook context (definitions, notations, algorithms, elementary results) from textbook exercises and converts them into self-contained formal theorem-proving targets.
A method for normalizing textbook exercises into standalone informal theorems with recovered context, then translating them into Lean 4 formal proof targets with verified correctness.

A systematic evaluation framework for LLM-based formalization agents that identifies failure modes including local assumption tracking, elementary result application, proof decomposition, and long-horizon control in Lean.
idea_ch: 一种依赖恢复管道：从教科书习题中自动重构局部上下文（定义、符号、算法、基础结论），并将其转化为自包含的形式化定理证明目标。
一种教科书习题标准化方法：将带有恢复上下文的习题归一化为独立的非正式定理，再翻译为 Lean 4 形式化证明目标，并经过编译和语义双重验证。
一种面向大模型形式化代理的系统性评估框架：识别 Lean 形式化证明中追踪局部假设、应用基础结论、分解证明长程控制等关键失败模式。

title: Is VLA Reasoning Faithful? Probing Safety of Chain-of-Causation
comment: Accept (Poster), CVPR 2026 Workshop DriveX NonArchival Track
summary: We present the first systematic study of faithfulness in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving models, analyzing 300 Alpamayo-R1-10B inferences across 100 diverse PhysicalAI-AV scenarios. Our main finding is that output natural-language rationales with trajectories may be significantly unfaithful: (i) overall reasoning fidelity is only 42.5%, with Chain-of-Causation matching scene reality less than half the time; (ii) 94 missed pedestrians in one-third of pedestrian-relevant scenes; (iii) 97.7% trajectory fragility under mild visual perturbations; and (iv) only 48.3% mean reasoning-action consistency, with 53.3% of inferences exhibiting low consistency, including 37.9% of stop-claimed cases where the model continues instead. We formalize faithfulness information-theoretically, define entity and action fidelity with verification criteria, and outline a four-component safety architecture aligned with these results.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究VLA驾驶模型的忠实性问题，发现其自然语言推理与轨迹输出存在显著不忠实：推理保真度仅42.5%，大量漏检行人（94次），轨迹脆弱性高（97.7%），推理-动作一致性低（48.3%）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA驾驶模型虽然能输出自然语言推理与轨迹，但缺乏对其输出忠实性的系统评估。需要量化分析这些模型是否真正理解了驾驶场景并基于正确推理做出决策。
AI.method: 构建100个多样化PhysicalAI-AV驾驶场景，对Alpamayo-R1-10B模型进行300次推理，从推理保真度、实体检测、轨迹鲁棒性、推理-动作一致性四个维度量化分析。
AI.result: 推理保真度仅42.5%；1/3含行人场景中漏检94次行人；轻微视觉扰动下轨迹脆弱性达97.7%；推理-动作一致性仅48.3%，53.3%推理一致性低，37.9%声称停车但实际继续行驶。
AI.conclusion: VLA驾驶模型存在严重的忠实性问题，需建立信息论框架定义忠实性，并设计四组件安全架构以解决这些问题。
idea_en: A method for systematic faithfulness evaluation of Vision-Language-Action driving models using multi-dimensional metrics including reasoning fidelity, entity detection accuracy, trajectory robustness under perturbations, and reasoning-action consistency.

An information-theoretic framework for formalizing and quantifying faithfulness in VLA driving model outputs, providing mathematical definitions for entity fidelity and action fidelity with verification criteria.
A four-component safety architecture for VLA driving models designed to address unfaithful reasoning, missed entity detection, trajectory fragility, and reasoning-action inconsistency.
A chain-of-causation verification method that measures alignment between model-generated natural language rationales and actual scene reality in driving scenarios.
A perturbation-based trajectory robustness testing system that quantifies trajectory fragility under mild visual perturbations for VLA driving models.
idea_ch: 一种VLA驾驶模型系统化忠实性评估方法，采用多维指标包括推理保真度、实体检测准确率、扰动下轨迹鲁棒性及推理-动作一致性
一种用于VLA驾驶模型输出的信息论忠实性形式化框架，提供实体忠实性和动作忠实性的数学定义及验证准则
一种面向VLA驾驶模型的四组件安全架构，用于解决不忠实推理、漏检实体、轨迹脆弱性和推理-动作不一致问题
一种因果链验证方法，用于衡量驾驶场景中模型生成的自然语言推理与真实场景现实之间的对齐程度
一种基于扰动的轨迹鲁棒性测试系统，用于量化VLA驾驶模型在轻微视觉扰动下的轨迹脆弱性

title: A2RBench: An Automatic Paradigm for Formally Verifiable Abstract Reasoning Benchmark Generation
summary: Abstract reasoning ability reflects the intelligence and generalization capacity of LLMs to extract and apply abstract rules. However, accurately measuring this ability remains challenging: existing benchmarks either rely on expensive manual annotation, limiting their scale, or risk measuring memorization rather than genuine reasoning. To address this, we introduce an automated pipeline named A2RBench, encompassing generation, expansion, evaluation, and analysis. Specifically, in the generation stage, LLMs create diverse tasks demanding genuine reasoning; in the expansion stage, LLMs reuse validated rules and expand new input spaces to generate task variations, achieving scaling. However, such a process may cause hallucinations. To eliminate it, we further establish a theoretical framework and prove that programmatic verification--testing whether the inverse operation perfectly reverses the forward operation (cycle consistency)--guarantees a unique solution. Through extensive evaluations on mainstream LLMs, we find: (1) Current LLMs exhibit fundamental deficiencies in abstract reasoning, with top models significantly underperforming humans on a representative subset (39.8% vs. 68.5%). (2) Current LLMs fall far short of 2D and 1D in the complexity of generated 3D tasks, revealing their lack of understanding of high-dimensional tasks. (3) Counterintuitively, inputs with higher information complexity can simplify the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A2RBench自动化流水线，通过程序化验证（循环一致性）消除幻觉，生成可扩展的抽象推理任务来评估LLM，发现当前LLM在抽象推理上远逊于人类（39.8% vs 68.5%），且缺乏对高维任务的理解。
AI.motivation: 现有抽象推理基准要么依赖昂贵的人工标注导致规模受限，要么可能测量的是记忆而非真正的推理能力，缺乏自动化、可扩展且能保证推理真实性的评估方法。
AI.method: A2RBench包含四个阶段：生成阶段LLM创建多样化推理任务；扩展阶段LLM复用已验证规则并扩展新输入空间生成任务变体实现规模化；通过理论框架证明程序化验证（循环一致性）可消除幻觉，保证唯一解。
AI.result: (1)顶级LLM在抽象推理上显著低于人类（39.8% vs 68.5%）；(2)LLM在生成3D任务复杂度上远不及2D和1D任务；(3)反直觉地，更高信息复杂度的输入可以简化推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在抽象推理方面存在根本性缺陷，尤其是在高维任务理解上，A2RBench为自动化评估和扩展抽象推理能力提供了有效框架。
idea_en: Automated generation pipeline for abstract reasoning tasks using LLMs with cycle-consistency verification to eliminate hallucinations
Programmatic verification method based on mathematical proof that inverse operation perfectly reverses forward operation (cycle consistency) guaranteeing unique solution
Scalable task expansion methodology that reuses validated rules and expands new input spaces to generate task variations
Counterintuitive complexity-simplification principle: higher information complexity inputs can simplify the reasoning process
idea_ch: 基于循环一致性的程序化验证方法：通过数学证明前向操作与逆操作完美互逆可保证唯一解，用于消除LLM生成推理任务时的幻觉
自动化抽象推理任务生成与扩展流水线：利用LLM创建多样化推理任务，并复用已验证规则扩展新输入空间实现任务规模化
复杂度-简化反直觉原理：利用更高信息复杂度的输入来降低推理过程难度的技术方法
多维任务推理能力评估框架：可系统评估LLM在1D、2D、3D不同维度任务上的抽象推理表现

title: MetaCogAgent: A Metacognitive Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Self-Aware Task Delegation
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems have shown promise for solving complex tasks through agent collaboration. However, existing frameworks assign tasks based on predefined roles without considering whether an agent can accurately assess its own competence boundaries, leading to overconfident execution on tasks beyond its expertise. Inspired by metacognition theory from cognitive science, we propose MetaCogAgent, a multi-agent LLM framework where each agent is equipped with a Metacognitive Self-Assessment Unit that evaluates task-capability alignment before execution. The framework introduces three contributions: (1) a self-assessment mechanism that estimates per-task confidence by combining verbalized uncertainty with historical capability profiles; (2) an adaptive delegation protocol that routes low-confidence tasks to better-suited agents through cross-agent evaluation; and (3) a capability boundary learning module that iteratively refines each agent's competence model via cybernetic feedback. Experiments on our constructed MetaCog-Eval benchmark (700 tasks across 5 cognitive dimensions) demonstrate that MetaCogAgent achieves 82.4% task accuracy -- 8.7% above the best routing baseline -- while using 5% fewer API calls than AutoGen and 34% fewer than ensemble voting. Ablation studies confirm that each metacognitive component contributes to overall system performance.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaCogAgent框架，为多智能体LLM系统引入元认知能力，使每个智能体具备自我评估、自适应委派和能力边界学习的功能，在减少API调用次数的同时提升任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有框架基于预定义角色分配任务，未考虑智能体能否准确评估自身能力边界，导致在超出其专长领域的任务上过度自信执行。
AI.method: (1) 元认知自我评估单元：结合语言化不确定性与历史能力档案评估任务置信度；(2) 自适应委派协议：将低置信任务路由至更合适的智能体；(3) 能力边界学习模块：通过控制论反馈迭代优化智能体能力模型。
AI.result: 在MetaCog-Eval基准上达到82.4%任务准确率，比最佳路由基线高8.7%；API调用比AutoGen少5%，比集成投票少34%。
AI.conclusion: 元认知各组件均对系统整体性能有贡献，为多智能体系统提供了更高效、更智能的任务分配方案。
idea_en: 1. A metacognitive self-assessment unit for LLM agents that combines verbalized uncertainty expressions with historical task-capability profiles to estimate per-task confidence before execution.
2. An adaptive delegation protocol for multi-agent systems that routes low-confidence tasks to better-suited agents through cross-agent capability evaluation.
3. A capability boundary learning module that iteratively refines each agent's competence model using cybernetic feedback from task outcomes.
4. A multi-agent task routing system where confidence scores determine whether an agent executes a task independently or delegates to another agent.

5. A methodology for constructing multi-dimensional cognitive evaluation benchmarks spanning multiple cognitive dimensions (e.g., reasoning, planning, creative generation) for assessing multi-agent LLM systems.
idea_ch: 1. 一种LLM智能体的元认知自我评估单元，通过结合语言化不确定性表达与历史任务-能力档案，在执行前估算每个任务的置信度。
2. 一种多智能体系统的自适应委派协议，通过跨智能体能力评估将低置信任务路由至更合适的智能体执行。
3. 一种能力边界学习模块，利用任务结果的控制论反馈迭代优化每个智能体的能力模型。
4. 一种基于置信度分数的多智能体任务路由系统，根据置信度决定智能体是独立执行任务还是委派给其他智能体。
5. 一种跨多个认知维度（如推理、规划、创造性生成）构建多智能体LLM系统评估基准的方法论。

title: CyberCorrect: A Cybernetic Framework for Closed-Loop Self-Correction in Large Language Models
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, submitted to IEEE SMC 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) self-correction -- the ability to detect and fix errors in generated outputs -- remains largely ad hoc, relying on generic prompts such as "please reconsider your answer" without systematic error analysis or convergence guarantees. We propose CyberCorrect, a framework that formalizes LLM self-correction as a closed-loop control system grounded in cybernetic theory. The framework models the LLM generator as the plant and introduces a tri-modal Error Detector (combining self-consistency, verbalized confidence, and logic-chain verification) as the sensor. A type-directed Correction Controller generates targeted repair instructions based on diagnosed error categories, while a Convergence Judge determines iteration termination using stability criteria adapted from control theory. We further introduce three control-theoretic evaluation metrics -- convergence rate, overshoot rate, and oscillation rate -- that capture correction dynamics beyond final accuracy. Experiments on our constructed CyberCorrect-Bench (440 reasoning tasks with annotated error types and correction paths) show that CyberCorrect achieves 79.8% final accuracy, improving upon the best existing self-correction method by 6.2 percentage points, while reducing overshoot (erroneous over-correction) by 41% through its convergence control mechanism.

AI.tldr: CyberCorrect 将 LLM 自校正形式化为闭环控制系统，引入三模态错误检测器、类型导向的修正控制器和收敛判定器，在推理任务上取得 79.8% 准确率，并降低 41% 过度修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 自校正方法缺乏系统性的错误分析和收敛保证，仅依赖通用提示词，效果不稳定且不可控。
AI.method: CyberCorrect 将 LLM 生成器建模为被控对象，设计三模态错误检测器（自一致性、口头化置信度、逻辑链验证）作为传感器，类型导向的修正控制器生成针对性修复指令，引入收敛判定器基于控制理论稳定性准则判断是否终止迭代。同时提出收敛率、超调率、振荡率三个控制论评估指标。
AI.result: 在 CyberCorrect-Bench 上达到 79.8% 最终准确率，比最佳现有方法高 6.2 个百分点，过度修正减少 41%。
AI.conclusion: 将控制理论引入 LLM 自校正是可行的，能显著提升校正效果和稳定性，为未来 LLM 可控制生成提供了新方向。
idea_en: A closed-loop control system for LLM self-correction based on cybernetic theory, modeling the LLM generator as a plant with feedback control
A tri-modal Error Detector combining self-consistency, verbalized confidence, and logic-chain verification as sensing mechanisms for error detection
A type-directed Correction Controller that generates targeted repair instructions based on diagnosed error categories
A Convergence Judge using stability criteria from control theory to determine iteration termination for self-correction
Control-theoretic evaluation metrics (convergence rate, overshoot rate, oscillation rate) for capturing correction dynamics beyond final accuracy
idea_ch: 基于控制论的 LLM 自校正闭环控制系统，将 LLM 生成器建模为被控对象并引入反馈控制
三模态错误检测器，融合自一致性、口头化置信度和逻辑链验证三种机制进行错误感知
类型导向的修正控制器，根据诊断出的错误类别生成针对性的修复指令
收敛判定器，采用控制理论中的稳定性准则判断自校正迭代是否终止
控制论评估指标（收敛率、超调率、振荡率），用于捕捉超出最终准确率的校正动态特性

title: Reasoning Before Diagnosis: Physician-Inspired Structured Thinking for ECG Classification
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis in clinical practice relies on structured reasoning over multiple hierarchical aspects, including cardiac rhythm, conduction properties, waveform morphology, and overall diagnostic impression. However, most existing approaches predict labels directly from ECG signals without explicit clinical reasoning, resulting in opaque decisions that lack clinical alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose CardioThink, a physician-inspired multimodal large language model (MLLM) framework that explicitly models the diagnostic reasoning process through human-interpretable intermediate stages (rhythm, conduction, morphology, and impression) to derive final classification results. Furthermore, we introduce Structured Set Policy Optimization (SSPO) to jointly optimize adherence to this structured reasoning format and the accuracy of variable-size diagnostic sets, without requiring manually annotated reasoning traces. Extensive experiments on diverse ECG benchmarks demonstrate the significant superiority of our approach in diagnostic accuracy, while simultaneously providing interpretable clinical reasoning. Notably, reasoning quality evaluations confirm that SSPO substantially enhances the clinical validity of the generated rationales. These findings reveal that moving beyond direct label prediction toward structured reasoning offers a more clinically aligned direction for future ECG modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出CardioThink框架，通过结构化推理（心律、传导、形态、印象）进行心电图诊断，并引入SSPO优化方法，在提升诊断准确率的同时提供可解释的临床推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG诊断方法直接从信号预测标签，缺乏临床推理过程，导致决策不透明且不符合临床实践。
AI.method: 提出CardioThink：一个受医生启发的多模态大语言模型框架，通过显式建模诊断推理过程（心律→传导→形态→印象）进行ECG分类；并引入结构化集合策略优化（SSPO）联合优化推理格式和变尺寸诊断集的准确性。
AI.result: 在多个ECG基准测试中，CardioThink在诊断准确率上显著优于现有方法，同时提供可解释的临床推理；SSPO有效增强了生成推理的临床有效性。
AI.conclusion: 超越直接标签预测，走向结构化推理是未来ECG建模更符合临床需求的发展方向。
idea_en: Physician-Inspired Multi-Stage Diagnostic Reasoning Framework: A method that structures ECG diagnosis into hierarchical interpretable stages (rhythm, conduction, morphology, impression) within a multimodal large language model, enabling explicit clinical reasoning path generation alongside final classification.

Structured Set Policy Optimization (SSPO): A novel optimization technique that jointly optimizes adherence to structured reasoning format and accuracy of variable-size diagnostic label sets without requiring manually annotated reasoning traces, applicable to medical diagnosis tasks with set-structured outputs.

Interpretable Clinical Reasoning in ECG via MLLM: Using a multimodal large language model to transform raw ECG signals into structured clinical rationales that explicitly document the step-by-step diagnostic reasoning process, improving both accuracy and interpretability.

Variable-Size Diagnostic Set Prediction with Structured Reasoning: A technical solution for predicting diagnostic sets of varying sizes (multiple possible conditions) while maintaining a structured, clinically-valid reasoning chain, addressing the challenge of multi-label ECG classification with explicit rationale.
idea_ch: 受医生启发的多阶段诊断推理框架：一种将心电图诊断结构化为层次化可解释阶段（心律、传导、形态、印象）的多模态大语言模型方法，在最终分类的同时生成显式的临床推理路径。
结构化集合策略优化（SSPO）：一种新型优化技术，无需人工标注的推理轨迹，即可联合优化结构化推理格式的遵循度和变尺寸诊断标签集的准确性，适用于具有集合结构输出的医疗诊断任务。
基于MLLM的心电图可解释临床推理：利用多模态大语言模型将原始心电图信号转换为结构化的临床推理链，显式记录逐步诊断推理过程，同时提升准确性和可解释性。
带结构化推理的变尺寸诊断集预测：一种预测可变大小诊断集（多种可能病症）并同时维护结构化、临床有效的推理链的技术方案，解决了需要显式推理的多标签心电图分类问题。

title: HyperPersona: A Multi-Level Hypergraph Framework for Text-Based Automatic Personality Prediction
summary: As a modern commodity, language has become a vast repository of socially and psychologically significant traits and concepts, reflecting the ways people encode pattern of thoughts, behaviors, and emotions into words. Text-based Automatic Personality Prediction (APP), seeks to infer personality from linguistic behavior, offering a scalable alternative to traditional psychometric assessments. Although text is inherently hierarchical, with the document-level capturing global features, the sentence-level encoding local semantics, and the word-level providing fine-grained lexical information, most existing approaches rely on shallow, sequential, or single-level representations that ignore the multi-level structure of written language. To address this, we propose HyperPersona, a framework that explicitly models the hierarchical organization of text (document, sentence, and word) through hypergraph structure, where a document and its sentences are represented as hyperedges, and the words are represented as nodes, enabling joint modeling of global, local, and lexical dependencies of text. Followed by a transformer-based graph encoder that learns interactions within and across these linguistic layers, yielding context-sensitive and structurally grounded feature representations for personality prediction. Experiments on the Big Five personality dimensions show that, while relying solely on text, HyperPersona effectively integrates multi-level linguistic cues, achieving superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These findings underscore the critical role of textual hierarchy in advancing human-like personality inference from natural language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperPersona框架，通过超图结构显式建模文本的层级结构（文档、句子、单词），利用基于Transformer的图编码器学习跨层级交互，在文本人格预测任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本人格预测方法多采用浅层、顺序或单层表示，忽略了文本固有的多层级结构（文档级全局特征、句子级局部语义、单词级细粒度词汇信息），导致无法充分捕捉语言中的多层次人格线索。
AI.method: 提出HyperPersona框架，构建超图结构：文档和句子作为超边，单词作为节点，从而联合建模全局、局部和词汇依赖；使用基于Transformer的图编码器学习层级内和跨层级的交互，生成上下文敏感且结构化的特征表示用于人格预测。
AI.result: 在Big Five人格维度实验中，仅依赖文本输入，HyperPersona有效整合多层级语言线索，性能优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 文本层级结构对从自然语言中进行类人化人格推断具有关键作用，超图建模是捕捉这种结构化信息的有效手段。
idea_en: A hierarchical hypergraph-based text representation method for personality prediction, where documents and sentences are modeled as hyperedges and words as nodes to capture multi-level linguistic dependencies.
A transformer-based graph encoder architecture that learns intra-layer and inter-layer interactions across document, sentence, and word levels for context-sensitive feature extraction.

A text-only personality prediction framework that jointly models global (document), local (sentence), and lexical (word) information through hypergraph structure without requiring external psychometric data.
A method for automatic personality inference that explicitly encodes the hierarchical organization of natural language text using hyperedges to represent composite linguistic units.
idea_ch: 一种基于层级超图的文本人格预测表示方法，将文档和句子建模为超边、单词建模为节点，以捕获多层级语言依赖关系。
一种基于Transformer的图编码器架构，在文档、句子和单词层级间学习层级内及跨层级交互，实现上下文敏感的特征提取。
一种纯文本人格预测框架，通过超图结构联合建模全局（文档）、局部（句子）和词汇（单词）信息，无需外部心理测量数据。
一种自动人格推断方法，利用超边表示复合语言单元，显式编码自然语言文本的层级组织结构。

title: CBT-Audio: Evaluating Audio Language Models for Patient-Side Distress Intensity Estimation in CBT Session Recordings
summary: Cognitive behavioural therapy is widely used to help patients understand and manage psychological distress. It is often delivered through spoken conversation, where therapists attend not only to what patients say, but also to how they say it, because these cues can help therapists decide how to respond and adapt treatment. Progress in building AI systems for CBT remains largely limited to text, partly because most available datasets are text based and shareable spoken CBT data are scarce under ethical and privacy constraints. This creates a blind spot because text based models and evaluations cannot capture the mismatch between the transcript and the patient's voice, even though therapists often rely on this mismatch to understand patient distress. We introduce CBT-Audio, a dataset for evaluating patient distress estimation from spoken CBT sessions with audio language models. CBT-Audio contains 1,802 patient turns from 96 publicly available CBT recordings, with turn-level distress labels validated on an experts-annotated subset. We evaluate 10 open source audio language models under three input conditions, where models receive only patient audio, only the transcript, or both audio and transcript. Our results show that audio can provide useful information beyond text, especially when combined with transcripts. Adding audio to transcript input improves distress estimation over using the transcript alone in 8 of 10 model families, with significant gains in 4, and case studies show the clearest benefit when verbal content and vocal delivery diverge. CBT-Audio makes spoken patient behaviour measurable for AI evaluation in CBT-related tasks and supports future work on audio language models for mental health interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CBT-Audio数据集，用于从心理治疗会话的语音中评估患者痛苦程度。该数据集包含96个公开录音的1802个患者发言片段，带有痛苦程度标签。实验表明，结合音频和文本比单独使用文本能更好地估计患者痛苦，特别是在语词内容与语气表达不一致时。
AI.motivation: 现有认知行为疗法（CBT）的AI系统主要基于文本，忽略了语音中的声学线索（如语调、语速等），而治疗师恰恰依赖这些线索来判断患者状态。由于伦理和隐私限制，缺乏可共享的语音CBT数据集。
AI.method: 构建CBT-Audio数据集：从96个公开CBT录音中提取1802个患者发言片段，由专家标注痛苦程度。使用10个开源音频语言模型，在三种输入条件下（仅音频、仅文本、音频+文本）评估患者痛苦估计性能。
AI.result: 音频+文本输入在10个模型家族中的8个上优于仅文本输入，其中4个有显著提升。案例研究表明，当患者语词内容与语音表达不一致时，音频信息的增益最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 音频信息对于准确评估CBT会话中的患者痛苦有重要价值，尤其当文本与语音存在不一致时。CBT-Audio数据集为AI在心理健康领域的音频语言模型研究提供了基础。
idea_en: A method for estimating patient distress in cognitive behavioral therapy by jointly processing audio features (vocal tone, pitch, speaking rate) and text transcript, using an audio-language model that detects misalignment between verbal content and voice delivery.

A turn-level distress annotation system for psychotherapy sessions that captures temporal dynamics of patient emotional states by segmenting continuous therapy recordings into discrete patient speaking turns with validated expert labels.
A multimodal fusion framework for mental health assessment that learns to weight audio versus text contributions dynamically, with higher audio weight when vocal cues and semantic content diverge.
A privacy-preserving approach to creating shareable psychotherapy audio datasets, using publicly available recordings with de-identified turn-level annotations for AI model training and evaluation.
A cross-modal evaluation methodology for audio language models in clinical settings, with three input conditions (audio-only, text-only, audio+text) to systematically assess modality contribution.
idea_ch: 一种联合处理音频特征（语调、音高、语速）和文本转录的认知行为疗法患者痛苦程度估计方法，利用音频语言模型检测语词内容与语音表达之间的不一致性。
一种面向心理治疗会话的发言级（turn-level）痛苦标注系统，通过将连续治疗录音分割为离散的患者发言片段并由专家验证标注，捕获患者情绪状态的时间动态变化。
一种用于心理健康评估的多模态融合框架，能够动态学习音频与文本特征的权重分配，当声学线索与语义内容出现偏差时自动提高音频模态的贡献权重。
一种隐私保护的公开心理治疗音频数据集构建方法，利用公开可用的治疗录音并配以去标识化的发言级标注，用于AI模型训练与评估。
一种面向临床场景的音频语言模型跨模态评估方法，设置三种输入条件（纯音频、纯文本、音频+文本）来系统评估各模态对评估性能的贡献度。

title: ADR: An Agentic Detection System for Enterprise Agentic AI Security
summary: We present the Agentic AI Detection and Response (ADR) system, the first large-scale, production-proven enterprise framework for securing AI agents operating through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We identify three persistent challenges in this domain: (1) limited observability -- existing Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools see file writes but not the agent reasoning, prompts, or causal chains linking intent to execution; (2) insufficient robustness -- static defenses constrained by pre-defined rules fail to generalize across diverse attack techniques and enterprise contexts; and (3) high detection costs -- LLM-based inference is prohibitively expensive at scale. ADR addresses these challenges via three components: the ADR Sensor for high-fidelity agentic telemetry, the ADR Explorer for systematic pre-deployment red teaming and hard-example generation, and the ADR Detector for scalable, two-tier online detection combining fast triage with context-aware reasoning. Deployed at Uber for over ten months, ADR has sustained reliable detection in production with growing adoption reaching over 7,200 unique hosts and processing over 10,000 agent sessions daily, uncovering hundreds of credential exposures across 26 categories and enabling a shift-left prevention layer (97.2% precision, 206 detected credentials). To validate the approach and enable community adoption, we introduce ADR-Bench (302 tasks, 17 techniques, 133 MCP servers), where ADR achieves zero false positives while detecting 67% of attacks -- outperforming three state-of-the-art baselines (ALRPHFS, GuardAgent, LlamaFirewall) by 2--4x in F1-score. On AgentDojo (public prompt injection benchmark), ADR detects all attacks with only three false alarms out of 93 tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个大规模、生产验证的企业级AI代理检测与响应系统（ADR），通过传感器、探测器和检测器三大组件，解决了AI代理安全中的观测性不足、鲁棒性差和检测成本高等问题。在Uber部署超10个月，覆盖7200+主机，日处理10000+代理会话，零误报下检测67%攻击，F1分数比现有最优方案高2-4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有安全方案无法有效防护通过Model Context Protocol运行的AI代理，面临三大挑战：1）EDR工具无法观测代理推理过程、提示词及因果链；2）基于预定义规则的静态防御无法泛化到多样化攻击；3）LLM推理成本过高，难以大规模部署。
AI.method: ADR系统包含三个核心组件：1）ADR Sensor - 高保真代理遥测传感器；2）ADR Explorer - 系统化预部署红队测试与困难样本生成；3）ADR Detector - 可扩展的两层在线检测（快速分类+上下文感知推理）。
AI.result: 在Uber部署超10个月，覆盖7200+主机，日处理10000+代理会话；发现26类数百个凭证暴露；shift-left预防层达97.2%精度、206个检测凭证；在ADR-Bench基准上零误报下检测67%攻击，F1分数优于ALRPHFS、GuardAgent、LlamaFirewall等基线2-4倍；在AgentDojo上检测全部攻击，仅3次误报。
AI.conclusion: ADR系统证明了通过高保真遥测、系统化红队测试和两级检测架构，可以在生产环境中经济高效地实现AI代理安全防护，具有显著的可扩展性和实际应用价值。
idea_en: An agentic AI detection and response system with a two-tier online detection architecture combining fast triage and context-aware reasoning for real-time security monitoring of AI agents operating through Model Context Protocol.
A high-fidelity agentic telemetry sensor (ADR Sensor) that captures agent reasoning, prompts, and causal chains linking intent to execution, providing observability beyond traditional EDR tools.
A systematic pre-deployment red teaming and hard-example generation framework (ADR Explorer) for enterprise AI agents, enabling automated attack surface discovery and robust defense training.
A shift-left prevention layer for credential exposure detection in AI agent sessions, achieving 97.2% precision through production-scale monitoring of 26 categories of credential exposures.
A benchmark suite (ADR-Bench) comprising 302 tasks, 17 attack techniques, and 133 MCP servers for standardized evaluation of AI agent security solutions.
idea_ch: 一种用于AI代理安全的两级在线检测架构，结合快速分类与上下文感知推理，实现对通过Model Context Protocol运行的AI代理的实时安全监控。
一种高保真代理遥测传感器（ADR Sensor），能够捕获代理推理过程、提示词以及从意图到执行的因果链，超越传统EDR工具的观测能力。
一种面向企业AI代理的系统化预部署红队测试与困难样本生成框架（ADR Explorer），实现攻击面的自动发现和鲁棒防御训练。
一种用于AI代理会话中凭证暴露检测的左移预防层，通过大规模生产环境监控26类凭证暴露，实现97.2%的检测精度。
一种包含302项任务、17种攻击技术和133个MCP服务器的标准化AI代理安全评估基准（ADR-Bench）。

title: QQJ: Quantifying Qualitative Judgment for Scalable and Human-Aligned Evaluation of Generative AI
summary: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has exposed fundamental limitations in existing evaluation methodologies, particularly for open-ended, creative, and human-facing tasks. Traditional automatic metrics rely on surface-level statistical similarity and often fail to reflect human perceptions of quality, while purely human evaluation, although reliable, is costly, subjective, and difficult to scale. Recent approaches using large language models as evaluators offer improved scalability but frequently lack explicit grounding in human-defined evaluation principles, leading to bias and inconsistency. In this paper, we introduce Quantifying Qualitative Judgment (QQJ), a scalable and human-centric evaluation framework that explicitly bridges the gap between human judgment and automated assessment. QQJ separates the definition of quality from its execution by anchoring evaluation in expert-designed, multi-dimensional rubrics and calibrating large language model evaluators to align with expert reasoning using a small, high-quality annotation set. This design enables consistent, interpretable, and scalable evaluation across diverse generative tasks and modalities. Extensive experiments on text and image generation demonstrate that QQJ achieves substantially stronger alignment with human judgment than traditional automatic metrics and unconstrained LLM-based evaluators. Moreover, QQJ exhibits improved stability across repeated evaluations and superior diagnostic capability in identifying critical failure modes such as hallucination and intent mismatch. These results indicate that structured qualitative judgment can be operationalized at scale without sacrificing interpretability or human alignment, positioning QQJ as a practical foundation for reliable evaluation of modern generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QQJ框架，通过专家设计的评分标准+少量标注校准LLM评估者，实现可扩展、一致且符合人类判断的生成式AI评估方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI评估方法存在根本性局限：传统自动指标依赖表面统计相似性且无法反映人类感知，纯人工评估成本高且主观，LLM作为评估者虽可扩展但缺乏人类评估原则的显式基础，导致偏差和不一致。
AI.method: QQJ框架将质量定义与执行分离：首先由专家设计多维评分标准（rubrics），然后使用少量高质量标注集对LLM评估者进行校准，使其对齐专家推理逻辑，从而实现跨文本和图像生成任务的一致、可解释且可扩展的评估。
AI.result: 在文本和图像生成任务上，QQJ比传统自动指标和未约束的LLM评估者更接近人类判断，具有更好的重复评估稳定性，并能有效识别幻觉和意图不匹配等关键失败模式。
AI.conclusion: QQJ通过将质量定义与执行分离、基于专家设计的多维评分标准并校准LLM评估者，实现了可扩展、一致且可解释的生成式AI评估，在文本和图像生成任务上比传统自动指标和未约束的LLM评估者更接近人类判断。
idea_en: A method for calibrating large language model evaluators using expert-designed multi-dimensional rubrics and a small high-quality annotation set to align with expert reasoning for generative AI quality assessment

A framework that separates quality definition from execution by anchoring evaluation in pre-defined structured rubrics, enabling consistent and interpretable assessment across diverse generative tasks and modalities
A diagnostic evaluation method using calibrated LLM evaluators to identify critical failure modes including hallucination and intent mismatch in generated content
A scalable evaluation scheme with improved stability across repeated evaluations by using structured scoring criteria to reduce bias and inconsistency in LLM-based evaluators
A cross-modal evaluation framework applicable to both text and image generation tasks using unified multi-dimensional rubrics adapted to different generation types
idea_ch: 一种基于专家设计的多维评分标准与少量高质量标注集来校准大型语言模型评估者的方法，使其对齐专家推理逻辑，用于生成式AI任务的质量评估
一种将质量定义与执行相分离的评估框架，通过预定义结构化评估维度和标准，实现跨不同生成任务和模态的一致、可解释评估
一种利用校准后的LLM评估者进行生成内容诊断的方法，能够识别幻觉（hallucination）和意图不匹配（intent mismatch）等关键失败模式
一种在多次重复评估中保持稳定性的可扩展评估方案，通过结构化评分标准减少LLM评估者的偏差和不一致性
一种在文本生成和图像生成任务中通用的跨模态评估框架，使用统一的多维评分标准适配不同生成类型

title: Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Coordination graphs are a central abstraction in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), yet existing sparse-graph learners lack a theoretically grounded mechanism to decide which edges should exist and how much information each edge should carry. Current methods rely on heuristic criteria that offer no formal guarantee on the learned topology, and no principled way to allocate different communication capacities to structurally different agent relationships. To address this, we propose Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs (HIBCG), which learns a group-aware sparse graph in which both edge existence and message capacity are theoretically justified. With the graph information bottleneck (GIB) serving as the underlying tool, HIBCG first constructs a group-aligned block-diagonal prior that provides a closed-form criterion for edge retention -- determining which edges should exist and at what density per group block -- and then controls per-agent feature bandwidth on the resulting topology, compressing messages to retain only task-relevant content. We prove that the group-aligned prior strictly tightens the variational bound on topology learning, that the objective decomposes per group block, enabling differential edge control, and that capacity allocation follows a water-filling principle.

AI.tldr: 提出异构信息瓶颈协调图（HIBCG），利用图信息瓶颈（GIB）理论为多智能体强化学习中的协调图提供边缘存在性和消息容量的理论保证，实现分组感知的稀疏图学习与差异化通信容量分配。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏图学习方法缺乏理论依据来决定哪些边应该存在以及每条边应携带多少信息，依赖启发式标准，无法保证学习到的拓扑结构的形式正确性，也无法对不同智能体关系分配不同的通信容量。
AI.method: 以图信息瓶颈（GIB）为底层工具，首先构建分组对齐的块对角先验，为边的保留提供闭式判别准则（决定哪些边应存在以及每个分组块的密度）；然后在所得拓扑上控制每个智能体的特征带宽，压缩消息仅保留任务相关内容。
AI.result: 理论证明：分组对齐先验严格收紧拓扑学习的变分下界；目标函数可按分组块分解，实现差异化边控制；容量分配遵循注水原理（water-filling principle）。
AI.conclusion: HIBCG为多智能体协调图的拓扑学习和容量分配提供了理论基础，能够学习到分组感知的稀疏图，使边存在性和消息容量均具有理论保证。
idea_en: A method for learning sparsified coordination graphs in multi-agent reinforcement learning using Graph Information Bottleneck (GIB) to theoretically justify edge existence and message capacity.
A group-aligned block-diagonal prior construction method that provides closed-form criteria for edge retention decision in graph topology learning.
A differential edge control mechanism where the optimization objective decomposes per group block, enabling group-specific density control in coordination graphs.
A water-filling principle-based capacity allocation method for allocating different communication bandwidths to different agent relationships.
A feature bandwidth control technique on learned graph topology that compresses messages to retain only task-relevant content via information bottleneck.
idea_ch: 一种基于图信息瓶颈（GIB）的多智能体强化学习协调图稀疏化学习方法，为边的存在性和消息容量提供理论依据
一种分组对齐块对角先验构建方法，为图拓扑学习中的边保留决策提供闭式判别准则
一种差异化边控制机制，通过将优化目标按分组块分解实现对不同组块的密度差异化控制
一种基于注水原理的容量分配方法，为不同智能体关系分配不同的通信带宽
一种在所学拓扑上的特征带宽控制技术，通过信息瓶颈压缩消息仅保留任务相关内容

title: Computational Challenges in Token Economics: Bridging Economic Theory and AI System Design
summary: Token economics has emerged as a useful lens for understanding resource allocation, value creation, and pricing in large language model systems. While recent work has increasingly treated tokens as economic primitives, there remains a substantial gap between high-level economic theory and the computational realities of modern AI infrastructure. This paper identifies and analyzes the key computational challenges that arise when token-economic principles are implemented in real-time inference systems. We argue that computational feasibility is not merely one dimension of token economics, but its governing constraint: these challenges are driven by fundamental tensions among fine-grained valuation, low-latency execution, and allocation optimality under uncertainty. To structure this problem space, we introduce the notion of \textbf{Computational Token Economics} and propose the \textbf{Token Economics Trilemma} -- a conditional no-free-lunch principle that captures the inherent trade-offs among granularity, real-time performance, and optimality. We further categorize the main technical challenges into three areas: real-time value accounting, constrained resource allocation, and economic-aware system architecture. Rather than presenting a complete solution, this paper aims to define a research agenda for bridging token economics and AI system design, highlighting open problems at the intersection of computational economics, machine learning systems, and AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“计算代币经济学”概念和“代币经济学三难困境”，分析了在大型语言模型实时推理系统中实施代币经济原则所面临的计算挑战，包括细粒度估值、低延迟执行和不确定性下的最优分配之间的根本矛盾。
AI.motivation: 尽管代币经济学已成为理解LLM系统中资源分配、价值创造和定价的有用视角，但高层次经济理论与现代AI基础设施的计算现实之间存在显著差距，需要系统分析和弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出计算代币经济学（Computational Token Economics）概念框架，定义代币经济学三难困境（Token Economics Trilemma）作为条件性无免费午餐原则，并将技术挑战分为三大类：实时价值核算、受限资源分配、经济感知系统架构。
AI.result: 识别并分析了代币经济原则在实时推理系统中实施时的关键计算挑战，阐明代币经济学三难困境，并定义了连接代币经济学与AI系统设计的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 计算可行性不仅是代币经济学的一个维度，而是其主导性约束条件。本文旨在定义一个研究议程，而非提供完整解决方案，突出计算经济学、机器学习系统和AI基础设施交叉领域的开放问题。
idea_en: 1. Token Economics Trilemma framework: A no-free-lunch principle characterizing the inherent trade-offs among granularity (fine-grained valuation), real-time performance (low-latency execution), and optimality (allocation optimality under uncertainty) in token-economic inference systems.

2. Computational Token Economics system architecture: An economic-aware system architecture design that integrates real-time value accounting, constrained resource allocation, and economic principles directly into AI inference infrastructure.

3. Real-time value accounting mechanism for tokens: A technical method for tracking and assigning economic value to individual tokens in real-time during LLM inference, enabling dynamic pricing and resource allocation.

4. Constrained resource allocation optimizer for token economics: An optimization algorithm that balances economic efficiency with computational constraints in multi-tenant LLM serving systems under uncertainty.
idea_ch: 1. 代币经济学三难困境框架：一种无免费午餐原则，刻画了代币经济推理系统中细粒度估值（粒度）、低延迟执行（实时性能）和不确定性下的最优分配（最优性）之间的内在权衡关系。
2. 计算代币经济学系统架构：一种经济感知的系统架构设计，将实时价值核算、受限资源分配和经济原则直接集成到AI推理基础设施中。
3. 代币实时价值核算机制：一种在LLM推理过程中实时追踪和分配单个代币经济价值的技术方法，支持动态定价和资源分配。
4. 代币经济学的受限资源分配优化器：一种在多租户LLM服务系统中平衡经济效率与计算约束的优化算法，能够在不确定性条件下运行。

title: Multi-Party Multi-Objective Optimization as Consensus Search: Runtime Analysis of Cross-Party Recombination
summary: Multi-party multi-objective optimization problems (MPMOPs) require consensus among autonomous decision makers and therefore differ from flattened many-objective formulations. Existing runtime theory for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms is largely tailored to single-party Pareto-front approximation and does not directly explain common-solution search in MPMOPs. We investigate cross-party recombination in two representative settings. On MP-JCG, a pseudo-Boolean benchmark with an explicit gap region, we prove that a payoff-guided mutation baseline faces a gap-crossing bottleneck requiring \(Θ(n^2)\) expected fitness evaluations. In contrast, an analytical CPR-NSGA-II variant discovers both common Pareto-optimal solutions in \(O(n\log n)\) expected evaluations by directly assembling complementary prefix and suffix templates distributed across party populations. Comparing this with the flattened four-objective formulation F-JCG, our full-front coverage analysis illustrates the additional coverage burden introduced by flattening. For BPBOMST, the bi-party, two-objective-per-party specialization of the multi-party multi-objective minimum spanning tree problem, we develop a layered support-cover analysis. For each common Pareto objective vector, the symmetric average projection induces an auxiliary bi-objective MST instance, and suitable support representatives yield a \(2λ\)-common approximation cover with \(λ\in[1,2]\). We further derive an instance-parameterized expected runtime bound for a representative-pool CPR-NSGA-II variant using edge-union recombination and uniform repair. This bound separates the effects of local auxiliary-front filling, cross-party recombination shortcuts, and edge-union repair ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多主体多目标优化问题（MPMOPs），提出跨主体重组策略的理论分析。在MP-JCG基准上，证明CPR-NSGA-II变体通过直接组装分布在各主体种群中的互补前缀和后缀模板，可在O(n log n)期望评估中共同发现Pareto最优解，而基于梯度的变异需要Θ(n²)评估。在BPBOMST问题上，开发了分层支持覆盖分析，导出了代表性池CPR-NSGA-II变体的实例参数化期望运行时间界。
AI.motivation: 现有单主体Pareto前沿逼近的运行时间理论不适用于多主体多目标优化问题（MPMOPs），缺乏对跨主体重组和共同解搜索的严格理论分析。
AI.method: 1) 在MP-JCG基准上对比分析基于梯度的变异与CPR-NSGA-II的跨主体重组策略；2) 与扁平化四目标公式F-JCG进行全覆盖分析对比；3) 在BPBOMST问题上开发分层支持覆盖分析，通过对称平均投影构造辅助双目标MST实例，推导代表性池CPR-NSGA-II变体的期望运行时间界。
AI.result: 1) MP-JCG上，CPR-NSGA-II变体达到O(n log n)期望评估，而基线方法需要Θ(n²)；2) 扁平化公式F-JCG引入了额外的覆盖负担；3) BPBOMST上导出了包含局部辅助前沿填充、跨主体重组捷径和边联合修复歧义三种效应的分离式期望运行时间界。
AI.conclusion: 跨主体重组策略（CPR）可以显著加速多主体多目标优化中的共同解搜索过程，其理论优势可通过分离式运行时间分析得到量化解释。
idea_en: Cross-party recombination (CPR) method for multi-party multi-objective optimization where complementary prefix and suffix templates are directly assembled from distributed party populations to discover common Pareto-optimal solutions in O(n log n) expected evaluations.
Layered support-cover analysis framework for bi-party multi-objective minimum spanning tree problems using symmetric average projection to construct auxiliary bi-objective MST instances.

Instance-parameterized expected runtime bound for representative-pool CPR-NSGA-II variant using edge-union recombination and uniform repair, which separates effects of local auxiliary-front filling, cross-party recombination shortcuts, and edge-union repair ambiguity.
Payoff-guided mutation baseline with gap-crossing bottleneck analysis for multi-party JCG benchmark requiring Θ(n²) expected fitness evaluations.
Full-front coverage analysis method for comparing multi-party formulations against flattened many-objective formulations, quantifying the additional coverage burden introduced by flattening.
2λ-common approximation cover mechanism for multi-party multi-objective optimization with λ∈[1,2] using suitable support representatives.
idea_ch: 跨主体重组（CPR）方法：直接从分布在不同主体种群中的互补前缀和后缀模板进行组装，以O(n log n)期望评估发现多主体多目标优化中的共同Pareto最优解
分层支持覆盖分析框架：针对双主体多目标最小生成树问题，利用对称平均投影构造辅助双目标MST实例进行理论分析
代表性池CPR-NSGA-II变体的实例参数化期望运行时间界：采用边联合重组和统一修复策略，分离局部辅助前沿填充、跨主体重组捷径和边联合修复歧义三种效应
基于梯度的变异基线方法在MP-JCG基准上的间隙跨越瓶颈分析，证明需Θ(n²)期望适应度评估
全覆盖分析方法：比较多主体公式化与扁平化多目标公式化，量化扁平化带来的额外覆盖负担
2λ共同近似覆盖机制：利用合适的支持代表，对多主体多目标优化实现λ∈[1,2]的近似覆盖

title: The Capability Paradox: How Smarter Auditors Make Multi-Agent Systems Less Secure
summary: Multi-agent systems extend large language models (LLMs) by decomposing tasks among specialized agents, but their distributed decision process creates new attack surfaces. We identify \emph{semantic hijacking}, an attack in which harmful requests are concealed within domain-specific narratives and propagated to a Manager through Worker reports, without any syntactic injection primitives. Across 42,000 adversarial trials over 12 Manager models and 7 Worker configurations, we uncover a \emph{capability paradox}: as Worker capability increases, the mean system-level Attack Success Rate (ASR) increases from 18.4% to 63.9%, peaking at 94.4%. To explain this effect, we conduct multi-level mediation analysis on two independent datasets (47,807 interactions). This analysis shows that this paradox is driven by \emph{linguistic certainty}: stronger Workers are more likely to interpret adversarial narratives as legitimate, convey their conclusions assertively, and thereby lead Managers to treat such confident endorsements as justification to execute. In our larger Worker-Only setting ($n_W$=14), certainty mediates 74% of the effect, with 95% confidence intervals (CI) excluding zero under both Monte Carlo and cluster bootstrap; the smaller Full-MAS setting ($n_W$ =6) shows a directionally consistent indirect effect. Worker-side safety prompting does not reliably mitigate this failure. Building on the mediation finding, we propose \emph{heterogeneous ensemble verification}, which pairs Workers of asymmetric domain competence so their complementary vulnerabilities break the certainty-to-execution chain, reducing ASR from 52.8% to 2.0% with negligible benign-task impact. Our results show that upgrading components to stronger models can actively degrade system security, and that effective defenses require exploiting--rather than eliminating--capability asymmetries between agents.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多智能体系统中存在"语义劫持"攻击：有害请求隐藏在领域叙事中，通过Worker报告传播给Manager。且存在"能力悖论"：Worker能力越强，系统攻击成功率越高（从18.4%升至94.4%）。中介分析表明原因在于"语言确定性"——强Worker更自信地传达结论，Manager更易执行。提出"异构集成验证"防御，将ASR从52.8%降至2.0%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统扩展了LLM能力但引入了新的攻击面，现有研究聚焦于提示注入等语法级攻击，忽视了通过语义叙事隐蔽传递有害请求的"语义劫持"攻击，且对智能体能力与系统安全性的关系缺乏理解。
AI.method: 1) 设计语义劫持攻击框架：有害请求隐藏在领域叙事中通过Worker报告传播给Manager；2) 在42,000次对抗试验中测试12种Manager模型和7种Worker配置；3) 进行多层次中介分析（47,807次交互），识别"语言确定性"作为中介变量；4) 提出异构集成验证防御：配对具有不对称领域能力的Worker。
AI.result: Worker能力增强时，系统ASR从18.4%升至63.9%，峰值达94.4%。中介分析表明语言确定性中介了74%的效果。异构集成验证将ASR从52.8%降至2.0%，且对良性任务影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 升级组件到更强模型会主动降低系统安全性；有效防御需要利用而非消除智能体之间的能力不对称性。
idea_en: Semantic hijacking attack method: A novel attack technique that conceals harmful requests within domain-specific narratives, propagating them through Worker reports to a Manager without any syntactic injection primitives.

Capability paradox security analysis framework: A systematic method for evaluating the counter-intuitive relationship between increased Worker capability and decreased system security in multi-agent LLM systems.

Multi-level mediation analysis for security evaluation: A technique using multi-level mediation analysis on large-scale interaction data (47,807 interactions) to identify linguistic certainty as the causal mechanism explaining the capability paradox.
Linguistic certainty metric: A method to quantify how confident assertiveness in Worker reports (driven by stronger models) influences Manager decision-making to execute potentially harmful requests.
Heterogeneous ensemble verification defense: A defense mechanism that pairs Workers with asymmetric domain competence so their complementary vulnerabilities break the certainty-to-execution chain.

Asymmetric Worker pairing for security: A technical method of deliberately using Workers with different capability levels in specific domains to exploit capability asymmetries for security enhancement rather than eliminating them.
idea_ch: 语义劫持攻击方法：一种新型攻击技术，将有害请求隐藏在特定领域叙事中，通过Worker报告传播给Manager，无需任何语法注入原语。
能力悖论安全分析框架：一种系统化方法，用于评估多智能体LLM系统中Worker能力增强反而导致系统安全性下降的反直觉关系。
多层次中介分析安全评估技术：一种基于大规模交互数据（47,807次交互）的多层次中介分析方法，识别'语言确定性'作为解释能力悖论的因果机制。
语言确定性度量方法：一种量化Worker报告中自信断言程度（由强模型驱动）如何影响Manager决策执行潜在有害请求的方法。
异构集成验证防御机制：一种配对具有不对称领域能力的Worker的防御方法，利用其互补脆弱性打破确定性到执行的链条。
非对称Worker配对增强安全技术：一种在特定领域故意使用不同能力水平Worker的技术方法，利用而非消除能力不对称性来增强安全性。

title: RAG-based EEG-to-Text Translation Using Deep Learning and LLMs
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summary: The decoding of linguistic information from electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains an extremely challenging problem in brain-computer interface (BCI) research. In particular, sentence-level decoding from EEG is difficult due to the low signal-to-noise ratio of these recordings. Previous studies tackling this problem have typically failed to surpass random baseline performance unless teacher forcing is used during the inference phase. In this work, we propose a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based sentence-level EEG-to-text decoding pipeline that combines an EEG encoder aligned with semantic sentence embeddings, a vector retrieval stage, and a large language model (LLM) to refine retrieved sentences into coherent output. Experiments are conducted on the Zurich Cognitive Language Processing Corpus (ZuCo) dataset, which contains single-trial EEG recordings collected during silent reading. To evaluate whether the system extracts meaningful information from these EEG signals, the results are compared with a random baseline. In nine subjects, the proposed pipeline outperforms the random baseline, achieving a mean cosine similarity of 0.181 +- 0.022 compared to 0.139 +- 0.029 for the baseline, corresponding to a relative improvement of 30.45%. Statistical analysis further confirms that this improvement is significant, following a strict evaluation workflow where inference is performed without access to ground-truth labels.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的句子级EEG到文本解码流水线，结合EEG编码器、向量检索和大语言模型，在ZuCo数据集上显著超越随机基线，平均余弦相似度提升30.45%。
AI.motivation: 现有的句子级EEG解码方法性能差，大多无法超越随机基线，尤其是在不使用教师强制（teacher forcing）的情况下。需要一种能从低信噪比的EEG信号中有效解码语言信息的方法。
AI.method: 采用检索增强生成（RAG）流水线：1) EEG编码器将信号映射到与语义句子嵌入对齐的向量空间；2) 向量检索阶段从知识库中检索最相关的句子候选；3) 大语言模型（LLM）对检索到的句子进行精炼，生成连贯的文本输出。推理时不使用真实标签。
AI.result: 在ZuCo数据集的9名受试者上，所提流水线平均余弦相似度0.181±0.022，相比随机基线0.139±0.029，相对提升30.45%，统计显著性得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的RAG-based EEG-to-text解码方法在不使用教师强制的情况下显著优于随机基线，验证了从EEG信号中提取语义信息的可行性，为脑机接口中的语言解码提供了新方向。
idea_en: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based sentence-level EEG-to-text decoding pipeline that combines an EEG encoder, vector retrieval stage, and large language model (LLM) for refining retrieved sentences.
An EEG encoder architecture aligned with semantic sentence embeddings, enabling direct mapping from brain signals to a semantic vector space for retrieval.
A vector retrieval stage that bridges EEG signal encoding and LLM-based text generation without requiring ground-truth labels during inference.
A strict evaluation workflow for EEG-to-text decoding that measures performance without teacher forcing, using cosine similarity against a random baseline.
Use of single-trial EEG recordings collected during silent reading for sentence-level decoding, demonstrating feasibility of extracting linguistic information from low-SNR brain signals.
idea_ch: 一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的句子级EEG到文本解码流水线，结合EEG编码器、向量检索阶段和大语言模型（LLM）对检索到的句子进行精炼。
一种与语义句子嵌入对齐的EEG编码器架构，实现从脑信号到语义向量空间的直接映射以进行检索。
一种连接EEG信号编码与LLM文本生成的向量检索阶段，推理时无需真实标签参与。
一种不使用教师强制（teacher forcing）的EEG到文本解码严格评估流程，使用余弦相似度与随机基线比较。
利用静默阅读过程中采集的单试次EEG记录进行句子级解码，验证了从低信噪比脑信号中提取语言信息的可行性。

title: Self-supervised Hierarchical Visual Reasoning with World Model
summary: 3D open-world environments with adversarial opponents remain a core challenge for reinforcement learning due to their vast state spaces. Effective reasoning representations are essential in such settings. While existing self-supervised visual foresight reasoning approaches often suffer from multi-step error accumulation, many recent studies resort to injecting domain-specific knowledge for more stable guidance. Our key insight is that the photorealistic fidelity of visual reasoning representations is secondary; what truly matters is providing informative, task-relevant signals. To this end, we propose ResDreamer, a hierarchical world model in which each higher-level layer is trained to reconstruct the residuals of the layer below. This design enables progressive abstraction of increasingly sophisticated world dynamics and fosters the emergence of richer latent representations. Drawing inspiration from the "Bitter Lesson", ResDreamer trains its reasoning representations in a purely self-supervised manner. The higher-level residual representations are used to modulate lower-level predictions, allowing the world model to scale effectively with only linearly increasing cross-layer communication costs. Experiments show that ResDreamer achieves state-of-the-art sample efficiency and parameter efficiency. This scalable hierarchical visual foresight reasoning architecture paves the way for more capable online RL agents in open-ended, dynamic environments. The code is accessible at \url{https://github.com/XuYuanFei01/ResDreamer}.

AI.tldr: ResDreamer提出了一种分层世界模型，每个高层层被训练去重建低层的残差，通过渐进式抽象实现视觉预见推理，在3D开放世界环境中达到SOTA样本效率和参数效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督视觉预见推理方法存在多步误差累积问题，许多研究转向注入领域特定知识。本文认为视觉推理表示的逼真度是次要的，重要的是提供信息丰富、任务相关的信号。
AI.method: 提出ResDreamer分层世界模型，每个高层层训练重建低层的残差，实现世界动态的渐进式抽象，高层残差表示用于调制低层预测，仅需线性增加的跨层通信成本。
AI.result: 在3D开放世界环境中实现了SOTA样本效率和参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 这种可扩展的分层视觉预见推理架构为开放动态环境中更强大的在线RL智能体铺平了道路。
idea_en: Hierarchical residual world model: A multi-layer world model architecture where each higher level reconstructs residuals of the lower level, enabling progressive abstraction of world dynamics without domain-specific knowledge injection.

Residual modulation mechanism: Higher-level residual representations modulate lower-level predictions, allowing the world model to scale effectively with only linearly increasing cross-layer communication costs.

Self-supervised hierarchical representation learning for RL: Purely self-supervised training of hierarchical reasoning representations that prioritize task-relevant information over photorealistic fidelity in 3D open-world reinforcement learning.

Progressive abstraction of world dynamics: A cascaded reconstruction framework that decomposes complex environment dynamics into progressively abstracted residual layers, reducing multi-step error accumulation in visual foresight reasoning.
idea_ch: 分层残差世界模型：一种多层世界模型架构，每个高层层被训练去重建低层的残差，实现对世界动态的渐进式抽象，无需注入领域特定知识。
残差调制机制：高层残差表示用于调制低层预测，使世界模型仅需线性增加的跨层通信成本即可有效扩展。
面向强化学习的自监督分层表示学习：在3D开放世界强化学习中，通过纯自监督方式训练分层推理表示，优先考虑任务相关信息而非视觉逼真度。
世界动态的渐进式抽象：一种级联重建框架，将复杂环境动态分解为渐进式抽象的残差层，减少视觉预见推理中的多步误差累积。

title: Memory-Guided Tree Search with Cross-Branch Knowledge Transfer for LLM Solver Synthesis
summary: Combinatorial optimization (CO) underlies decision-making from logistics to chip design, where infeasible solutions are operationally unusable and small quality gains translate into substantial economic value. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to automate solver synthesis: generating executable solver programs from natural-language specifications. However, existing tree-search and evolutionary agents refine candidate trajectories in parallel without explicit knowledge transfer, reintroducing the same constraint violations and converging on similar algorithm families. We introduce MEMOIR, a memory-guided tree-search framework with a two-level memory hierarchy: branch-local memory preserves execution-grounded refinement details within a branch as it iterates on a single algorithmic design, while global memory stores compressed algorithmic and failure-mode summaries across branches. A reflection step at branch termination distills these summaries, enabling cross-branch transfer without polluting future contexts with low-level debugging traces. Across seven CO problems spanning scheduling, routing, packing, and geometric design, MEMOIR achieves 96.7% solution validity (a 9.2 point gap over the strongest baseline) and improves the average normalized score by 7.3 points at matched per-method execution budget. Over three independent runs on four problems, MEMOIR's run-to-run validity standard deviation is more than an order of magnitude below that of every baseline we evaluated in this setting, suggesting that memory-guided exploration yields consistent improvements rather than reflecting sampling variance.

AI.tldr: MEMOIR是一个记忆引导的树搜索框架，通过两级记忆层次结构（分支局部记忆和全局记忆）来改进基于LLM的组合优化求解器合成，在七个CO问题上实现了96.7%的解有效性和7.3分的平均归一化分数提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的求解器合成方法中，树搜索和进化智能体在并行优化时缺乏知识转移，反复出现相同的约束违规并收敛到相似的算法族，导致解的有效性和质量受限。
AI.method: MEMOIR提出两级记忆层次结构：1) 分支局部记忆：在单个分支内保存执行验证的细粒度优化细节；2) 全局记忆：跨分支存储压缩后的算法摘要和失败模式。分支终止时通过反思步骤提炼摘要，实现跨分支知识转移而避免低层调试痕迹污染未来上下文。
AI.result: 在调度、路由、装箱和几何设计等七个CO问题上，MEMOIR实现96.7%解有效性（比最强基线高9.2个百分点），平均归一化分数提升7.3分，且运行间有效性标准差比所有基线低一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 记忆引导的探索能产生一致的性能提升，而非抽样方差所致，为自动化求解器合成中的知识积累提供了有效方案。
idea_en: A two-level memory hierarchy for LLM-based solver synthesis where branch-local memory stores execution-grounded refinement details and global memory stores compressed algorithmic and failure-mode summaries across branches.
A reflection step at branch termination that distills execution traces into compressed summaries for cross-branch knowledge transfer without context pollution.
Memory-guided tree-search framework that prevents reoccurrence of identical constraint violations across different optimization branches.
A method for storing and retrieving failure-mode patterns from prior solver generations to guide subsequent search iterations in combinatorial optimization.
idea_ch: 一种用于基于LLM的求解器合成的两级记忆层次结构：分支局部记忆保存执行验证的细粒度优化细节，全局记忆跨分支存储压缩的算法摘要和失败模式。
一种分支终止时的反思步骤机制，将执行轨迹提炼为压缩摘要，实现跨分支知识转移且避免上下文污染。
一种记忆引导的树搜索框架，防止不同优化分支间重复出现相同的约束违规问题。
一种从先前求解器生成中存储和检索失败模式的方法，用于引导后续组合优化的搜索迭代。

title: Evaluating Deep Research Agents on Expert Consulting Work: A Benchmark with Verifiers, Rubrics, and Cognitive Traps
summary:
Frontier deep research agents (DRAs) plan a research task, synthesize across documents, and return a structured deliverable on demand. They are being deployed in enterprise workflows faster than they are being evaluated. Existing benchmarks measure factual recall, single-hop QA, or generic agentic skill, missing the multi-document, decision-grade work DRAs are deployed to produce. We introduce a benchmark targeting the structured analytical deliverables that fill a management consultant's typical week.
  We grade three frontier agents, namely Claude Opus 4.6 with web search, OpenAI o3-deep-research, and Google Gemini 3.1 Pro deep-research, on 42 SME-authored prompts. Each of the 126 responses is scored on two layers: deterministic ground-truth verifiers (mean 13.8 per task) and a five-criterion 0-3 SME rubric, composed into a Verifier-Rubric Score (VRS) on 0-100. Most prompts embed cognitive traps that penalize surface-pattern matching. Acceptance under our joint threshold (rubric mean >= 2.5 and verifier rate >= 80%) is uniformly low: Gemini 21.4%, o3 9.5%, Claude 9.5%.
  Mean VRS scores agree with published rubric-based benchmarks (our top 62.6 vs. APEX-v1 64.2, ProfBench 65.9, ResearchRubrics < 68%), validating the rubric construct. ACCEPT rates sit below APEX-Agents' MC-segment Pass@1 band (12.3-22.7%) on dedicated DR agents; our floor is three points lower despite the harness advantage, opened by stricter conjunctive grading and trap design.
  Each agent fails distinctively. Claude produces the deliverable most reliably (4.5x the others' rate on file-required tasks) but carries the highest fabrication signature. o3 has the cleanest reasoning average yet drops required sections and propagates arithmetic errors. Gemini is bimodal, with the highest acceptance rate alongside the most zero-scored rubric cells.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对深度研究智能体（DRA）的基准测试，模拟管理顾问的分析交付物场景。测试了三个前沿智能体（Claude、o3、Gemini）在42个SME-authored提示上的表现，采用双重评分机制（确定性验证器+专家评分），发现所有智能体在接受阈值下表现均较低（21.4%/9.5%/9.5%），且各有不同的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅关注事实回忆、单跳问答或通用智能体技能，无法评估深度研究智能体在企业中实际执行的多文档、决策级分析工作。随着DRA在企业工作流中快速部署，需要一个针对结构化分析交付物的评估基准。
AI.method: 设计了42个SME-authored提示，模拟管理顾问典型周的分析交付物。对三个前沿智能体（Claude Opus 4.6、OpenAI o3-deep-research、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro deep-research）的126个响应进行双层评分：确定性ground-truth验证器（平均每个任务13.8个）和五维度0-3专家评分，组合成Verifier-Rubric Score (VRS)。提示中嵌入了认知陷阱以惩罚表面模式匹配。
AI.result: 联合阈值（rubric均值>=2.5且验证器率>=80%）接受率普遍较低：Gemini 21.4%、o3 9.5%、Claude 9.5%。平均VRS分数与已有基准一致（62.6 vs 64.2-68%）。各智能体失败模式不同：Claude交付最可靠但捏造最多；o3推理最清晰但遗漏必要部分；Gemini呈双峰分布。
AI.conclusion: 现有深度研究智能体在结构化分析任务上表现远远不够可靠，接受率极低。不同智能体有独特且互补的失败模式，表明当前DRA技术尚未成熟到可替代专业分析人员。
idea_en: A structured analytical deliverable evaluation system using multi-layer scoring (deterministic verifiers + SME rubric) for deep research agents, with cognitive traps embedded in prompts to penalize surface-pattern matching
A Verifier-Rubric Score (VRS) composed of ground-truth verifiers and multi-criterion rubric for assessing multi-document analytical work quality
A conjunctive joint threshold method (rubric mean >= 2.5 and verifier rate >= 80%) for determining acceptance of AI-generated analytical deliverables
A cognitive trap embedding technique for prompts that specifically targets surface-pattern matching vulnerabilities in large language models during research tasks
idea_ch: 一种用于深度研究智能体的结构化分析交付物评估系统，采用多层评分机制（确定性验证器+专家评分），并在提示中嵌入认知陷阱以惩罚表面模式匹配
一种由ground-truth验证器和多维度专家评分组成的Verifier-Rubric Score (VRS)评分方法，用于评估多文档分析工作质量
一种联合阈值判定方法（rubric均值>=2.5且验证器率>=80%），用于确定AI生成的分析交付物是否被接受
一种针对大语言模型研究任务的提示认知陷阱嵌入技术，专门攻击模型在分析任务中的表面模式匹配弱点

title: Generalization or Memorization? Brittleness Testing for Chess-Trained Language Models
summary: Recent work has fine-tuned language models on chess data and reported high benchmark scores as evidence that the resulting models can understand the rules of chess, play full chess games at a professional level, or generate human-readable explanations grounded in expert knowledge. We train KinGPT, a 25M-parameter character-level language model trained only on (position, best-move) pairs, who exceeds 3B-parameter ChessGPT on a 600-puzzle mate-in-N suite and 4B-parameter C1-4B over a 20-theme puzzle benchmark. We examine several claims made in existing literature regarding chess-trained language models and assert that their impressive benchmark performance is largely explained by pattern-matching. We also demonstrate how LLM-Modulo, a verifier-in-the-loop framework, raises RedPajama 3B's best move accuracy from 1.2% to 21.2% and move generation validity from 19.3% to 95.3% on mate-in-N chess puzzles, comparable to gains achieved from ChessGPT's fine-tuning on chess-specific web corpora at a fraction of the cost. Our results illustrate how pairing a general LLM with an external verifier offers a more flexible alternative to directly training on synthetic data for well-defined domains. We open source all training/evaluation code, datasets, puzzle samples, and KinGPT model checkpoints for reproducibility.
