title: Agents for Experiments, Experiments for Agents: A Design Grammar for AI-Enabled Experimental Science
summary: AI systems are becoming active participants in organizational and knowledge work. They increasingly interact with humans, coordinate workflows, and operate in multi-agent arrangements. Understanding their effects therefore requires more than measuring output accuracy; it requires evidence about mechanisms, delegation, feedback, and control. Experiments remain central to this task, but they also face a recursive challenge: we need experiments for agents to study these arrangements, and we may need agents for experiments to help search the expanding space of possible designs. Yet experimental conditions for human-AI and agentic workflows are still largely specified in prose, making them difficult to compare, reuse, or audit. We frame this as a problem of workflow representation, traceability, and governance in AI-enabled knowledge production. We introduce SEED (Structural Encoding for Experimental Discovery), a framework that represents experimental conditions as typed actor-flow graphs. SEED supports three design functions: describing conditions as interaction structures, evaluating structural novelty relative to encoded prior designs, and generating candidate designs under feasibility and governance constraints. We report a lightweight empirical feasibility test that compares graph-blind and SEEDguided generation in a medical-triage design task. In this diagnostic contrast, SEED-guided candidate designs show clearer actor-flow changes, assumptions, and governance checks, supporting the feasibility of the grammar as a design aid. The commentary closes by identifying governance tensions around novelty, replication, validity, diversity of inquiry, and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEED框架，将AI与人类协作的实验条件表示为类型化的参与者-流程图，以解决工作流表示、可追溯性和治理问题，并支持条件描述、结构新颖性评估和候选设计生成。
AI.motivation: AI系统正在成为组织与知识工作的积极参与者，但现有实验条件仍以自然语言描述，难以比较、复用或审计，缺乏结构化的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出SEED（Structural Encoding for Experimental Discovery）框架，将实验条件表示为类型化的参与者-流程图，支持三种设计功能：描述交互结构、评估结构新颖性、在可行性及治理约束下生成候选设计。
AI.result: 在医疗分诊设计任务中，SEED引导的候选设计相比盲生成展现出更清晰的参与者-流程变化、假设和治理检查，验证了该语法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: SEED框架为AI时代的工作流实验提供了结构化的表示与设计辅助工具，但仍面临新颖性、可重复性、有效性、研究多样性及问责性等治理张力。
idea_en: A typed actor-flow graph representation for encoding experimental conditions of human-AI and agentic workflows, enabling standardized comparison, reuse, and audit.
A structural novelty evaluation method for candidate workflow designs by comparing against an encoded library of prior designs.
A constrained generation mechanism for producing candidate experimental designs under feasibility and governance constraints using graph-based representations.
A grammar-based design aid framework that transforms prose-based experimental protocols into structured, machine-readable interaction graphs.
idea_ch: 一种类型化的参与者-流程图表示方法，用于编码人-AI及多智能体工作流的实验条件，支持标准化比较、复用和审计。
一种结构新颖性评估方法，通过将候选工作流设计与已编码的先前设计方案库进行对比来评估新颖性。
一种基于图的约束生成机制，在可行性和治理约束下生成候选实验设计方案。
一种基于语法的设计辅助框架，将基于自然语言的实验协议转换为结构化的、机器可读的交互图。

title: Surface-Form Neural Sparse Retrieval: Robust Fuzzy Matching for Industrial Music Search
summary: Music search at the scale of Amazon Music presents a unique challenge: queries frequently deviate from indexed metadata due to misspellings, transpositions, and phonetic variations, yet the retrieval system must operate under strict millisecond-level latency constraints. Our existing learning-to-retrieve system, the High Confidence Index (HCI), learns query-entity associations from customer behavior, relying on continual ``exploration'' to choose candidates. Traditional n-gram matching enables this exploration but suffers from poor semantic robustness and high noise, limiting the system's ability to learn from long-tail queries. In this work, we present a \textbf{robust neural sparse retrieval system} designed to maximize exploration efficiency. We adapt a state-of-the-art \textbf{inference-free} sparse retrieval architecture to the music domain, combining it with an effective \textbf{domain-specific granular subword tokenization strategy}. Our approach utilizes short-length token constraints (max 3 chars) to enforce the learning of surface-form robustness over lexical memorization. By pre-computing the neural embeddings and term expansions during the offline indexing phase, online processing is reduced to minimal tokenization and IDF weighting, achieving effectively zero latency overhead for query encoding. Evaluations on a 6M-document production corpus show an aggregate \textbf{91.4\%} recall@10 (vs. \textbf{57.7\%} for trigrams) at comparable throughput. Simulation of the HCI feedback loop demonstrates improved exploration efficiency, with \textbf{+0.8\%} higher stabilized recall than production trigrams. Ablation studies indicate that our sparse training methodology drives the performance gains, while domain-specific pretraining provides a cost-effective alternative to large-scale general-purpose pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的神经稀疏检索系统，用于Amazon Music的搜索场景。系统采用无推理的稀疏检索架构，结合领域特定的细粒度子词分词策略（最大3字符），通过离线预计算神经嵌入和词项扩展，实现零延迟在线查询编码。在600万文档的生产语料库上，召回率@10达到91.4%（对比三元组57.7%），同时保持可比吞吐量，并将HCI系统的探索效率提升0.8%。
AI.motivation: 音乐搜索面临查询与元数据不匹配（拼写错误、音变等）的挑战，传统n-gram匹配语义鲁棒性差、噪声高，限制了系统从长尾查询中学习的能力。需要一种能够在严格毫秒级延迟约束下，提升探索效率的鲁棒检索方法。
AI.method: 1）采用无推理的稀疏检索架构，离线预计算神经嵌入和词项扩展；2）设计领域特定的细粒度子词分词策略（最大3字符），强制学习表面形式鲁棒性；3）在线处理仅需最小化分词和IDF加权，实现零延迟开销；4）与现有HCI系统集成，提升探索效率。
AI.result: 在600万文档生产语料库上，召回率@10达91.4%（vs.三元组57.7%），吞吐量可比；HCI反馈循环模拟显示探索效率提升，稳定召回率比生产三元组高0.8%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的神经稀疏检索系统显著优于传统n-gram方法，领域特定预训练是大规模通用预训练的经济有效替代方案，稀疏训练方法是性能提升的关键驱动因素。
idea_en: A robust neural sparse retrieval system for music search using inference-free architecture with domain-specific granular subword tokenization (max 3 chars) to enforce surface-form robustness over lexical memorization.

A method for achieving zero-latency online query encoding by pre-computing neural embeddings and term expansions during offline indexing phase, reducing online processing to minimal tokenization and IDF weighting.
A domain-specific subword tokenization strategy for music metadata that constrains token length to maximum 3 characters to handle misspellings, transpositions, and phonetic variations.
Integration of neural sparse retrieval with learning-to-retrieve system (HCI) to improve exploration efficiency from long-tail queries through enhanced candidate selection.
An efficient sparse training methodology that achieves high recall (91.4% recall@10) using domain-specific pretraining as a cost-effective alternative to large-scale general-purpose pretraining.
idea_ch: 一种用于音乐搜索的鲁棒神经稀疏检索系统，采用无推理架构结合领域特定细粒度子词分词策略（最大3字符），强制学习表面形式鲁棒性而非词汇记忆。
一种实现零延迟在线查询编码的方法，通过在离线索引阶段预计算神经嵌入和词项扩展，将在线处理简化为最小化分词和IDF加权。
一种针对音乐元数据的领域特定子词分词策略，将令牌长度限制为最多3个字符，以处理拼写错误、换位和音变等查询变异。
一种将神经稀疏检索与学习到检索系统（HCI）集成的方法，通过增强候选选择提升从长尾查询中的探索效率。
一种高效的稀疏训练方法，利用领域特定预训练作为大规模通用预训练的经济有效替代方案，实现高召回率（91.4%召回率@10）。

title: Entropy-Gradient Inversion: Moving Toward Internal Mechanism of Large Reasoning Models
summary: The advancement of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) has catalyzed a paradigm shift from reactive ``fast thinking'' text generation to systematic, step-by-step ``slow thinking'' reasoning, unlocking state-of-the-art performance in complex mathematical and logical tasks. However, the field faces \textit{the fundamental gap between token-level behavioral analysis and internal reasoning mechanisms, and the instability of reinforcement learning (RL) for reasoning optimization relying on costly external verifiers}. We identify and formally define \textbf{Entropy-Gradient Inversion}, a robust negative correlation between token entropy and logit gradients that acts as a definitive geometric fingerprint for LRM reasoning capability. Building on this, we propose \textbf{Correlation-Regularized Group Policy Optimization (CorR-PO)}, which embeds this inversion signature into RL reward regularization. Extensive experiments on various reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales show CorR-PO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming that stronger inversion directly correlates with superior reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大推理模型（LRM）中熵-梯度反转（Entropy-Gradient Inversion）这一稳定的几何指纹，并据此提出相关性正则化组策略优化（CorR-PO），将这一反转特征嵌入RL奖励正则化中，显著提升了复杂推理任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 解决LRM领域两个核心问题：(1) token级行为分析与内部推理机制之间的根本鸿沟；(2) 依赖昂贵外部验证器的强化学习推理优化不稳定性。
AI.method: 首先发现并定义了熵-梯度反转（Entropy-Gradient Inversion）——token熵与logit梯度之间的稳健负相关关系，作为LRM推理能力的几何指纹；然后提出CorR-PO（相关性正则化组策略优化），将这种反转特征嵌入RL奖励正则化中，以替代昂贵的外部验证器。
AI.result: 在多种推理基准上、跨多个模型规模的实验中，CorR-PO持续优于最先进的基线方法，且更强的反转与更优的推理性能直接相关。
AI.conclusion: 熵-梯度反转是LRM推理能力的关键内在特征，CorR-PO通过将其嵌入RL正则化可有效提升推理性能，为无需外部验证器的推理优化提供了新路径。
idea_en: A method for evaluating reasoning capability of Large Reasoning Models by computing Entropy-Gradient Inversion, a negative correlation between token entropy and logit gradients, as a geometric fingerprint without external verifiers.

A reinforcement learning optimization framework named Correlation-Regularized Group Policy Optimization (CorR-PO) that embeds Entropy-Gradient Inversion signature into reward regularization to replace costly external verifiers.
A system for stabilizing reinforcement learning training for reasoning tasks by using internal geometric fingerprints (entropy-gradient correlation) as intrinsic reward signals.
A technique to detect and measure reasoning quality in language models through token-level entropy and logit gradient analysis, enabling real-time reasoning monitoring.
idea_ch: 一种通过计算token熵与logit梯度之间的负相关关系（熵-梯度反转）来评估大推理模型推理能力的方法，无需外部验证器即可作为推理能力的几何指纹。
一种名为相关性正则化组策略优化（CorR-PO）的强化学习优化框架，将熵-梯度反转特征嵌入奖励正则化中，替代昂贵的外部验证器。
一种利用内部几何指纹（熵-梯度相关性）作为内在奖励信号来稳定推理任务的强化学习训练的系统。
一种通过token级熵和logit梯度分析检测和衡量语言模型推理质量的技术，可实现实时推理监控。

title: STRIDE: A Self-Reflective Agent Framework for Reliable Automatic Equation Discovery
summary: LLM-based equation discovery offers a promising route to recovering symbolic laws from data, but many systems still rely on generation-centered loops that propose candidates, fit parameters, score results, and reuse selected examples. Such loops can misjudge useful skeletons under unreliable fitting, discard near-correct equations that require repair, and accumulate redundant memories that provide limited guidance. We propose STRIDE, a self-reflective agent framework that improves reliability by coordinating data-aware generation, mixed-fitting evaluation, critic--executor repair, and diversity-preserving semantic memory. By turning fitted scores and candidate behavior into shared feedback, STRIDE enables equations to be proposed, assessed, refined, and reused within a closed-loop discovery process. Experiments on representative symbolic-regression benchmarks and LSR-Synth suites show that STRIDE improves accuracy, OOD robustness, and structural recovery across multiple LLM backbones, with ablations and analyses confirming the contribution of its core components.

AI.tldr: STRIDE是一个自反思智能体框架，通过协调数据感知生成、混合拟合评估、批评者-执行者修复和多样性保持语义记忆，改进了基于LLM的符号方程发现，在多个基准上提升了准确率、OOD鲁棒性和结构恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的方程发现方法依赖生成中心循环（提出候选、拟合参数、评分、重用），存在三个问题：不可靠拟合下误判有用骨架、丢弃需要修复的接近正确方程、积累提供有限指导的冗余记忆。
AI.method: STRIDE框架包含四个核心组件：1) 数据感知生成（Data-aware Generation）；2) 混合拟合评估（Mixed-fitting Evaluation）；3) 批评者-执行者修复（Critic-Executor Repair）；4) 多样性保持语义记忆（Diversity-preserving Semantic Memory）。通过将拟合得分和候选行为转化为共享反馈，实现方程的闭环发现过程。
AI.result: 在符号回归基准和LSR-Synth数据集上的实验表明，STRIDE在多个LLM主干上提高了准确性、OOD鲁棒性和结构恢复能力。消融实验和进一步分析证实了其核心组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE通过自反思的智能体框架有效解决了现有LLM方程发现方法的核心缺陷，实现了更可靠、更准确的符号定律发现。
idea_en: A self-reflective agent framework for equation discovery that coordinates data-aware generation, mixed-fitting evaluation, critic-executor repair, and diversity-preserving semantic memory in a closed-loop process.

A mixed-fitting evaluation method that combines multiple fitting strategies to assess candidate equations, preventing premature discard of near-correct equations under unreliable single-fitting scenarios.

A critic-executor repair mechanism where one LLM agent (critic) identifies flaws in candidate equations and another (executor) performs targeted repairs, enabling refinement of near-correct symbolic expressions.

A diversity-preserving semantic memory system that stores equation candidates based on structural diversity rather than score alone, reducing redundant memories and providing more informative guidance for generation.
A closed-loop discovery process that converts fitted scores and candidate behavior into shared feedback across generation, evaluation, repair, and memory components.
A data-aware generation method that incorporates data characteristics into the LLM prompting process for more informed equation skeleton proposal.
idea_ch: 一种自反思智能体框架，通过协调数据感知生成、混合拟合评估、批评者-执行者修复和多样性保持语义记忆，在闭环过程中实现方程发现
一种混合拟合评估方法，结合多种拟合策略评估候选方程，防止在不可靠单拟合场景下过早丢弃接近正确的方程
一种批评者-执行者修复机制，由一个LLM智能体（批评者）识别候选方程缺陷，另一个（执行者）进行针对性修复，实现对接近正确符号表达式的精炼
一种多样性保持语义记忆系统，基于结构多样性（而非仅基于评分）存储候选方程，减少冗余记忆并为生成提供更具信息量的指导
一种闭环发现过程，将拟合得分和候选行为转化为跨生成、评估、修复和记忆组件的共享反馈
一种数据感知生成方法，将数据特征融入LLM提示过程，以提出更具信息量的方程骨架

title: Accelerating AI-Powered Research: The PuppyChatter Framework for Usable and Flexible Tooling
summary: This research addresses the challenges inherent in developing Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications, particularly those leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs). While AI vendors provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and Software Development Kits (SDKs) to facilitate developer interaction, the former often requires intricate manual request construction, and the latter can lead to significant vendor lock-in. Furthermore, existing model abstraction frameworks, though mitigating vendor dependency, introduce an additional layer of complexity and potential security concerns. To reconcile these conflicting factors, the study introduces PuppyChatter, a novel software framework designed to preserve the intuitive simplicity of vendor-specific SDKs while simultaneously adhering to the vendor-neutrality principles characteristic of model abstraction, thereby offering a more streamlined and flexible development paradigm.

AI.tldr: PuppyChatter是一个新型软件框架，旨在兼顾AI SDK的易用性与模型抽象的供应商中立性，解决LLM应用开发中的供应商锁定和复杂度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI应用开发中，直接使用API需要复杂的手动请求构建，SDK则导致严重的供应商锁定；模型抽象框架虽缓解了供应商依赖，但引入了额外的复杂性和安全风险。需要一种兼顾简便性和供应商中立性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出PuppyChatter框架，该框架融合了供应商SDK的直观简便性与模型抽象的供应商无关性原则，提供更精简、灵活的开发范式。
AI.result: PuppyChatter能够同时实现类似SDK的简便开发体验和跨供应商的模型抽象能力，减少了开发复杂度和供应商锁定风险。
AI.conclusion: PuppyChatter提供了一种兼顾简便性与中立性的折中方案，为LLM应用开发提供了更流畅灵活的开发范式。
idea_en: A unified software framework that provides SDK-like intuitive interfaces while internally implementing model abstraction to achieve vendor-neutral LLM interaction.
A dynamic plugin architecture for LLM abstraction layers that automatically adapts to different vendor APIs without requiring manual request construction.
A security-wrapper mechanism that sits between the developer's code and LLM vendors, enforcing security policies while maintaining SDK-like simplicity.
idea_ch: 一种统一软件框架，对外提供类似SDK的直观接口，内部实现模型抽象以达到与供应商无关的LLM交互能力。
一种LLM抽象层的动态插件架构，可自动适配不同供应商API，无需手动构建请求。
一种位于开发者代码与LLM供应商之间的安全包装机制，在保持SDK简便性的同时强制执行安全策略。

title: Going Headless? On the Boundaries of Vertical AI Firms
summary: Vertical AI firms in accounting, law, healthcare, procurement, and similar domains historically bundled workflow, domain logic, and accountability into a single application. General-purpose AI agents are now unbundling that package, prompting founders and investors to advocate "going headless": cede the workflow and interface to agents and expose domain expertise as callable services. This article argues that going headless is correct for some firms and destructive for others, and that the latter often cede their value capture inadvertently through architectural choices that look like interface decisions. This is a boundary question, and the answer turns on distinguishing the interface boundary, which can often move, from the accountability boundary, which often must not. Drawing on Coase's theory of the firm, Eisenmann, Parker, and Van Alstyne's platform envelopment framework, and Teece's analysis of complementary assets and appropriability, the article shows that orchestrators operating through open protocols acquire envelopment power even as technical interoperability improves, and that durable value capture concentrates in cospecialized accountability assets: professional signoff, regulated workflows, evidence trails, and trusted systems of record. The article proposes a three-position taxonomy (component, integrated software platform, dual-track) determined not by sector but by task-accountability regime, and formalizes the construct of rule debt: the future governance, maintenance, and accountability burden that accrues to customer organizations when business rules and professional standards migrate from governed systems into prompts and agent instructions. Four principles follow: decompose by accountability not interface, invert the edges while retaining the core, position rule debt as the customer cost the integrated platform prevents, and avoid single-orchestrator dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了垂直AI企业（如会计、法律、医疗等领域）在通用AI代理时代面临的"去头化"战略选择——即放弃工作流和界面层，将领域专业知识作为可调用服务暴露。文章提出应从问责边界而非界面边界来决策，并引入"规则债务"概念，提出三个位置的分类法和四条原则。
AI.motivation: 通用AI代理正在解构传统垂直AI企业将工作流、领域逻辑和问责打包在一起的模式。创始人投资者推崇"去头化"（放弃界面和工作流，只暴露领域服务），但这一策略对某些企业正确，对另一些则具有破坏性，需要厘清边界问题。
AI.method: 基于科斯的企业理论、Eisenmann等人的平台包围框架、Teece的互补资产与可appropriability分析，区分界面边界（可移动）与问责边界（不可移动），提出三位置分类法（组件、集成软件平台、双轨制）和规则债务概念。
AI.result: 提出了由任务-问责体制而非行业决定的三个位置分类法；形式化了"规则债务"概念——当业务规则和专业标准从受管系统迁移到提示词和代理指令时，客户组织积累的未来治理、维护和问责负担。
AI.conclusion: 四条原则：按问责而非界面分解；反转边缘保留核心；将规则债务定位为集成平台阻止的客户成本；避免单一协调者依赖。通过开放协议运营的协调者即使技术互操作性提升也会获得包围力量，持久价值集中在共同专业化的问责资产中。
idea_en: Rule Debt Quantification and Management System: A method for measuring, tracking, and managing 'rule debt'—the future governance, maintenance, and accountability burden that accrues when business rules migrate from governed systems to AI prompts and agent instructions.

Accountability Boundary Preservation Architecture: A system architecture design that maintains the accountability boundary (professional signoff, regulated workflows, evidence trails) while allowing the interface boundary to be flexible and modular.

Task-Accountability Regime Classification Engine: An AI-driven classification system that determines optimal vertical AI deployment strategy (component, integrated software platform, or dual-track) based on task-accountability regime rather than industry sector.

Cospecialized Accountability Asset Framework: A method for identifying and protecting durable value capture assets (professional signoff, trusted systems of record) when transitioning from bundled vertical applications to modular AI agent ecosystems.

Dual-Track Orchestration Platform: A platform architecture that simultaneously supports both integrated software delivery and headless API-based service exposure, with dynamic routing based on accountability requirements.
idea_ch: 规则债务量化管理系统：一种测量、追踪和管理'规则债务'的方法——即当业务规则从受管系统迁移到AI提示词和代理指令时产生的未来治理、维护和问责负担。
问责边界保留架构：一种系统架构设计，在允许界面边界灵活模块化的同时，维持问责边界（专业签核、监管工作流、证据链）。
任务-问责体制分类引擎：一种基于任务-问责体制而非行业部门来确定最佳垂直AI部署策略（组件、集成软件平台或双轨制）的AI驱动分类系统。
共同专业化问责资产框架：一种在从捆绑式垂直应用向模块化AI代理生态系统过渡时，识别和保护持久价值捕获资产（专业签核、可信记录系统）的方法。
双轨制编排平台：一种同时支持集成软件交付和无头API服务暴露的平台架构，可根据问责要求进行动态路由。

title: Interactive Evaluation Requires a Design Science
summary: AI evaluation is undergoing a structural change. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as systems that act over time through tools, environments, users, and other agents, while many evaluation practices still inherit assumptions from response-centered benchmarks (e.g., fixed inputs, isolated outputs, and outcome judgments that can be made from a single response). The field has begun to build interactive benchmarks, but the resulting landscape is fragmented: benchmarks differ in what interaction artifacts they admit, how trajectories are scored, and what claims their results support. This position paper argues that interactive evaluation should be treated as a principled evaluation paradigm, not merely a new family of agent benchmarks. Simply adopting previous evaluation paradigms does not suffice. We define evaluation as an autonomous mapping from evidence to judgments, and show that interactive evaluation changes both sides of this mapping: the evidence becomes interaction-generated trajectories, while the evaluation procedure must assess process, recoverability, coordination, robustness, and system-level performance. Building on this definition, we propose a two-axis taxonomy, derive design principles and reporting standards, examine representative scenarios, and analyze how longstanding evaluation challenges reappear at the trajectory level.

AI.tldr: 本文论证交互式评估应被视为一个独立的评估范式，而非仅仅是新型智能体基准测试，并提出了双轴分类法、设计原则和报告标准。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM越来越多地被部署为通过工具、环境、用户和其他代理随时间交互的系统，但现有评估实践仍沿用基于静态响应的基准测试范式（固定输入、孤立输出、单轮判断），导致交互式评估领域碎片化严重。
AI.method: 将评估定义为从证据到判断的自主映射，分析交互式评估如何改变了证据侧（交互生成的轨迹）和判断侧（需评估过程、可恢复性、协调性、鲁棒性和系统级性能），并在此基础上提出双轴分类法、设计原则和报告标准。
AI.result: 提出了交互式评估作为独立范式的理论框架，包括双轴分类法、设计原则和报告标准，并分析了代表性场景及长期评估挑战在轨迹层面的重现。
AI.conclusion: 交互式评估不应仅被视为新型智能体基准，而应作为有原则的评估范式；简单沿用先前的评估范式不足以应对交互式系统的评估需求。
idea_en: A two-axis taxonomy for classifying interactive evaluation benchmarks based on interaction artifacts and scoring methods.
Design principles and reporting standards specifically for interactive evaluation of AI systems.
A framework defining evaluation as autonomous mapping from evidence (trajectory-level) to judgments (process, recoverability, coordination, robustness, system-level).
idea_ch: 一种基于交互产物和评分方法对交互式评估基准进行分类的双轴分类法
专门针对AI系统交互式评估的设计原则和报告标准
将评估定义为从轨迹级证据到过程、可恢复性、协调性、鲁棒性和系统级性能判断的自主映射框架

title: Remembering More, Risking More: Longitudinal Safety Risks in Memory-Equipped LLM Agents
summary: Safety evaluations of memory-equipped LLM agents typically measure within-task safety: whether an agent completes a single scenario safely, often under adversarial conditions such as prompt injection or memory poisoning. In deployment, however, a single agent serves many independent tasks over a long horizon, and memory accumulated during earlier tasks can affect behavior on later, unrelated ones. Studying this regime requires evaluation along the temporal dimension across tasks: not whether an agent is safe at any single memory state, but how its safety profile changes as memory accumulates across many independent interactions. We call this failure mode temporal memory contamination. To isolate memory exposure from stream non-stationarity, we introduce a trigger-probe protocol that evaluates a fixed probe set against read-only memory snapshots at varying prefix lengths, together with a NullMemory counterfactual baseline for identifying memory-induced violations. We apply this protocol across three deployment scenarios spanning records, memos, forms, and email correspondence and eight memory architectures, and additionally on Claw-like AI agents, such as OpenClaw, using the platform's native memory mechanism. Memory-enabled agents consistently exceed the NullMemory baseline, and memory-induced violation rates show a robust upward trend with exposure length on both agent classes. Order-randomization experiments indicate that the effect is driven primarily by accumulated content rather than encounter order. Finally, a structural consequence of the event decomposition is that memory-induced risk is detectable from retrieval state before generation, which we confirm with a high-recall diagnostic monitor. Our results argue for treating memory safety as a longitudinal property that requires temporal evaluation, not a single-state property that can be captured by a snapshot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"时间记忆污染"概念，揭示记忆增强型LLM代理在跨任务场景中，记忆积累会导致安全违规率随时间增长，并设计了触发-探测协议（trigger-probe protocol）来隔离测量这一安全退化现象。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估仅关注单任务场景（within-task safety），忽略了部署时代理在多个独立任务间积累记忆对后续行为的影响。作者希望研究记忆随跨任务时间线积累时，代理安全概况如何变化。
AI.method: 提出触发-探测协议（trigger-probe protocol）：使用固定的探测集评估只读记忆快照在不同前缀长度下的表现，同时引入NullMemory反事实基线来识别记忆引发的违规行为。在记录、备忘录、表单、电子邮件等三类部署场景和八种记忆架构上测试，并扩展至OpenClaw等Claw类AI代理。
AI.result: 记忆增强代理一致超过NullMemory基线；记忆引发的违规率随暴露长度呈现稳健上升趋势；顺序随机化实验表明该效应主要由累积内容驱动而非遭遇顺序；从检索状态即可在生成前检测到记忆引发的风险。
AI.conclusion: 记忆安全应被视为一种纵向属性（longitudinal property），需要时间维度的评估，而非单状态属性；记忆安全需要跨任务的时序评估范式。
idea_en: Trigger-probe protocol for isolating temporal memory contamination in LLM agents across independent tasks
NullMemory counterfactual baseline for identifying memory-induced safety violations
Diagnostic monitor that detects memory-induced risk from retrieval state before generation
Order-randomization experimental framework to distinguish content accumulation vs. order effects in memory safety
Longitudinal safety evaluation framework treating memory safety as a temporal property rather than single-state snapshot
idea_ch: 触发-探测协议（Trigger-Probe Protocol）：通过固定探测集结合不同前缀长度的只读记忆快照，隔离测量跨任务时间记忆污染对安全的影响
NullMemory反事实基线方法：构建无记忆状态的对照基线，用于识别由记忆引发的安全违规行为
基于检索状态的记忆风险预检测监视器：在生成输出之前，从记忆检索状态中检测由记忆引发的安全风险，实现高召回率预警
顺序随机化实验框架：通过打乱任务执行顺序，区分记忆安全退化是由累积内容量驱动还是由遭遇顺序驱动
纵向安全评估范式：将记忆安全视为随时间演变的纵向属性，而非单一时间点的快照评估，建立跨任务的时序安全评估标准

title: KISS - Knowledge Infrastructure for Scientific Simulation: A Scaffolding for Agentic Earth Science
summary: Process-based simulation models encode decades of scientific understanding across the Earth sciences, yet the communities most exposed to climate risk and resource scarcity are the least able to use them. Here, we introduce knowledge infrastructure (KI), an agent-actionable scaffold that externalizes expertise into validated modelling operators, staged domain protocols, and diagnostic recovery mechanisms. Across a 3,000-trial coupled-hydrology benchmark, agents equipped with KI produced physically plausible, verifiable end-to-end simulations in up to 84% of trials, while agents without KI plateaued below 40%. KI generalizes across disciplines. We packaged its construction into a Knowledge Dissection Toolkit (KDT) that autonomously produced KI enabling end-to-end agent execution of 117 additional process-based models across 14 Earth-science domains. Across all 119 KIs, modelling decisions and failure remedies converged despite different underlying physics, showing that operational expertise is structured and extractable rather than ad hoc. Demonstrations show KI-equipped agents lowering both the access barrier between non-specialist users and process-based simulation, and the integration barrier between modelling communities. Through this scaffold, process-based science can then evolve as a living scientific commons, answerable to whoever needs to know and extendable by whoever can contribute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识基础设施（KI）框架，使AI代理能够自主执行基于过程的仿真模型，在3000次水文基准测试中成功率从低于40%提升至84%，并推广到14个地球科学领域的119个模型。
AI.motivation: 气候风险与资源匮乏的高危社区难以使用基于过程的仿真模型，这些模型编码了数十年科学理解但操作门槛极高。
AI.method: 构建知识基础设施（KI）——一种代理可操作的框架，包含验证过的建模算子、分阶段领域协议和诊断恢复机制。开发知识解剖工具包（KDT）自动生成KI。
AI.result: KI代理在84%试验中产生物理合理、可验证的仿真，无KI代理低于40%。KDT自动为14个地球科学领域117个额外模型生成KI。
AI.conclusion: 操作专业知识是可结构化提取的，KI可降低非专家使用门槛和跨学科集成门槛，推动过程科学作为活着的科学公地演进。
idea_en: Knowledge Infrastructure (KI) framework for agent-actionable process-based simulation, externalizing domain expertise into validated modeling operators, staged protocols, and diagnostic recovery mechanisms
Knowledge Dissection Toolkit (KDT) that autonomously constructs KI for any process-based model, enabling end-to-end agent execution across multiple Earth-science domains
Diagnostic recovery mechanisms within KI that enable agents to detect and remediate simulation failures autonomously, converging on correct solutions across different physical domains
idea_ch: 知识基础设施（KI）框架：将领域专家知识外部化为代理可操作的验证建模算子、分阶段领域协议和诊断恢复机制，使AI代理能自主执行复杂物理仿真
知识解剖工具包（KDT）：自动为任意基于过程的模型生成知识基础设施，实现跨地球科学领域（14个领域117个模型）的端到端代理执行
诊断恢复机制：嵌入KI中的自主故障检测与修复能力，使代理在不同物理背景下自动识别仿真错误并收敛到正确解决方案

title: PAIR: Prefix-Aware Internal Reward Model for Multi-Turn Agent Optimization
summary: A significant hurdle for current LLMs is the execution of complex, multi-stage tasks. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been emerging as a leading choice, but its reliance on sparse outcome rewards severely limits credit assignment across intermediate steps. Existing remedies such as running full rollouts to assign step-level advantages, calling external LLM judges at each step, or computing intrinsic rewards that require ground-truth answers at every evaluation introduce significant costs or practical constraints. We hypothesize that internal correctness probing over LLM hidden states can be repurposed as a step-level reward signal, potentially addressing all of these limitations at once. However, existing probing research assumes clean inputs, and we first show that this assumption breaks down in multi-step settings: hidden-state probes degrade severely under prefix contamination tracking coherence with the (possibly corrupted) prefix rather than grounded correctness, while attention-based features remain robust to contamination but underperform on clean prefixes. Building on this complementary relationship, we propose the Prefix-Aware Internal Reward (PAIR), a two-stage model with a frozen hidden-state probe estimating belief-consistency and a lightweight attention-based head correcting it toward grounded correctness. Experimental results show that PAIR achieves the highest AUROC on contaminated trajectories while operating at negligible inference cost, enabling dense step-level reward signals for GRPO training without external model calls, ground-truth dependencies, or full-trajectory rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出了PAIR方法，利用LLM内部状态探测作为步骤级奖励信号，解决GRPO在复杂多步任务中的信用分配问题，无需外部模型、真实答案或完整轨迹展开。
AI.motivation: GRPO在复杂多步任务中面临稀疏结果奖励导致的信用分配困难，现有方案（完整展开、外部LLM评判、内在奖励）成本高或实际受限。
AI.method: 提出PAIR（Prefix-Aware Internal Reward），一个两阶段模型：冻结的隐藏状态探测估计信念一致性，轻量级注意力头纠正为基于事实的正确性，利用两者互补特性提供稠密步骤级奖励。
AI.result: PAIR在污染轨迹上取得最高AUROC，推理成本极低，能为GRPO训练提供稠密步骤级奖励信号，无需外部模型调用、真实答案依赖或完整轨迹展开。
AI.conclusion: 内部正确性探测可被重新用作步骤级奖励信号，PAIR通过前缀感知设计克服了多步场景中探测退化问题，有效支撑GRPO训练。
idea_en: A method for generating step-level reward signals for LLM reinforcement learning by probing internal hidden states of the model, using a frozen hidden-state probe for belief-consistency estimation and a lightweight attention-based head for grounded correctness correction.
A two-stage internal reward model (PAIR) that combines complementary probing approaches to maintain robustness under prefix contamination in multi-step LLM reasoning trajectories.

A prefix-aware reward mechanism that distinguishes between coherence with the current prefix and grounded correctness, enabling accurate step-level credit assignment without external models or ground-truth answers.
A system for dense step-level reward signal extraction from LLM internal states during multi-stage tasks, operating at negligible inference cost without requiring full trajectory rollouts.
idea_ch: 一种通过探测LLM内部隐藏状态生成步骤级奖励信号的方法，使用冻结的隐藏状态探针估计信念一致性，并结合轻量级注意力头进行基于事实的正确性纠正。
一种两阶段内部奖励模型PAIR，结合互补的探测方法，在多步LLM推理轨迹的前缀污染场景下保持鲁棒性。
一种前缀感知奖励机制，区分当前前缀的连贯性与基于事实的正确性，无需外部模型或真实答案即可实现精确的步骤级信用分配。
一种从LLM内部状态中提取稠密步骤级奖励信号的系统，在多阶段任务中以极低推理成本运行，无需完整轨迹展开。

title: Evaluating Cognitive Age Alignment in Interactive AI Agents
summary: While agentic AI and its core multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable promise in language and visual reasoning across domains ranging from daily life to advanced scientific research, a profound gap remains between artificial and human intelligence. Despite the integration of powerful tools and advanced MLLMs, state-of-the-art AI agents frequently fail at foundational, seemingly simple tasks that a child can resolve with ease. Inspired by the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC), we introduce ChildAgentEval, the first psychometrically grounded interactive benchmark for evaluating cognitive age alignment in MLLM-based agents. ChildAgentEval systematically compares the reasoning performance of various MLLM-based interactive agents against age-specific human developmental stages, exposing where current agentic AI systems can and cannot simulate age-specific cognitive behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于心理测量学的交互式基准测试ChildAgentEval，用于评估多模态大语言模型代理的认知年龄对齐程度，揭示当前AI代理与人类儿童认知发展之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的AI代理在基础简单任务上频频失败，而儿童却能轻松完成，这表明AI与人类智能之间存在深刻差距，亟需系统性的认知年龄对齐评估方法。
AI.method: 借鉴韦克斯勒儿童智力量表(WISC)，构建ChildAgentEval基准，通过交互式测试系统比较不同MLLM代理在不同年龄段人类认知发展阶段的表现。
AI.result: 揭示了当前MLLM代理能够和无法模拟特定年龄认知行为的具体场景，暴露了AI系统在认知年龄对齐方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发更具认知对齐能力的AI代理，缩小人工与人类智能在基础认知任务上的差距。
idea_en: A psychometrically grounded interactive benchmark system (ChildAgentEval) for evaluating cognitive age alignment in multimodal large language model-based agents, which systematically compares agent reasoning performance against age-specific human developmental stages based on the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC).

A method for exposing where AI agent systems can and cannot simulate age-specific cognitive behavior by structured interactive testing derived from standardized child intelligence assessment protocols.

An evaluation framework that maps MLLM-based agent capabilities to human cognitive developmental stages, enabling quantitative measurement of the cognitive age gap between artificial and human intelligence.
idea_ch: 一种基于心理测量学的交互式基准系统ChildAgentEval，用于评估多模态大语言模型代理的认知年龄对齐程度，基于韦克斯勒儿童智力量表(WISC)系统性地比较代理推理能力与特定年龄段人类认知发展阶段的匹配度。
一种通过结构化交互测试揭示AI代理系统在哪些方面能够/无法模拟特定年龄段认知行为的方法，该方法源自标准化儿童智力评估协议。
一种将MLLM代理能力映射到人类认知发展阶段的评估框架，能够定量测量人工与人类智能之间的认知年龄差距。

title: DuIVRS-2: An LLM-based Interactive Voice Response System for Large-scale POI Attribute Acquisition
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Industry Track. 14 pages, including appendix
summary: Accurate Point of Interest (POI) attribute acquisition is essential for location-based services, yet traditional modular Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems suffer from error accumulation and high maintenance overhead. We present DuIVRS-2, a large language model (LLM)-based end-to-end framework designed for large-scale POI attribute acquisition at Baidu Maps. To address the long-tail distribution of real-world interactions, our methodology first employs a finite state machine (FSM)-guided data augmentation strategy to synthesize a balanced and diverse training dataset. We then streamline dialogue management via a selective generation scheme combined with a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism, which ensures output stability and effectively eliminates hallucinations in industrial settings. To facilitate continuous policy refinement with minimal manual effort, we design a cooperative iterative learning framework that leverages a dual-evaluator voting system. Deployed in production for two months, DuIVRS-2 processed 0.4 million calls daily and achieved a 83.9\% Task Success Rate (TSR), outperforming its predecessor by 4 percentage points while maintaining a low reaction time of 130ms. This work provides a production-proven reference for developing robust, cost-effective LLM agents for large-scale industrial dialogue applications.

AI.tldr: DuIVRS-2是一个基于大语言模型的端到端框架，用于百度地图大规模POI属性采集，通过FSM引导的数据增强、选择性生成与CoT机制、以及双评估器协同迭代学习，日处理40万通话，任务成功率83.9%，反应时间130ms。
AI.motivation: 传统模块化IVR系统存在错误累积和维护成本高的问题，且真实交互数据呈长尾分布，亟需一种鲁棒、低成本的端到端框架解决大规模POI属性采集中的工业级挑战。
AI.method: 1) FSM引导的数据增强策略，合成平衡且多样化的训练数据集；2) 选择性生成方案结合Chain-of-Thought机制，确保输出稳定性并消除幻觉；3) 双评估器投票系统的协同迭代学习框架，实现最小人工干预下的持续策略优化。
AI.result: 在百度地图生产环境部署两个月，每日处理40万通话，任务成功率达83.9%，相比前代提升4个百分点，反应时间仅130ms。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开发稳健、高性价比的大规模工业对话应用LLM智能体提供了经过生产验证的参考方案。
idea_en: FSM-guided data augmentation strategy for synthesizing balanced and diverse training datasets in dialogue systems, addressing long-tail distribution problems.
Selective generation scheme combined with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism to ensure output stability and eliminate hallucinations in LLM-based dialogue systems.
Cooperative iterative learning framework with dual-evaluator voting system for continuous policy refinement requiring minimal manual effort.
End-to-end LLM-based IVR framework for large-scale POI attribute acquisition with low latency (130ms) and high task success rate.
idea_ch: 基于有限状态机(FSM)引导的数据增强策略，用于合成平衡且多样化的对话系统训练数据集，解决长尾分布问题。
选择性生成方案结合思维链(CoT)机制，确保基于LLM的对话系统输出稳定性并消除工业场景中的幻觉。
基于双评估器投票系统的协同迭代学习框架，实现最小人工干预下的对话策略持续优化。
端到端基于大语言模型的IVR框架，用于大规模POI属性采集，实现低延迟(130ms)和高任务成功率。

title: LAST-RAG: Literature-Anchored Stochastic Trajectory Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Conditioned Degradation Model Selection
summary: Stochastic-process-based degradation modeling is a core approach for estimating the distribution of remaining useful life (RUL); however, the selection of an appropriate stochastic process has not been sufficiently addressed. Existing model selection methods mainly rely on the statistical fit of the observed health indicator (HI) trajectory, but this approach may select a model that is inconsistent with the underlying degradation mechanism when the observation window is short or the signal is highly noisy. To address this issue, this paper proposes Literature-Anchored Stochastic Trajectory Retrieval-Augmented Generation (LAST-RAG). The proposed method uses both the observed HI trajectory and domain-specific context, and hierarchically conditions the candidate degradation model space based on theoretical and mechanical evidence retrieved from a local evidence bank. In addition, Rule-based Confidence Reasoning with Uncertain State (RCRUS) is introduced to prevent candidate models from being prematurely eliminated when hierarchical decisions are uncertain. Simulation-based experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms statistical, prognostic, and uncertainty-aware baselines in both Wiener/gamma family classification and detailed degradation model classification. Ultimately, this study reframes degradation model selection from a purely statistical goodness-of-fit problem into a knowledge-conditioned decision-making problem that integrates observed data with domain knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAST-RAG方法，将退化模型选择从统计拟合问题重构为知识条件决策问题，通过检索增强生成技术结合观测轨迹与领域知识，并引入RCRUS防止层级决策不确定时模型被过早淘汰，在仿真实验中优于统计、预测及不确定性基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有退化模型选择方法主要依赖健康指标轨迹的统计拟合度，但在观测窗口短或信号噪声大时，可能选出与底层退化机制不一致的模型。需解决如何将领域知识与观测数据融合以进行更可靠的模型选择问题。
AI.method: 提出LAST-RAG方法：1) 同时利用观测HI轨迹和领域特定上下文；2) 基于从本地证据库检索的理论和力学证据，分层约束候选退化模型空间；3) 引入RCRUS（基于规则的不确定状态置信推理），防止层级决策不确定时候选模型被过早淘汰。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，所提方法在Wiener/gamma族分类和详细退化模型分类任务中，均优于统计基线、预测基线和不确定性感知基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将退化模型选择从纯统计拟合问题重构为知识条件决策问题，通过整合观测数据与领域知识实现更可靠的模型选择。
idea_en: 1. Literature-Anchored Stochastic Trajectory Retrieval-Augmented Generation (LAST-RAG): A method that combines observed HI trajectory with domain-specific context retrieved from a local evidence bank to hierarchically constrain the candidate degradation model space for RUL estimation.

2. Rule-based Confidence Reasoning with Uncertain State (RCRUS): A reasoning mechanism that prevents premature elimination of candidate degradation models when hierarchical decisions are uncertain, enabling robust model selection under noisy conditions.

3. Knowledge-conditioned degradation model selection framework: Reframes model selection from a purely statistical goodness-of-fit problem into a decision-making process that integrates observed data with domain knowledge for enhanced reliability.
idea_ch: 1. 文献锚定随机轨迹检索增强生成方法(LAST-RAG)：将观测的健康指标轨迹与从本地证据库检索的领域特定上下文相结合，分层约束候选退化模型空间，用于剩余寿命分布估计。
2. 基于规则的不确定状态置信推理(RCRUS)：一种推理机制，在层级决策不确定时防止候选退化模型被过早淘汰，在噪声条件下实现鲁棒的模型选择。
3. 知识条件退化模型选择框架：将模型选择从纯统计拟合问题重构为整合观测数据与领域知识的决策过程，提高选择的可靠性。

title: Agentic Chunking and Bayesian De-chunking of AI Generated Fuzzy Cognitive Maps: A Model of the Thucydides Trap
summary: We automatically generate feedback causal fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) from text by teaching large-language-model agents to break the text into overlapping chunks of text. Convex mixing of these chunk FCMs gives a representative cyclic FCM knowledge graph. The text chunks can have different levels of overlap. The chunk FCMs still mix to form a new FCM causal knowledge graph. The mixing technique scales because it uses light computation with sparse causal chunk matrices. The mixing structure allows an operator-level type of Bayesian inference that produces "de-chunked" or posterior-like FCMs from the mixed FCM. These de-chunked FCMs are useful in their own right and allow further iterations of Bayesian updating. We demonstrate these mixing techniques on the essay text of Allison's "Thucydides Trap" model of conflict between a dominant power such as the United States and a rising power such as China. The FCM dynamical systems predict outcomes as they equilibrate to fixed-point or limit-cycle attractors. Seven out of 8 FCM knowledge graphs predicted a type of war when we stimulated them by turning on and keeping on the concept node that stands for the rising power's ambition and entitlement. Gemini 3.1 LLMs served as the chunking AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从文本自动生成反馈因果模糊认知图（FCM）的方法，通过让大语言模型代理将文本分解为重叠文本块，对块FCM进行凸混合形成循环FCM知识图谱，并支持算子级贝叶斯推理产生"去块化"的后验FCM。在"修昔底德陷阱"文本上的实验表明，8个FCM知识图谱中有7个在刺激"崛起大国的野心与权利"概念节点时预测了战争。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以从非结构化文本中自动提取因果知识并构建可反馈推理的认知图，缺乏高效的文本分块与融合机制。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型代理将文本分解为重叠文本块，为每个块构建FCM，通过凸混合（convex mixing）合并稀疏因果块矩阵形成循环FCM知识图谱，并引入算子级贝叶斯推理实现"去块化"后验FCM更新。
AI.result: 在Allison的"修昔底德陷阱"文本上，8个FCM知识图谱中有7个在持续激活"崛起大国的野心与权利"节点时预测了战争（收敛到不动点或极限环吸引子）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可规模化地从文本构建因果FCM知识图谱，支持贝叶斯推理式更新，为文本到因果动力学建模提供了新途径。
idea_en: A method for automatically generating causal fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) from text by using LLM agents to decompose text into overlapping chunks and performing convex mixing of chunk-level sparse causal matrices.
An operator-level Bayesian inference technique that produces 'de-chunked' posterior-like FCMs from mixed FCMs, enabling iterative Bayesian updating on causal knowledge graphs.
A scalable mixing architecture for combining multiple overlapping textual chunk FCMs into a unified cyclic causal knowledge graph using lightweight sparse matrix operations.
A system using FCM dynamical systems with fixed-point or limit-cycle attractor analysis to predict geopolitical conflict outcomes from textual narratives.
idea_ch: 一种利用大语言模型代理将文本分解为重叠文本块，并通过凸混合合并稀疏因果块矩阵，自动从文本生成因果模糊认知图（FCM）的方法。
一种算子级贝叶斯推理技术，从混合FCM中产生'去块化'的后验式FCM，支持因果知识图谱上的迭代贝叶斯更新。
一种可扩展的混合架构，通过轻量级稀疏矩阵运算将多个重叠文本块的FCM合并为统一的循环因果知识图谱。
一种利用FCM动力系统的不动点或极限环吸引子分析，从文本叙事中预测地缘政治冲突结果的系统。

title: Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV): A Provably Deterministic Governance-Aware JIT Compiler Architecture for Agentic Systems
comment: 11 pages, 3 TikZ figures, 1 table. Bounded TLA+ formal specification and model checking verification logs included as supplementary artifacts
summary: As autonomous agentic systems scale across regulated critical infrastructures, the lack of mechanistic, hardware-rooted enforcement for high-frequency policy updates presents a fundamental safety gap. We introduce Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV), a novel architectural framework for the formal verification of AI governance policies at runtime. Unlike retrospective auditing frameworks (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF) which introduce 14-30 day latencies, EHV relocates the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) into the inference pipeline via a Governance-Aware Just-In-Time (JIT) Compiler. By integrating Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) for policy synchronization and Epoch-based Attestation Caching within Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), EHV achieves Sub-millisecond Formal Determinism (SMFD). We demonstrate via TLA+ formal verification that non-compliant agentic actions are computationally unreachable within the system's bounded operating state space. We prove that O(1) runtime enforcement can eliminate the traditional trade-off between deployment velocity and governance integrity, reducing Governance Latency from O(days) to O(1).

AI.tldr: EHV是一种将AI治理策略实时嵌入推理管线的架构框架，通过JIT编译器、CRDT和TEE实现亚毫秒级策略强制执行，使不合规的智能体动作在计算上不可达。
AI.motivation: 自治智能体系统在关键基础设施中规模化部署，现有AI治理框架（如ISO/IEC 42001、NIST AI RMF）存在14-30天的审计延迟，无法满足高频策略更新的实时合规需求，构成了根本性的安全缺口。
AI.method: 提出EHV架构：1）将策略执行点（PEP）通过治理感知的JIT编译器嵌入推理管线；2）使用无冲突复制数据类型（CRDT）进行策略同步；3）在可信执行环境（TEE）中实现基于周期的认证缓存；4）通过TLA+形式化验证，确保不合规动作在系统有界状态空间中计算不可达。
AI.result: 达到亚毫秒级形式确定性（SMFD）；治理延迟从数天（O(days)）降至常数时间（O(1)）；证明运行时强制执行可消除部署速度与治理完整性之间的传统权衡。
AI.conclusion: EHV证明了在自治智能体系统中实现硬件根信任的实时策略强制执行是可行的，为关键基础设施中的AI安全治理提供了新的范式。
idea_en: A Governance-Aware Just-In-Time (JIT) Compiler that relocates the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) into the AI inference pipeline, enabling sub-millisecond runtime policy verification.
Integration of Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) with Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for real-time policy synchronization and attestation caching in autonomous agentic systems.
A formal verification method using TLA+ to prove that non-compliant agentic actions are computationally unreachable within the system's bounded operating state space.
Epoch-based Attestation Caching mechanism within TEEs that achieves O(1) runtime enforcement latency for AI governance policies.
A hardware-rooted, mechanistic policy enforcement architecture that eliminates the trade-off between deployment velocity and governance integrity in regulated critical infrastructures.
idea_ch: 一种治理感知的即时（JIT）编译器，将策略执行点（PEP）嵌入AI推理管线，实现亚毫秒级运行时策略验证。
无冲突复制数据类型（CRDT）与可信执行环境（TEE）的集成方法，用于自治智能体系统中的实时策略同步与认证缓存。
基于TLA+的形式化验证方法，证明不合规的智能体动作在系统有界运行状态空间中计算不可达。
TEE内的基于周期的认证缓存机制，实现AI治理策略的O(1)运行时强制执行延迟。
一种硬件根信任的机制化策略执行架构，消除了受监管关键基础设施中部署速度与治理完整性之间的权衡。

title: SVFSearch: A Multimodal Knowledge-Intensive Benchmark for Short-Video Frame Search in the Gaming Vertical Domain
summary: Multimodal large language models are increasingly used as agent backbones that understand multimodal inputs, plan retrieval actions, invoke external tools, and reason over retrieved information. Yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate this ability in short-video applications, where a paused frame is often visually ambiguous and answering requires vertical, long-tail, and fast-evolving domain knowledge. We introduce SVFSearch, the first open benchmark for short-video frame search in the Chinese gaming domain. SVFSearch contains 5,000 four-choice test examples and 4,198 auxiliary training examples, each centered on a paused game scene from a real short-video clip. To support fair and reproducible evaluation, SVFSearch provides a frozen offline retrieval environment with a game-domain text corpus, a topic-linked image gallery, and text, image, and multimodal retrieval interfaces, avoiding reliance on uncontrolled web search APIs. We evaluate representative paradigms ranging from direct QA and RAG workflow to Plan-Act-Replan agents and learned search models. Results reveal a large gap between model-only answering, practical agentic search, and oracle knowledge: the best open-source direct-QA model reaches 66.4%, the best practical agent achieves 79.1%, and oracle knowledge reaches 95.4%. Further analysis exposes bottlenecks in visual grounding, retrieval quality, evidence-grounded reasoning, and tool-use behavior, including over-search, answer-only shortcuts, and retrieval-induced misleading.

AI.tldr: SVFSearch是一个面向中文游戏领域短视频帧搜索的开源基准测试，包含5000道四选一测试题和4198个辅助训练样本，通过冻结的离线检索环境评估多模态大语言模型在视觉模糊、垂直长尾知识场景下的智能体搜索能力。实验显示最佳开源模型准确率66.4%，最佳智能体79.1%，而先知知识可达95.4%，揭示了视觉定位、检索质量、证据推理和工具使用等方面的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少评估多模态大语言模型在短视频应用中的智能体能力，尤其是在暂停帧视觉模糊、需要垂直领域长尾知识的场景下。
AI.method: 构建了SVFBench基准测试，包含5,000个四选一测试样本和4,198个辅助训练样本，每个样本基于真实短视频中的暂停游戏场景；提供冻结的离线检索环境，包括游戏领域文本语料库、主题链接图片库以及文本、图像和多模态检索接口。
AI.result: 最佳开源直接QA模型准确率66.4%，最佳实践智能体79.1%，先知知识95.4%。存在过度搜索、仅回答捷径、检索误导等瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在短视频帧搜索任务上距离理想性能仍有较大差距，主要瓶颈在视觉定位、检索质量、证据推理和工具使用行为方面。
idea_en: A frozen offline retrieval environment for short-video frame search that provides text, image, and multimodal retrieval interfaces with a game-domain text corpus and topic-linked image gallery, avoiding reliance on uncontrolled web search APIs
A benchmark construction method for creating four-choice test examples from paused frames in real short-video clips, specifically designed for short-video frame search in the Chinese gaming domain
An evaluation framework that compares direct QA, RAG workflow, Plan-Act-Replan agents, and learned search models on short-video frame search tasks
idea_ch: 一种用于短视频帧搜索的冻结离线检索环境，提供文本、图像和多模态检索接口，配备游戏领域文本语料库和主题链接图片库，避免依赖不可控的网络搜索API
一种从真实短视频暂停帧中构建四选一测试样本的基准测试构建方法，专为中文游戏领域的短视频帧搜索设计
一种评估框架，用于比较直接问答、RAG工作流、规划-行动-重规划智能体和学习型搜索模型在短视频帧搜索任务上的性能表现

title: Reconciling Contradictory Views on the Effectiveness of SFT in LLMs: An Interaction Perspective
summary: This paper explores a scientific question in supervised fine-tuning (SFT): why SFT is broadly effective for small-scale deep neural networks, yet can produce inconsistent or even detrimental effects when applied to large language models (LLMs). Recent advances in interaction-based explanations suggest that interactions between words/tokens provide a faithful metric for quantifying the inference patterns encoded by LLMs. We find that the evolution of interactions during SFT can effectively explain the inconsistent effectiveness of SFT for LLMs. Specifically, we find that (1) SFT primarily removes noise-like interactions, while rarely acquiring reliable new interactions. (2) This denoising stage is extremely brief, after which continued fine-tuning tends to introduce overfitted interactions. We validate these findings across multiple LLMs and datasets. Our findings provide new insights into early stopping and offer practical guidance for LLM training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了监督微调(SFT)在大型语言模型(LLMs)上效果不一致的原因，发现SFT主要通过去除噪声交互来发挥作用，且这一去噪阶段极其短暂，之后继续微调会导致过拟合交互的引入。
AI.motivation: 探索为什么SFT对于小规模深度神经网络广泛有效，但对LLMs却可能产生不一致甚至有害的效果。
AI.method: 基于交互可解释性(interaction-based explanations)的方法，量化LLMs编码的推理模式，通过分析SFT过程中交互的演变来解释其效果差异。
AI.result: (1) SFT主要移除噪声类交互，很少获取可靠的新交互；(2) 去噪阶段极其短暂，之后继续微调会引入过拟合交互。
AI.conclusion: SFT对LLMs的效果主要源于去噪而非学习新知识，这为早停策略提供了新见解，并为LLM训练提供了实用指导。
idea_en: A method for monitoring and controlling the fine-tuning process of large language models based on interaction-based noise analysis, where the model's interaction patterns are tracked to determine optimal early stopping points.
A system for detecting overfitting in LLM fine-tuning by analyzing the emergence of spurious interactions between tokens beyond a critical threshold.
A technique for selectively removing noise-like interactions from LLMs during SFT while preventing the introduction of overfitted interactions through adaptive training duration control.
A method for quantifying the denoising effectiveness of SFT on LLMs by measuring the reduction in noise-like interactions relative to newly acquired interactions.
idea_ch: 一种基于交互噪声分析的大语言模型微调过程监测与控制方法，通过跟踪模型交互模式来确定最优早停点。
一种通过分析词元间虚假交互出现情况来检测LLM微调过拟合的系统，在超过临界阈值时触发停止机制。
一种在SFT过程中选择性移除LLM中噪声类交互，同时通过自适应训练时长控制防止过拟合交互引入的技术。
一种通过测量噪声类交互减少量与新增交互量的比率来量化SFT对LLM去噪效果的方法。

title: Unleashing LLMs in Bayesian Optimization: Preference-Guided Framework for Scientific Discovery
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. 10 pages main paper, 21 pages appendix, 26 figures
summary: Scientific discovery is increasingly constrained by costly experiments and limited resources, underscoring the need for efficient optimization in AI for science. Bayesian Optimization (BO), though widely adopted for balancing exploration and exploitation, often exhibits slow cold-start performance and poor scalability in high-dimensional settings, limiting its applicability in real-world scientific problems. To overcome these challenges, we propose LLM-Guided Bayesian Optimization (LGBO), the first LLM preference-guided BO framework that continuously integrates the semantic reasoning of large language models (LLMs) into the optimization loop. Unlike prior works that use LLMs only for warm-start initialization or candidate generation, LGBO introduces a region-lifted preference mechanism that embeds LLM-driven preferences into every iteration, shifting the surrogate mean in a stable and controllable way. Theoretically, we prove that LGBO does not perform significantly worse than standard BO in the worst case, while achieving significantly faster convergence when preferences align with the objective. Empirically, LGBO consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse dry benchmarks in physics, chemistry, biology, and materials science. Most notably, in a new wet-lab optimization of Fe-Cr battery electrolytes, LGBO attains \textbf{90\% of the best observed value within 6 iterations}, whereas standard BO and existing LLM-augmented baselines require more than 10. Together, these results suggest that LGBO offers a promising direction for integrating LLMs into scientific optimization workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出了LLM引导的贝叶斯优化框架(LGBO)，通过区域提升偏好机制将大语言模型的语义推理持续融入优化循环，在多个科学领域基准测试及电池电解液湿实验优化中显著提升收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化在高维科学问题中冷启动慢、可扩展性差，限制了其在实际科学发现中的应用。
AI.method: 提出LGBO框架，引入区域提升偏好机制(region-lifted preference mechanism)，将LLM驱动的偏好嵌入每一轮迭代，以稳定可控的方式偏移代理均值，实现LLM语义推理与BO优化循环的持续融合。
AI.result: 在物理、化学、生物、材料科学等多个干实验基准上持续优于现有方法；在Fe-Cr电池电解液湿实验优化中，6次迭代达到最优值的90%，而标准BO和LLM增强基线需10次以上。
AI.conclusion: LGBO为将LLM集成到科学优化工作流中提供了有前景的方向，理论上证明在最坏情况下不显著差于标准BO，偏好与目标对齐时可实现更快收敛。
idea_en: A region-lifted preference mechanism for embedding LLM-driven preferences into every iteration of Bayesian optimization, shifting the surrogate mean in a stable and controllable manner.

An LLM-guided Bayesian optimization framework (LGBO) that continuously integrates semantic reasoning of large language models into the optimization loop, rather than only for warm-start initialization or candidate generation.

A theoretical guarantee framework proving that LLM-preference-guided BO does not perform significantly worse than standard BO in worst-case scenarios while achieving faster convergence when preferences align with objectives.
A method for accelerating wet-lab optimization of battery electrolytes (Fe-Cr) using LLM-guided Bayesian optimization, achieving 90% of best observed value within 6 iterations.

A cross-disciplinary scientific optimization approach combining LLM semantic reasoning with Bayesian optimization surrogate modeling for physics, chemistry, biology, and materials science applications.
idea_ch: 一种区域提升偏好机制，将LLM驱动的偏好嵌入贝叶斯优化的每一轮迭代，以稳定可控的方式偏移代理模型的均值
一种LLM引导的贝叶斯优化框架(LGBO)，将大语言模型的语义推理持续融入优化循环，而非仅用于热启动初始化或候选生成
一种理论保证框架，证明LLM偏好引导的BO在最坏情况下不显著差于标准BO，且在偏好与目标一致时实现更快收敛
一种利用LLM引导贝叶斯优化加速Fe-Cr电池电解液湿实验优化的方法，6次迭代内达到最佳观测值的90%
一种跨学科科学优化方法，将LLM语义推理与贝叶斯优化代理建模相结合，适用于物理、化学、生物学和材料科学应用

title: Shared Backbone PPO for Multi-UAV Communication Coverage with Connection Preservation
summary: This paper proposes a Shared Backbone Proximal Policy Optimization (Shared Backbone PPO) algorithm. By sharing the base module between the Actor and Critic networks, the algorithm achieves efficient training and improved performance. The algorithm is implemented in a connectivity-preserving multi-UAV swarm communication coverage task and compared with the standard PPO algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance. Furthermore, a graph information aggregation module is incorporated into the model architecture to accommodate the communication conditions among agents. With the integration of this module, the algorithm remains effective, and the trained agent swarm exhibits a higher level of cooperation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种共享骨干网络的PPO算法（Shared Backbone PPO），通过Actor和Critic网络共享基础模块实现高效训练，并在多无人机通信覆盖任务中验证了其优越性能。同时引入图信息聚合模块以增强智能体间的协作。
AI.motivation: 标准PPO算法中Actor和Critic网络独立训练导致参数冗余、训练效率低；多无人机协同任务中缺乏有效的通信信息聚合机制，智能体间协作能力不足。
AI.method: 1) 共享骨干网络：Actor和Critic网络共享底层基础模块，减少参数量并加速训练；2) 图信息聚合模块：引入图神经网络结构，聚合邻居智能体的通信状态信息，增强多智能体协同决策能力。
AI.result: 在保持连通性的多无人机集群通信覆盖任务中，Shared Backbone PPO相比标准PPO取得了更优的性能；加入图信息聚合模块后算法仍保持有效，且智能体集群展现出更高水平的协作行为。
AI.conclusion: 共享骨干网络架构能有效提升PPO算法训练效率与性能；图信息聚合模块可增强多智能体系统的协作能力，为无人机集群通信覆盖等协同任务提供了可行方案。
idea_en: Shared backbone architecture for Actor-Critic in PPO that reduces parameters and accelerates training for multi-agent systems
Graph information aggregation module integrated into PPO for multi-agent communication coverage tasks
Connectivity-preserving multi-UAV swarm coordination method using shared backbone PPO with graph neural networks
idea_ch: 一种Actor-Critic共享骨干网络的PPO算法架构，通过参数共享降低多智能体系统训练成本并提升效率
融合图信息聚合模块的多智能体PPO算法，用于无人机集群通信覆盖任务中的协同决策
基于共享骨干PPO与图神经网络的保持连通性多无人机集群编队控制方法

title: TeleCom-Bench: How Far Are Large Language Models from Industrial Telecommunication Applications?
summary: While Large Language Models have achieved remarkable integration in various vertical scenarios, their deployment in the telecommunications domain remains exploratory due to the lack of a standardized evaluation framework. Current telecom benchmarks primarily focus on static, foundational knowledge and isolated atomic skills, neglecting the equipment-specific documentation and end-to-end industrial workflows essential for real-world production systems. To bridge this gap, we present TeleCom-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 12 evaluation sets with 22,678 curated samples, which evaluates LLMs across a synergistic hierarchy: (1) Multi-dimensional Knowledge Comprehension, which integrates telecommunication fundamentals, 3GPP protocols, and 5G network architecture with proprietary product knowledge across wired, core, and wireless networks via knowledge graph-driven synthesis; and (2)End-to-End Knowledge Application, which formalizes six core tasks on authentic trajectories from live network agent workflows, including intent recognition, entity extraction, event verification, tool invocation, root cause analysis, and solution generation-across network optimization and fault maintenance scenarios. Evaluations of eight state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a universal Execution Wall: while models achieve 90% accuracy in linguistic interface tasks such as intent recognition and entity extraction, performance collapses to approximately 30% in procedural execution tasks like solution generation. This capability gap demonstrates that current LLMs function competently as diagnosticians but fail as field engineers. TeleCom-Bench provides standardized diagnostics to precisely pinpoint this deficit, offering actionable guidance for domain-specific alignment toward production-ready telecom agents. The dataset and evaluation code have been released at https://github.com/ZTE-AICloud/TeleCom-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TeleCom-Bench，一个包含22,678个样本、12个评估集的电信领域大模型综合基准。通过知识图谱驱动的多维知识理解评估和基于真实网络轨迹的端到端知识应用评估，揭示了当前LLM在电信领域存在"执行墙"：语言界面任务准确率达90%，但过程执行任务（如解决方案生成）仅约30%，表明LLM能胜任诊断者角色但无法成为现场工程师。
AI.motivation: 现有电信基准主要关注静态基础知识和孤立原子技能，缺乏设备特定文档和端到端工业工作流评估，无法满足实际生产系统需求。
AI.method: 构建包含12个评估集、22,678个样本的TeleCom-Bench，采用协同层次结构：(1)多维知识理解——通过知识图谱驱动合成，整合电信基础、3GPP协议、5G网络架构及有线/核心/无线专有产品知识；(2)端到端知识应用——基于真实网络轨迹，形式化意图识别、实体抽取、事件验证、工具调用、根因分析和解决方案生成六大核心任务。
AI.result: 8个SOTA LLM评估显示：语言界面任务（意图识别、实体抽取）准确率达90%，但过程执行任务（如解决方案生成）准确率仅约30%，存在显著的"执行墙"。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在电信领域胜任"诊断者"但无法成为"现场工程师"，TeleCom-Bench为领域对齐和生产级电信智能体提供了标准化诊断工具和可操作指导。
idea_en: 1. A telecommunications knowledge graph-driven synthetic data generation method that integrates multi-dimensional knowledge (fundamentals, 3GPP protocols, 5G architecture, proprietary product knowledge across wired/core/wireless networks) for automated benchmark construction.

2. An evaluation framework with a synergistic two-level hierarchy (Multi-dimensional Knowledge Comprehension and End-to-End Knowledge Application) for assessing LLMs in domain-specific industrial workflows.

3. A formalization method for six core operational tasks (intent recognition, entity extraction, event verification, tool invocation, root cause analysis, solution generation) based on authentic trajectories from live network agent workflows.

4. A diagnostic methodology to identify the 'Execution Wall' phenomenon, quantifying the capability gap between linguistic interface tasks and procedural execution tasks in domain-specific LLM deployments.
idea_ch: 1. 一种基于知识图谱驱动的电信领域多维知识综合合成方法，将电信基础、3GPP协议、5G网络架构与有线/核心/无线网络的专有产品知识融合，用于自动化构建评估基准。
2. 一种协同双层层次评估框架（多维知识理解+端到端知识应用），用于评估LLM在特定领域工业工作流中的实际应用能力。
3. 一种基于真实网络智能体工作流轨迹的六大核心任务（意图识别、实体抽取、事件验证、工具调用、根因分析、解决方案生成）形式化方法。
4. 一种识别'执行墙'现象的诊断方法，量化LLM在领域部署中语言界面任务与过程执行任务之间的能力差距。

title: New Insight of Variance reduce in Zero-Order Hard-Thresholding: Mitigating Gradient Error and Expansivity Contradictions
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024. 9 pages main paper, 24 pages appendix, 11 figures, 7 tables. Correspondence to Bin Gu and Huan Xiong
summary: Hard-thresholding is an important type of algorithm in machine learning that is used to solve $\ell_0$ constrained optimization problems. However, the true gradient of the objective function can be difficult to access in certain scenarios, which normally can be approximated by zeroth-order (ZO) methods. The SZOHT algorithm is the only algorithm tackling $\ell_0$ sparsity constraints with ZO gradients so far. Unfortunately, SZOHT has a notable limitation on the number of random directions % in ZO gradients due to the inherent conflict between the deviation of ZO gradients and the expansivity of the hard-thresholding operator. This paper approaches this problem by considering the role of variance and provides a new insight into variance reduction: mitigating the unique conflicts between ZO gradients and hard-thresholding. Under this perspective, we propose a generalized variance reduced ZO hard-thresholding algorithm as well as the generalized convergence analysis under standard assumptions. The theoretical results demonstrate the new algorithm eliminates the restrictions on the number of random directions, leading to improved convergence rates and broader applicability compared with SZOHT. Finally, we illustrate the utility of our method on a ridge regression problem as well as black-box adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义方差缩减的零阶硬阈值算法（VR-ZOHT），解决了SZOHT算法中随机方向数量受限的问题，实现了更优的收敛速度和更广泛的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有SZOHT算法因零阶梯度偏差与硬阈值算子扩张性之间的固有冲突，对随机方向数量存在显著限制，影响了算法的收敛性能和应用范围。
AI.method: 从方差角度出发，提出方差缩减（variance reduction）机制来缓解零阶梯度与硬阈值算子之间的冲突，设计广义方差缩减零阶硬阈值算法，并在标准假设下给出广义收敛性分析。
AI.result: 新算法消除了对随机方向数量的限制，相比SZOHT具有更优的收敛速度和更广的适用性，在岭回归和黑盒对抗攻击任务中验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 方差缩减能够有效解决零阶梯度与硬阈值算子的冲突问题，为稀疏约束下的零阶优化提供了新的理论视角和实用算法。
idea_en: A variance-reduced zeroth-order hard-thresholding algorithm that eliminates restrictions on the number of random directions in ZO gradient estimation, enabling flexible and efficient optimization under L0 sparsity constraints.
A method for mitigating the inherent conflict between zeroth-order gradient deviation and hard-thresholding operator expansivity through variance reduction techniques.
Generalized convergence analysis for variance-reduced ZO hard-thresholding algorithms under standard assumptions, demonstrating improved convergence rates over SZOHT.
idea_ch: 一种方差缩减的零阶硬阈值算法，消除了零阶梯度估计中对随机方向数量的限制，实现了在L0稀疏约束下的灵活高效优化。
通过方差缩减技术缓解零阶梯度偏差与硬阈值算子扩张性之间的固有冲突的方法。
在标准假设下对方差缩减零阶硬阈值算法进行广义收敛性分析，证明其相较于SZOHT具有更优的收敛速度。

title: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
summary: While Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have shown promising performance in automated device interaction, they primarily depend on static parametric knowledge from pre-training or instruction tuning. This reliance fundamentally limits their ability to handle long-tailed tasks that require explicit procedural knowledge absent from model parameters, often forcing agents to resort to inefficient and brittle trial-and-error exploration. To mitigate this limitation, we introduce \textbf{Proactive Document-Guided Action} for GUI agents in dynamic, open-web environments, a novel paradigm that mirrors human problem-solving by enabling agents to autonomously search for relevant documentation to resolve long-tailed tasks. To evaluate agents' capability in this paradigm, we propose \textbf{DocOS}, a benchmark designed to assess document-guided problem solving in fully interactive environments. DocOS requires agents to autonomously navigate a web browser, locate relevant online documentation, comprehend procedural instructions, and faithfully ground them into executable GUI actions. Extensive experiments reveal that progress is strictly constrained by dual bottlenecks: agents struggle to reliably locate relevant information during proactive search and frequently fail to faithfully ground retrieved instructions into precise actions, pointing toward document-guided interaction as a crucial pathway for enabling self-evolving GUI agents in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“主动文档引导操作”（Proactive Document-Guided Action）的新范式，使GUI代理能够像人类一样自主搜索相关文档来解决长尾任务，并构建了DocOS基准来评估该能力。实验发现代理在主动搜索和指令落地执行两个环节存在瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理主要依赖预训练或指令微调中的静态参数化知识，无法有效处理需要显式程序性知识的长尾任务，往往只能通过低效的试错探索来应对。
AI.method: 提出Proactive Document-Guided Action范式，使GUI代理能自主搜索在线文档、理解程序性指令并将其落地为可执行的GUI操作；同时构建DocOS基准来评估这一能力。
AI.result: 实验表明代理在动态开放网络环境中仍面临双重瓶颈：一是难以可靠定位相关信息，二是难以将检索到的指令精确落地为具体操作。
AI.conclusion: 文档引导式交互是使GUI代理在动态环境中实现自我演进的关键路径。
idea_en: Proactive Document-Guided Action paradigm for GUI agents: enabling autonomous web documentation search to resolve long-tailed tasks without relying on static parametric knowledge
DocOS benchmark: a fully interactive, open-web evaluation framework for assessing document-guided problem-solving in GUI agents
Dual-bottleneck analysis method for diagnosing GUI agents' failures in proactive information retrieval vs instruction grounding
idea_ch: 主动文档引导操作范式：使GUI代理在动态开放网络环境中自主搜索在线文档来解析长尾任务，摆脱对静态参数化知识的依赖

title: LLM-Guided Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 9 pages for main, 32 pages for total, Accepted to ICML 2026
summary: Communication is a key component in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for mitigating partial observability, yet prior approaches often rely on inefficient information exchange or fail to transmit sufficient state information. To address this, we propose LLM-driven Multi-Agent Communication (LMAC), which leverages an LLM's reasoning capability to design a communication protocol that enables all agents to reconstruct the underlying state as accurately and uniformly as possible. LMAC iteratively refines the protocol using an explicit state-awareness criterion, improving state recovery while narrowing differences in agents' knowledge. Experiments on diverse MARL benchmarks show that LMAC improves state reconstruction across agents and yields substantial performance gains over prior communication baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM驱动的多智能体通信方法(LMAC)，利用大语言模型的推理能力设计通信协议，使所有智能体能够尽可能准确且一致地重建底层状态，实验证明该方法在状态重建和任务性能上均优于现有通信基线。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习中存在部分可观测性问题，现有通信方法要么信息交换效率低下，要么无法传输足够的状态信息。
AI.method: 利用LLM的推理能力设计通信协议，通过显式的状态感知准则迭代优化协议，使所有智能体尽可能准确且一致地重建底层状态。
AI.result: 在多种MARL基准测试上，LMAC改善了智能体间的状态重建，并在任务性能上大幅超越现有通信基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的通信协议设计能够有效提升多智能体系统的状态重建一致性和任务性能。

title: Learning to Solve Compositional Geometry Routing Problems
summary: We study the Compositional Geometry Routing Problem (CGRP), a unified superclass of traditional routing problems that covers point-only, line-only, area-only, and arbitrary hybrid task geometries, providing a broad abstraction for real-world routing scenarios. Beyond standard point-based routing, CGRP with non-point tasks can be inherently asymmetric, tightly coupled travel routes with the intrinsic path, and enlarges the action space with numerous feasible yet often irrelevant options, thereby posing significant challenges for both representation learning and decision-making. To address these challenges, we propose DiCon, a differential attention-assisted solver with contrastive learning, as a plug-and-play framework that tackles the problem from two complementary angles. First, we introduce a differential attention mechanism that actively suppresses the probability mass on less competitive candidate actions. Second, we design a double-level contrastive learning objective to promote robust global instance representations and regularize geometry-aware task representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiCon achieves strong performance, broad versatility, and superior generalization across diverse CGRP instances with different compositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiCon框架，通过差分注意力机制和双层对比学习，解决组合几何路径问题（CGRP）中非点任务的非对称性、路径耦合和动作空间爆炸等挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统路径规划局限于点状任务，无法处理线、面及混合几何任务的现实场景，而非点任务带来的非对称性、路径耦合与巨大动作空间给表示学习和决策带来严峻挑战。
AI.method: 提出DiCon即插即用框架：(1) 差分注意力机制主动抑制低竞争力候选动作的概率质量；(2) 双层对比学习目标，提升全局实例表示的鲁棒性并规范几何感知任务表示。
AI.result: 实验表明DiCon在多种CGRP实例上性能强劲、通用性强且泛化能力优越。
AI.conclusion: DiCon有效解决了CGRP中非点任务的表示学习和决策难题，为复杂几何路径规划提供了统一且高效的解决方案。

title: Safety Geometry Collapse in Multimodal LLMs and Adaptive Drift Correction
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail to transfer safety capabilities learned in the text modality to semantically equivalent non-text inputs, revealing a persistent multimodal safety gap. We study this gap from a representation-geometric perspective by analyzing a text-aligned refusal direction and a modality-induced drift direction. We show that multimodal inputs compress the usable separation along the refusal direction, making it no longer reliable for identifying and refusing harmful inputs. We refer to this failure mode as Safety Geometry Collapse. We quantify it through conditional refusal separability and show that stronger modality-induced drift is consistently associated with weaker refusal separability and higher attack success rates. We then validate the causal role of modality-induced drift through a fixed-strength activation intervention: counteracting the estimated drift restores refusal separability and improves multimodal safety. After drift correction, we further observe self-rectification, where the model recovers its ability to recognize and refuse harmful multimodal inputs during forward dynamics. This effect also provides an internal signal of the model's perceived harmfulness of each input. Motivated by this signal, we propose ReGap, a training-free inference-time method that adaptively corrects modality drift using self-rectification. Experiments across multiple multimodal safety benchmarks and utility benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ReGap, which significantly improves the safety of MLLMs without compromising general capabilities. Our findings highlight representation-level modality alignment as a crucial direction for real-time safety improvement and for building safer, more reliable MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Safety Geometry Collapse概念，揭示多模态大模型因模态诱导漂移导致安全拒绝方向失效的问题，并提出无需训练的推理时自适应校正方法ReGap，显著提升多模态安全性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在文本模态中习得的安全能力无法有效迁移到语义等价的非文本输入（如图像），存在持久的多模态安全鸿沟。现有方法未能从表征几何角度解释这一现象的原因。
AI.method: 从表征几何视角分析文本对齐的拒绝方向与模态诱导漂移方向。通过条件拒绝可分性量化安全几何崩塌。提出固定强度激活干预验证因果关系，并基于自修正现象提出ReGap——一种无需训练、推理时自适应校正模态漂移的方法。
AI.result: 实验表明：更强的模态诱导漂移与更弱的拒绝可分性及更高的攻击成功率一致。ReGap在多个多模态安全基准和效用基准上显著提升安全性，且不损害通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 表征层面的模态对齐是实现实时安全改进和构建更安全可靠多模态大模型的关键方向。
